sourceRange.text: 案舊唐書：光啟三年十一月，楊行密遣使求援于朱全忠，制授全忠檢校太尉、侍中，兼揚州大都督府長史，充淮南節度觀察使、行營兵馬都統。歐陽史作十二月，通鑑作閏十一月，據薛史則全忠兼領淮南自在九月以前，與諸書異。又薛史下文作閏十二月，而通鑑作閏十一月，亦有互異，未詳孰是。九月，亳州裨將謝殷逐刺史宋衮，自據其郡，帝親領軍屯于太清宮，遣霍存討平之。案新唐書云：光啟三年六月壬戌，亳州將謝殷逐其刺史宋衮。八月壬寅，謝殷伏誅。通鑑從新唐書，薛史作九月，與新唐書異。帝之禦蔡寇也，鄆州朱瑄、案：歐陽史作朱宣，薛史前後皆作「瑄」，舊唐書、通鑑並同薛史。兗州朱瑾皆領兵來援。

sourceRange.text: 九月，帝遂與左右定計，斬偽監軍使嚴實，嚴實原書訛作「嚴貴」，今據歐陽史及通鑑改正。舉郡降于重榮。案舊唐書僖宗紀：八月庚子，賊同州防禦使朱溫殺其監軍嚴實，與大將胡真、謝瞳等來降。薛史作九月，與舊唐書異。考新唐書：九月丙戌，黃巢將朱溫以同州降。通鑑亦作九月丙戌，朱溫殺其監軍嚴實，舉州降。皆與薛史同。是朱溫之降，實在九月，舊唐書誤。重榮卽日飛章上奏，時僖宗在蜀，覽表而喜曰：「是天賜予也。」乃詔授帝左金吾衞大將軍，充河中行營副招討使，仍賜名全忠。案歐陽史云：王鐸承制拜溫金吾衞大將軍、河中行營招討副使。薛史以為僖宗詔授，與歐陽史異。考舊唐書：王鐸承制拜溫為華州刺史、潼關防禦鎮國軍等使。通鑑作王鐸承制以溫為同華節度使。是王鐸承制所拜之官，非如歐陽史所載也，至謝瞳奉表行在，乃詔授金吾衞大將軍、河中行營招討副使耳。當以薛史為得其實。案：是書及舊唐書、通鑑皆作僖宗賜名，惟鑑戒錄云：朱太祖統四鎮，除中令日，名溫。與崔相國連搆大事，崔每奏太祖忠赤，遷之關東，國無患矣。昭宗遽敕太祖改名全忠，議者謂「全」字人王也，又在「中心」，甚不可也，上方悔焉。其說與諸史異，蓋傳聞之不同爾。

sourceRange.text: 閏月甲寅，帝請行營司馬李璠權知淮南留後，乃遣大將郭言領兵援送以赴揚州。文德元年正月，帝率師東赴淮海，行次宋州，聞楊行密已拔揚州，遂還。是時，李璠、郭言行至淮上，為徐戎所扼，不克進而還。案歐陽史云：璠之揚州，行密不納。據通鑑云：李璠至泗州，時溥以兵襲之，郭言力戰得免而還。是李璠未嘗得至揚州也，當以薛史為寔錄。帝怒，遂謀伐徐。二月丙戌，僖宗制以帝為蔡州四面行營都統，繇是諸鎮之師，皆受帝之節制。案新唐書：正月癸亥，朱全忠為蔡州四面行營都統。舊唐書作五月，與薛史異。通鑑從新唐書。三月庚子，昭宗卽位。是月，蔡人石璠領萬眾以剽陳、亳，帝遣朱珍率精騎數千擒璠以獻。四月戊辰，魏博樂彥禎失律，其子從訓出奔相州，使來乞師。帝遣朱珍領大軍濟河，連收黎陽、臨河二邑。旣而魏軍推小校羅弘信為帥。弘信旣立，遣使送款于汴，帝優而納之，遂命班師。是月，河南尹張全義襲李罕之于河陽，克之。罕之單騎出奔，因乞師于太原，李克用為發萬騎以援之。罕之遂收其眾，偕晉軍合勢，急攻河陽。全義危急，遣使求救于汴，帝遣丁會、牛存節、葛從周領兵赴之，大戰于溫縣，晉人與罕之俱敗。于是河橋解圍，全義歸于河陽，因以丁會為河陽留後。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: By then Li Fan and Guo Yan had reached the Huai, but Xu troops blocked them and they had to return.

manualTranslations.literal: The emperor was angry and then planned to attack Xu.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the second month, Xizong made him commander-in-chief against Caizhou on all four fronts, bringing the armies of the circuits under his authority.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the third month, Zhaozong took the throne.

manualTranslations.literal: That month, Shi Fan of Cai led ten thousand men to plunder Chen and Bo; the emperor sent Zhu Zhen with several thousand elite cavalry, captured Fan, and presented him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month Shi Fan of Cai plundered Chen and Bo with ten thousand men; the emperor sent Zhu Zhen with several thousand picked horsemen, who captured Fan and presented him.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the fourth month, Le Yanzhen of Weibo lost control of his forces; his son Congxun fled to Xiangzhou and begged for troops.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Zhu Zhen across the river with a large army; he took Liyang and Linhe in succession.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Wei army then raised the junior officer Luo Hongxin as its commander.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hanzhi fled alone on horseback and appealed to Taiyuan; Li Keyong sent ten thousand horse to help him.

sourceRange.text: 龍紀元年正月，龎師古攻陷宿遷縣，進軍于呂梁。時溥領軍二萬，晨壓師古之軍而陣，師古促戰，敗之，斬首二千餘級，溥復入于彭門。二月，蔡將申叢遣使來告，縛秦宗權于帳下，折其足而囚之矣。案舊唐書：文德元年十二月甲子朔，蔡州牙將申叢執秦宗權。新唐書作十一月辛酉，與舊唐書月日互異。薛史作龍紀元年二月，蓋卽其遣使來告之月而書之也。歐陽史作五月，誤。帝卽日承制以叢為淮西留後。未幾，叢復為都將郭璠所殺。是月，璠執宗權來獻，帝遣行軍司馬李璠、牙校朱克讓檻進于長安。旣至，昭宗御延喜樓受俘，卽斬宗權于獨柳樹下。蔡州平。昭宗詔加帝食實封一百戶，賜莊宅各一區。三月，又加帝檢校太尉、兼中書令，進封東平王，賞平蔡之功也。案舊唐書：四月壬戌朔，以宣武淮南等節度副大使、知節度事、管內營田觀察處置等使、開府儀同三司、檢校太傅、兼侍中、揚州大都督府長史、汴州刺史、充蔡州四面行營都統、上柱國、沛郡王、食邑四千戶朱全忠為檢校太尉、中書令，進封東平王，仍賜賞軍錢十萬貫。薛史及歐陽史俱作三月，與舊唐書異。

sourceRange.text: 十二月，兗州朱瑾領軍三萬寇單父，帝遣丁會領大軍襲之，敗于金鄉界，殺二萬餘眾，瑾單馬遁去。景福元年正月，遣丁會于兗州界徙其民數千戶于許州。二月戊寅，帝親征鄆，先遣朱友裕屯軍于斗門。甲申，次衞南，有飛鳥止于峻堞之上，鳴噪甚厲，副使李璠曰：「將有不如意之事。」是夜，鄆州朱瑾率步騎萬人襲朱友裕于斗門，友裕拔軍南去。乙酉，帝晨救斗門，不知友裕之退，前至斗門者皆為鄆人所殺。帝追襲鄆人至瓠河，不及，遂領兵于村落間。案領字攷文義應是頓字之譌。今改。時朱瑄尚在濮州。丁亥，遇朱瑄率兵將歸于鄆，遂來衝擊。帝策馬南馳，為賊所追甚急，前有浚溝，躍馬而過，張歸厚援矟力戰于其後，乃免。時李璠與都將數人皆為鄆軍所殺。五月丙午，遣朱克讓率眾暴兗、鄆之麥。十一月，遣朱友裕率兵攻濮州，下之，擒刺史邵儒以獻，濮州平。遂命移軍伐徐州。冊府元龜卷一百八十七。二年四月丁丑，師古下彭門，梟溥首以獻。通鑑考異引薛史梁紀。案：冊府元龜引薛史，于景福二年事多所刪節。考異是年春有石佛山之戰，今不載。通鑑注引薛史云：「石佛山在彭門南。」疑卽此處闕文也。八月，帝遣龎師古移兵攻兗，駐于曲阜，與朱瑾屢戰，皆敗之。

manualTranslations.zh: 是夜，鄆州朱瑾率步騎萬人襲朱友裕于斗門，友裕拔軍南去。
manualTranslations.literal: That night, Zhu Jin of Yunzhou led ten thousand infantry and cavalry to attack Zhu Youyu at Doumen, and Youyu withdrew his army south.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That night Zhu Jin of Yunzhou attacked Zhu Youyu at Doumen with ten thousand foot and horse, and Youyu pulled south.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙酉，帝晨救斗門，不知友裕之退，前至斗門者皆為鄆人所殺。
manualTranslations.literal: On yiyou day, the emperor went at dawn to relieve Doumen; not knowing that Youyu had withdrawn, those who went ahead to Doumen were all killed by the men of Yun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On yiyou he hurried to relieve Doumen at dawn, unaware Youyu had withdrawn; everyone who reached Doumen first was killed by Yun troops.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝追襲鄆人至瓠河，不及，遂頓兵于村落間。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor pursued the men of Yun as far as the Hu River but did not catch them, and so halted his army among the villages.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He pursued the Yun men to the Hu River but could not catch them, then halted among the villages.

manualTranslations.zh: 時朱瑄尚在濮州。
manualTranslations.literal: At this time Zhu Xuan was still in Puzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhu Xuan was still at Puzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁亥，遇朱瑄率兵將歸于鄆，遂來衝擊。
manualTranslations.literal: On dinghai day, he encountered Zhu Xuan leading troops back toward Yun, and Xuan came on to attack.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dinghai he met Zhu Xuan leading troops back to Yun, and Xuan charged him.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝策馬南馳，為賊所追甚急，前有浚溝，躍馬而過，張歸厚援矟力戰于其後，乃免。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor whipped his horse and fled south, with the enemy pressing him hard; a deep ditch lay ahead, and he leapt his horse over it, while Zhang Guihou took up his spear and fought fiercely behind him, so the emperor escaped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor galloped south with the enemy close behind; he leapt a deep ditch, and Zhang Guihou fought hard with his spear behind him, allowing him to escape.

manualTranslations.zh: 時李璠與都將數人皆為鄆軍所殺。
manualTranslations.literal: At this time Li Fan and several generals were all killed by the Yun army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li Fan and several generals were killed by the Yun army.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月丙午，遣朱克讓率眾暴兗、鄆之麥。
manualTranslations.literal: On bingwu day in the fifth month, he sent Zhu Kerang to lead troops in destroying the wheat of Yan and Yun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the fifth month he sent Zhu Kerang to ravage the wheat fields of Yan and Yun.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月，遣朱友裕率兵攻濮州，下之，擒刺史邵儒以獻，濮州平。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, he sent Zhu Youyu to lead troops to attack Puzhou; he took it, captured Prefect Shao Ru and presented him, and Puzhou was pacified.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he sent Zhu Youyu against Puzhou; Youyu took it, captured Prefect Shao Ru, and Puzhou was pacified.

manualTranslations.zh: 遂命移軍伐徐州。
manualTranslations.literal: He then ordered the army shifted to attack Xuzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then turned the army against Xuzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年四月丁丑，師古下彭門，梟溥首以獻。
manualTranslations.literal: On dingchou day in the fourth month of the second year, Shigu took Pengmen and presented Pu's head.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, on dingchou in the fourth month, Shigu took Pengmen and sent up Shi Pu's head.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月，帝遣龎師古移兵攻兗，駐于曲阜，與朱瑾屢戰，皆敗之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, the emperor sent Pang Shigu to move troops to attack Yan; he stationed them at Qufu, fought Zhu Jin repeatedly, and defeated him each time.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he sent Pang Shigu against Yan; camped at Qufu, Pang defeated Zhu Jin again and again.

sourceRange.text: 庚午，案通鑑考異云：長曆四月甲辰朔，無庚午，薛史誤。今考舊唐書，光啟三年四月正作甲辰朔，以日數計之，庚午乃四月二十七日也。此非薛史之誤，乃通鑑考異之誤耳。賊將盧瑭領萬餘人于圃田北萬勝戍夾汴水為營，跨河為梁，以扼運路。案通鑑注引薛史梁紀曰：盧瑭于圃田北夾汴為梁，以扼運路。視冊府元龜所引，稍有刪節。

sourceRange.text: 案通鑑：乾寧二年四月，河東遣其將史儼兒、李承嗣以萬人馳入于鄆。此據薛史梁紀原文，惟史儼兒作史儼為微異耳。下又云：七月，克用遣史儼將三千騎詣石門侍衞。十二月，李克用遣大將史儼、李承嗣假道于魏以救之。前後復互，且其時汴、鄆日有戰爭，道路且隔，史儼旣于四月入鄆，不應七月已在石門，十二月又過魏也。考舊唐書云：初，兗、鄆求援于太原，克用令蕃將史完府、何懷實等千騎赴之。不言其赴鄆為何時。據此篇下云：八月，獲蕃將史完府。十一月，擒何懷寶。然則四月馳入于鄆者，當是史完府、何懷寶，非史儼、李承嗣也。參考薛史唐武皇紀及李承嗣傳，承嗣等入鄆定在二年之冬，梁紀似有舛誤。通鑑並采梁、唐帝紀，亦未能考定畫一。

sourceRange.text: 光化元年正月，帝遣葛從周統諸將略地于山東，遂次於邢、洺。三月，昭宗以帝兼領天平軍節度使，余如故。四月，滄州節度使盧廷彥為燕軍所攻，棄城奔于魏，魏人送於汴。是月，帝以大軍至钜鹿，屯於城下，敗晉軍萬餘眾于青山口，俘馬千餘匹。丁卯，遣從周分兵攻洺州，斬刺史邢善益，擒將五十餘人。五月己巳，邢州刺史馬師素棄城遁去。辛未，磁州刺史袁奉滔自剄而死。五日之內，連下三州。因以葛從周兼邢州昭義軍節度使留後，帝遂班師。是時，襄州節度使趙匡凝聞帝軍有清口之敗，密附於淮夷。七月，帝遣氏叔琮率師伐之。未幾，泌州刺史趙璠越墉來降；隨州刺史趙匡琳臨陣就擒。

manualTranslations.zh: 光化元年正月，帝遣葛從周統諸將略地于山東，遂次於邢、洺。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Guanghua, the Emperor sent Ge Congzhou to command the generals in raiding Shandong, and they then halted at Xing and Ming.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of Guanghua 1 the Emperor sent Ge Congzhou to lead the generals in raiding Shandong, and they halted at Xing and Ming.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月，昭宗以帝兼領天平軍節度使，余如故。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month Zhaozong had the Emperor additionally hold the post of military governor of the Tianping Army; the rest remained as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month Zhaozong made the Emperor concurrent military governor of the Tianping army; his other posts were unchanged.

manualTranslations.zh: 四月，滄州節度使盧廷彥為燕軍所攻，棄城奔于魏，魏人送於汴。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth month Lu Tingyan, military governor of Cangzhou, was attacked by the Yan army, abandoned the city and fled to Wei; the people of Wei sent him on to Bian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Lu Tingyan of Cangzhou, attacked by the Yan army, abandoned his city and fled to Wei, and the Wei garrison sent him on to Bian.

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，帝以大軍至钜鹿，屯於城下，敗晉軍萬餘眾于青山口，俘馬千餘匹。
manualTranslations.literal: That month the Emperor with a great army reached Julu, encamped below the city, and at Qingshan Pass defeated more than ten thousand Jin troops, capturing more than a thousand horses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month the Emperor marched to Julu, camped beneath the walls, and at Qingshan Pass routed more than ten thousand Jin troops and seized a thousand horses.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁卯，遣從周分兵攻洺州，斬刺史邢善益，擒將五十餘人。
manualTranslations.literal: On dingmao he sent Congzhou with a detachment to attack Ming Prefecture, beheaded Prefect Xing Shanyi, and captured more than fifty officers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingmao he sent Congzhou to storm Mingzhou, killed Prefect Xing Shanyi, and took more than fifty officers.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月己巳，邢州刺史馬師素棄城遁去。
manualTranslations.literal: On jisi in the fifth month Ma Shisu, prefect of Xing Prefecture, abandoned the city and fled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jisi in the fifth month Xingzhou Prefect Ma Shisu abandoned the city and fled.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛未，磁州刺史袁奉滔自剄而死。
manualTranslations.literal: On xinwei Yuan Fengtao, prefect of Ci Prefecture, cut his own throat and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinwei Cizhou Prefect Yuan Fengtao killed himself by cutting his throat.

manualTranslations.zh: 五日之內，連下三州。
manualTranslations.literal: Within five days three prefectures fell in succession.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Within five days three prefectures fell in succession.

manualTranslations.zh: 因以葛從周兼邢州昭義軍節度使留後，帝遂班師。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon Ge Congzhou was made acting military governor of Xing Prefecture and the Zhaoyi Army, and the Emperor then withdrew the army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ge Congzhou was made acting governor of Xingzhou and the Zhaoyi army, and the Emperor withdrew.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時，襄州節度使趙匡凝聞帝軍有清口之敗，密附於淮夷。
manualTranslations.literal: At this time Zhao Kuangning, military governor of Xiang Prefecture, hearing that the Emperor's army had suffered the defeat at Qingkou, secretly attached himself to the Huai barbarians.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhao Kuangning of Xiangzhou, hearing of the Emperor's defeat at Qingkou, secretly sided with the Huai rebels.

manualTranslations.zh: 七月，帝遣氏叔琮率師伐之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh month the Emperor sent Shi Shuzong to lead troops to attack him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Emperor sent Shi Shuzong against him.

manualTranslations.zh: 未幾，泌州刺史趙璠越墉來降；
manualTranslations.literal: Before long Zhao Fan, prefect of Bi Prefecture, scaled the wall to come surrender;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon Bi Prefect Zhao Fan climbed the wall to surrender;

manualTranslations.zh: 隨州刺史趙匡琳臨陣就擒。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhao Kuanglin, prefect of Sui Prefecture, was captured on the spot in battle.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: and Suizhou Prefect Zhao Kuanglin was taken in battle.

sourceRange.text: 洪氏所述與冊府元龜畧同，惟「留十餘囷」與「留數囷」微異。

context.beforeSource: 」全忠為之留數囷，滄人賴以濟。
context.beforeLocal: 全忠為之留數囷，滄人賴以濟。

sourceRange.text: 開平元年正月丁亥，帝回自長蘆，次於魏州。節度使羅紹威以帝回軍，慮有不測之患，由是供億甚至，因密以天人之望切陳之。帝雖拒而不納，然心德之。壬寅，帝至自長蘆。是日，有慶雲覆於府署之上。甲辰，天子遣御史大夫薛貽矩來傳禪代之意。貽矩謁帝，陳北面之禮，帝揖之升階。貽矩曰：「殿下功德及人，三靈所卜已定。皇帝方議裁詔，行舜、禹之事，臣安敢違。」既而拜伏於砌下，帝側躬以避之。

context.afterSource: 二月戊申，帝之家廟棟間有五色芝生焉，狀若芙蓉，紫煙蒙護，數日不散。
context.afterLocal: 二月戊申，帝之家廟棟間有五色芝生焉，狀若芙蓉，紫煙蒙護，數日不散。

manualTranslations.zh: 開平元年正月丁亥，帝回自長蘆，次於魏州。
manualTranslations.literal: On dinghai in the first month of Kaiping year 1, the Emperor returned from Changlu and halted at Weizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the first month of Kaiping year 1 the Emperor returned from Changlu and stopped at Weizhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 節度使羅紹威以帝回軍，慮有不測之患，由是供億甚至，因密以天人之望切陳之。
manualTranslations.literal: Military Commissioner Luo Shaowei, because the Emperor was returning with his army, feared unforeseen trouble; he therefore supplied provisions on an extraordinary scale and privately urged him in the strongest terms that Heaven and men alike expected his next step.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Military Commissioner Luo Shaowei, fearing trouble when the Emperor marched home with his army, supplied provisions lavishly and privately urged that Heaven and men alike expected the transfer of the mandate.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝雖拒而不納，然心德之。
manualTranslations.literal: The Emperor declined but was inwardly grateful.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Emperor refused but was inwardly grateful.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬寅，帝至自長蘆。
manualTranslations.literal: On renyin the Emperor arrived from Changlu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renyin the Emperor arrived from Changlu.

manualTranslations.zh: 是日，有慶雲覆於府署之上。
manualTranslations.literal: That day auspicious clouds spread over the prefectural compound.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That day auspicious clouds covered the prefectural compound.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲辰，天子遣御史大夫薛貽矩來傳禪代之意。
manualTranslations.literal: On jiachen the Son of Heaven sent Censor-in-Chief Xue Yiju to convey the intention of transferring the mandate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiachen the Son of Heaven sent Censor-in-Chief Xue Yiju to convey the plan for abdication.

manualTranslations.zh: 貽矩謁帝，陳北面之禮，帝揖之升階。
manualTranslations.literal: Yiju called on the Emperor, set forth the rites due a northern vassal, and the Emperor bowed him up the steps.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yiju called on the Emperor, explained the ceremony of a northern vassal, and the Emperor bowed him up the steps.

manualTranslations.zh: 貽矩曰：「殿下功德及人，三靈所卜已定。
manualTranslations.literal: Yiju said: "Your Highness's merit reaches all men; the three powers have already decreed the issue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yiju said: "Your Highness's merit reaches all men; Heaven, Earth, and the spirits have already settled the matter.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇帝方議裁詔，行舜、禹之事，臣安敢違。」
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor is now drafting the edict to do as Shun and Yu did—I dare not disobey."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor is drafting the edict to follow Shun and Yu—I dare not refuse."

manualTranslations.zh: 既而拜伏於砌下，帝側躬以避之。
manualTranslations.literal: He then bowed prostrate on the steps; the Emperor turned aside to avoid it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then bowed prostrate on the steps, and the Emperor turned aside.

sourceRange.text: 十月丁酉，以開府儀同三司、中書侍郎兼吏部尚書、同平章事、集賢殿大學士、判戶部敬翔為右僕射兼門下侍郎、平章事、監修國史，判度支。以光祿大夫、中書侍郎、同平章事鄭玨為特進、兼刑部尚書、平章事、集賢殿大學士，判戶部。十月，晉王自太原至魏州。是月，前昭義軍節度使、檢校太師、兼侍中、陳留郡王葛從周薨。是歲，河北諸州悉入於晉。

context.beforeSource: ）己卯，天平軍節度副大使、知節度事、檢校太師、兼中書令、琅琊郡王王檀薨。
context.beforeLocal: 己卯，天平軍節度副大使、知節度事、檢校太師、兼中書令、琅琊郡王王檀薨。

manualTranslations.zh: 十月丁酉，以開府儀同三司、中書侍郎兼吏部尚書、同平章事、集賢殿大學士、判戶部敬翔為右僕射兼門下侍郎、平章事、監修國史，判度支。
manualTranslations.literal: On dingyou in the tenth month, Jing Xiang—Grand Minister of State with the Ceremonial Establishment, Vice Grand Counselor concurrently Vice Minister of Personnel, Co-Grand Counselor, Grand Academician of the Jixian Hall, and overseer of the Ministry of Revenue—was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat concurrently Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Counselor, supervisor of the compilation of the National History, and overseer of the Bureau of Budgets.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the tenth month Jing Xiang—minister of state, vice grand counselor and personnel overseer, co-grand counselor, Jixian grand academician, and Ministry of Revenue head—was made right vice director of the Secretariat, vice director of the Chancellery, grand counselor, supervisor of the National History, and Bureau of Budgets head.

manualTranslations.zh: 以光祿大夫、中書侍郎、同平章事鄭玨為特進、兼刑部尚書、平章事、集賢殿大學士，判戶部。
manualTranslations.literal: Grand Master of Splendid Honors Zheng Jue, Vice Grand Counselor and Co-Grand Counselor, was made Special Advancement, concurrent Vice Minister of Punishments, Grand Counselor, Grand Academician of the Jixian Hall, and overseer of the Ministry of Revenue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zheng Jue, grand master of splendid honors, vice grand counselor, and co-grand counselor, was made special advancement, concurrent vice minister of punishments, grand counselor, Jixian grand academician, and Ministry of Revenue head.

manualTranslations.zh: 十月，晉王自太原至魏州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth month the Prince of Jin came from Taiyuan to Weizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Prince of Jin marched from Taiyuan to Weizhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，前昭義軍節度使、檢校太師、兼侍中、陳留郡王葛從周薨。
manualTranslations.literal: That month the former Zhaoyi Army Military Commissioner, Honorary Grand Preceptor, Concurrent Palace Attendant, Prince of Chenliu Ge Congzhou died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month Ge Congzhou, former Zhaoyi commissioner and Prince of Chenliu, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，河北諸州悉入於晉。
manualTranslations.literal: That year all Hebei prefectures fell entirely to Jin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year Jin took all of Hebei.

sourceRange.text: 末帝，諱瑱，初名友貞，及即位，改名鍠，貞明中又改今諱。太祖第四子也。母曰元貞皇后張氏。以唐文德元年戊申歲九月十二日生於東京。帝美容儀，性沉厚寡言，雅好儒士。唐光化三年，授河南府參軍。太祖受禪，封均王。時太祖初置天興軍，最為親衛，以帝為左天興軍使。開平四年夏，進位檢校司空，依前天興軍使，充東京馬步軍都指揮使。

context.afterSource: 乾化二年六月二日，庶人友珪弑逆，矯太祖詔，遣供奉官丁昭溥馳至東京，密令帝害博王友文。
context.afterLocal: 乾化二年六月二日，庶人友珪弑逆，矯太祖詔，遣供奉官丁昭溥馳至東京，密令帝害博王友文。

manualTranslations.zh: 末帝，諱瑱，初名友貞，及即位，改名鍠，貞明中又改今諱。
manualTranslations.literal: The Last Emperor, taboo name Zhen, was originally named Youzhen; on taking the throne he changed his name to Huang, and in Zhenming again changed to his present taboo name.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Last Emperor, taboo name Zhen, was originally Youzhen; on accession he took the name Huang, and in Zhenming changed to his present taboo name.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖第四子也。
manualTranslations.literal: He was Taizu's fourth son.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was Taizu's fourth son.

manualTranslations.zh: 母曰元貞皇后張氏。
manualTranslations.literal: His mother was Empress Yuanzhen, née Zhang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Yuanzhen (Zhang).

manualTranslations.zh: 以唐文德元年戊申歲九月十二日生於東京。
manualTranslations.literal: On the twelfth day of the ninth month of the wushen year of Tang Wende 1 he was born in the Eastern Capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was born in the Eastern Capital on the twelfth of the ninth month of the wushen year, Wende 1 of Tang.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝美容儀，性沉厚寡言，雅好儒士。
manualTranslations.literal: The Emperor had fine features and bearing; his nature was deep, steady, and sparing of speech, and he esteemed Confucian scholars.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Handsome and composed, he spoke little and loved the company of scholars.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐光化三年，授河南府參軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tang Guanghua 3 he was appointed aide of Henan Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Guanghua 3 of Tang he was made aide of Henan Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖受禪，封均王。
manualTranslations.literal: When Taizu received the abdication, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Jun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Taizu took the throne, he was made Prince of Jun.

manualTranslations.zh: 時太祖初置天興軍，最為親衛，以帝為左天興軍使。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Taizu first established the Tianxing Army as the closest imperial guard, and made the Emperor Left Tianxing Army commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Taizu first formed the Tianxing Army as his personal guard, he made the Emperor commander of the Left Tianxing.

manualTranslations.zh: 開平四年夏，進位檢校司空，依前天興軍使，充東京馬步軍都指揮使。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer of Kaiping 4 he was advanced to honorary Minister of Works, still serving as Tianxing Army commander, and filled the post of Eastern Capital horse-and-foot commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the summer of Kaiping 4 he was promoted to honorary Minister of Works, kept command of the Tianxing Army, and became commander of horse and foot at the Eastern Capital.

sourceRange.text: 五月，晉王率師赴魏州。節度使牛存節薨。是月，鳳翔李茂貞遣偽署涇州節度使劉知俊率師攻邠州，以李保衡歸順故也。自是，凡攻圍十四月，節度使霍彥威、諸軍都指揮使黃貴堅守捍寇，會救軍至，岐人乃退。六月庚寅，晉王入魏州，以賀德倫為大同軍節度使，舉族遷於晉陽。是月，晉人陷德州。

context.beforeSource: 彥魯領知州事五十餘日，保衡殺彥魯送款於帝，即以保衡為華州節度使，以河陽留後霍彥威為邠州節度使。
context.afterSource: 秋七月，又陷澶州，刺史王彥章棄城來奔。

manualTranslations.zh: 五月，晉王率師赴魏州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month the Prince of Jin led troops to Weizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Prince of Jin marched to Weizhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 節度使牛存節薨。
manualTranslations.literal: Military Commissioner Niucunjie died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Military Commissioner Niucunjie died.

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，鳳翔李茂貞遣偽署涇州節度使劉知俊率師攻邠州，以李保衡歸順故也。
manualTranslations.literal: That month Fengxiang's Li Maozhen sent the usurper-appointed Jingzhou Military Commissioner Liu Zhijun with troops to attack Binzhou, because Li Baoheng had submitted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month Li Maozhen of Fengxiang sent Liu Zhijun, puppet commander of Jingzhou, against Bin—Li Baoheng's surrender was the cause.

manualTranslations.zh: 自是，凡攻圍十四月，節度使霍彥威、諸軍都指揮使黃貴堅守捍寇，會救軍至，岐人乃退。
manualTranslations.literal: From then the siege lasted fourteen months; Military Commissioner Huo Yanwei and all-armies commander Huang Gui held firm and repelled the enemy; when relief arrived the Qi forces withdrew.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The siege then ran fourteen months; Huo Yanwei and all-armies commander Huang Gui held out until relief came and Qi withdrew.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月庚寅，晉王入魏州，以賀德倫為大同軍節度使，舉族遷於晉陽。
manualTranslations.literal: On gengyin in the sixth month the Prince of Jin entered Weizhou, made He Delun Datong Army Military Commissioner, and moved his whole clan to Jinyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the sixth month the Prince of Jin took Weizhou, made He Delun commander of Datong, and moved his clan to Jinyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，晉人陷德州。
manualTranslations.literal: That month the Jin took De Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month Jin seized De Prefecture.

sourceRange.text: 龍德元年春正月癸巳，詔諸道入奏判官，宜令御史台點檢，合從正衙退後，便於中書門下公參辭謝。如有違越，具名銜聞奏。應麵賜章服，仍令閣門使取本官狀申中書門下，受敕牒後，方可結入新銜。甲辰，以河東道行營西面應接使、前靜勝軍節度、崇裕等州觀察處置等使、特進、檢校太尉、同平章事溫昭圖為匡國軍節度、陳許蔡等州觀察處置等使。以北面行營副招討使、匡國軍節度、陳許蔡等州觀察處置等使、光祿大夫、檢校太傅王彥章為宣義軍節度副大使，知節度事，鄭、滑、濮等州觀察處置等使，依前北面副招討使。

context.beforeSource: 至是，發禁軍及數郡兵合勢追擊，賊潰，生擒毋乙等首領八十餘人，械送闕下，並斬於都市。
context.afterSource: 二月己未，以權知靜勝軍節度觀察留後、前汝州防禦使華溫琪為靜勝軍節度觀察留後，依前檢校太傅。
context.beforeLocal: 至是，發禁軍及數郡兵合勢追擊，賊潰，生擒毋乙等首領八十餘人，械送闕下，並斬於都市。
context.afterLocal: 二月己未，以權知靜勝軍節度觀察留後、前汝州防禦使華溫琪為靜勝軍節度觀察留後，依前檢校太傅。

manualTranslations.zh: 龍德元年春正月癸巳，詔諸道入奏判官，宜令御史台點檢，合從正衙退後，便於中書門下公參辭謝。
manualTranslations.literal: On guisi in the first month of spring of Longde 1, an edict ordered that memorial-report adjudicators from all circuits should be inspected by the Censorate; after withdrawing from the main court audience they should pay public respects and offer thanks at the Secretariat and Chancellery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On guisi in the first month of Longde 1 an edict required the Censorate to inspect circuit memorial adjudicators, who after main court audience should offer respects at the Secretariat and Chancellery.

manualTranslations.zh: 如有違越，具名銜聞奏。
manualTranslations.literal: If there were violations, report them by name in memorial.

sourceRange.text: 長子麓，位至列卿。次子霖，改名岩，尚太祖女長樂公主。開平初，授衛尉卿、駙馬都尉。二年九月，權知洺州軍州事，俄轉天威軍使。十二月，授右羽林統軍，改右衛上將軍，充大內皇牆使。三年七月，出為宿州團練使，旋移州刺史。其後累曆近職，連典禁軍。預誅庶人友珪有功，末帝即位，用為租庸使、守戶部尚書。岩以勳戚自負，貨賂公行，天下之賄，半入其門。又以身尚公主，聞唐朝駙馬都尉杜悰位極將相，以服禦飲饌自奉，務極華侈，岩恥其不及。由是豐其飲膳，嘉羞法饌，動費萬錢，僦斂網商，其徒如市，權勢熏灼，人皆阿附。及唐莊宗滅梁室，岩逾垣而逸。素與徐州溫韜相善，岩往依之。既至，韜斬岩首送京師。

context.afterLocal: 昶，字大東，犨仲弟也。

manualTranslations.zh: 長子麓，位至列卿。
manualTranslations.literal: The eldest son Lu reached the rank of chief minister.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Eldest son Lu rose to chief minister rank.

manualTranslations.zh: 次子霖，改名岩，尚太祖女長樂公主。
manualTranslations.literal: The second son Lin changed his name to Yan and married the Founder's daughter Princess Changle.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Second son Lin, renamed Yan, married Princess Changle.

manualTranslations.zh: 開平初，授衛尉卿、駙馬都尉。
manualTranslations.literal: At the start of Kaiping he was appointed Minister of the Guards and Chief Commandant for Consorts of the Emperor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Kaiping he became Minister of the Guards and imperial son-in-law.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年九月，權知洺州軍州事，俄轉天威軍使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month of year 2 he was acting military and civil commissioner of Ming prefecture; soon he was transferred to commander of the Tianwei Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Month 9, year 2, he acted at Ming prefecture, then became Tianwei Army commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月，授右羽林統軍，改右衛上將軍，充大內皇牆使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month he was made commander of the Right Forest of Feathers Army, then Right Guard senior general, and commissioner of the inner imperial wall.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Month 12 he took the Right Forest command, then Right Guard senior general and inner wall commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年七月，出為宿州團練使，旋移州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh month of year 3 he went out as regimental commissioner of Su prefecture; soon he was prefect of Yi prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Month 7, year 3, he governed Su prefecture, then Yi prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 其後累曆近職，連典禁軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Afterward he repeatedly held nearby offices and successively commanded the palace guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then held court posts and repeatedly commanded the palace guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 預誅庶人友珪有功，末帝即位，用為租庸使、守戶部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: Having taken part in executing the deposed ruler Yougui, when the Last Emperor ascended he was used as grain-and-tax commissioner and acting Minister of Revenue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For helping kill the deposed ruler Yougui, the Last Emperor made him grain commissioner and acting Minister of Revenue.

manualTranslations.zh: 岩以勳戚自負，貨賂公行，天下之賄，半入其門。
manualTranslations.literal: Yan, relying on merit kinship, was proud; bribes flowed openly and half the empire's gifts entered his gate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Proud of his merit ties, Yan took bribes openly—half the realm's gifts reached his door.

manualTranslations.zh: 又以身尚公主，聞唐朝駙馬都尉杜悰位極將相，以服禦飲饌自奉，務極華侈，岩恥其不及。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, as husband to a princess, he heard that Tang Chief Commandant for Consorts Du Cong had reached the summit of general and minister, supplying himself with imperial dress and fare in utmost luxury; Yan was shamed that he did not match it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As a princess's husband he heard Tang son-in-law Du Cong lived in imperial luxury to the rank of chief minister and was ashamed to fall short.

manualTranslations.zh: 由是豐其飲膳，嘉羞法饌，動費萬錢，僦斂網商，其徒如市，權勢熏灼，人皆阿附。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore he enriched his food and drink, delicacies and ritual fare costing ten thousand cash at a move; he rented stalls and netted merchants until his followers were like a market; power scorched and all men fawned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He lavished feasts costing ten thousand cash, taxed merchants, drew crowds like a market, and everyone fawned on his power.

manualTranslations.zh: 及唐莊宗滅梁室，岩逾垣而逸。
manualTranslations.literal: When Tang Zhuangzong destroyed the Liang house, Yan climbed a wall and fled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong destroyed Liang, Yan fled over a wall.

manualTranslations.zh: 素與徐州溫韜相善，岩往依之。
manualTranslations.literal: He had long been friendly with Xuzhou's Wen Tao; Yan went to rely on him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He fled to his old friend Wen Tao at Xuzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 既至，韜斬岩首送京師。
manualTranslations.literal: When he arrived, Tao beheaded Yan and sent his head to the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wen Tao beheaded him and sent his head to the capital.

sourceRange.text: 五年八月，除犨為蔡州節度使。於時巢黨雖敗，宗權益熾，六七年間，屠膾中原，陷二十餘郡，惟陳去蔡百餘里，兵少力微，日與爭鋒，終不能屈。文德元年，蔡州平，朝廷議勳，以犨檢校司徒，充泰寧軍節度使，又改授浙西節度使，不離宛丘，兼領二鎮。龍紀元年三月，又以平巢、蔡功，就加平章事，充忠武軍節度使，仍以陳州為理所。由是中原塵靜，唐帝復歸長安，陳、許流亡之民，繈負歸業，犨設法招撫，人皆感之。犨兄弟三人，時稱雍睦。一日，念仲弟昶同心王事，共立軍功，乃下令盡以軍州事付於昶，遂上表乞骸。後數月，寢疾，卒於陳州官舍，年六十六；葬於宛丘縣之先域，累贈大尉。

context.beforeSource: 獻捷於行在。
context.afterSource: 犨雖盡忠唐室，保全陳州，然默識太祖雄傑，每降心托跡，為子孫之計，故因解圍之後，以愛子結親。

manualTranslations.zh: 五年八月，除犨為蔡州節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month of year 5 Chou was made military commissioner of Cai prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Month 8, year 5, Chou became Cai military commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 於時巢黨雖敗，宗權益熾，六七年間，屠膾中原，陷二十餘郡，惟陳去蔡百餘里，兵少力微，日與爭鋒，終不能屈。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time though Chao's party was defeated, Zongquan grew fiercer; in six or seven years he butchered the Central Plain and took more than twenty prefectures; only Chen lay a hundred-odd li from Cai, few in troops and slight in strength, yet daily contending at the front and in the end could not be broken.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Though Chao had fallen, Zongquan ravaged the heartland for years; Chen, a hundred li from Cai and weak, fought daily and would not yield.

manualTranslations.zh: 文德元年，蔡州平，朝廷議勳，以犨檢校司徒，充泰寧軍節度使，又改授浙西節度使，不離宛丘，兼領二鎮。
manualTranslations.literal: In Wende year 1 Cai prefecture was pacified; the court discussed merit and made Chou honorary Minister of Works and Taining military commissioner, then reassigned him Zhexi military commissioner without leaving Wankiu, holding both commands.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wende 1 Cai fell; the court made Chou honorary Minister of Works, Taining commissioner, then Zhexi commissioner while remaining at Wankiu.

manualTranslations.zh: 龍紀元年三月，又以平巢、蔡功，就加平章事，充忠武軍節度使，仍以陳州為理所。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month of Longji year 1, again for pacifying Chao and Cai, he was at once made co-equal chief minister and Zhongwu military commissioner, still taking Chen as seat of government.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Longji 1, month 3, for pacifying Chao and Cai he became chief minister and Zhongwu commissioner with Chen as capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 由是中原塵靜，唐帝復歸長安，陳、許流亡之民，繈負歸業，犨設法招撫，人皆感之。
manualTranslations.literal: From this the Central Plain grew calm and dust settled; the Tang emperor returned to Chang'an; Chen and Xu refugees came back carrying children on their backs; Chou devised methods to recruit and soothe, and all were moved.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The heartland calmed, the Tang emperor returned to Chang'an, and refugees of Chen and Xu came home; Chou won them with generous resettlement.

manualTranslations.zh: 犨兄弟三人，時稱雍睦。
manualTranslations.literal: Chou's three brothers were at the time called harmonious and close.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chou and his two brothers were famed for harmony.

manualTranslations.zh: 一日，念仲弟昶同心王事，共立軍功，乃下令盡以軍州事付於昶，遂上表乞骸。
manualTranslations.literal: One day, mindful that his second brother Chang shared his heart in royal service and together they had built military merit, he ordered that all army and prefecture affairs be given to Chang and then memorialized begging to retire.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: One day he gave all military and civil affairs to Chang and memorialized to retire.

manualTranslations.zh: 後數月，寢疾，卒於陳州官舍，年六十六；
manualTranslations.literal: Months later he fell ill in bed and died in the Chen prefecture government quarters at age sixty-six;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Months later he fell ill and died at the Chen government house at sixty-six;

manualTranslations.zh: 葬於宛丘縣之先域，累贈大尉。
manualTranslations.literal: He was buried in the ancestral ground of Wankiu county and repeatedly posthumously made Grand Marshal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was buried at Wankiu and posthumously made Grand Marshal.

sourceRange.text: 張慎思，清河人。自黃巢軍來歸，累授軍職，曆諸軍都指揮使。從平巢、蔡、兗、鄆，皆著功，表授檢校工部尚書，兼宋州長史。光化中，加檢校右僕射，權知亳州。天復三年，昭宗還長安，以從太祖迎駕功，賜號迎鑾毅勇功臣，尋除汝州防禦使。天祐元年，授左龍武統軍。其冬，除許州匡國軍節度使。明年十一月，權知徐州武寧軍兩使留後。太祖受禪，入為左金吾大將軍。開平二年，除宋州刺史，未幾，復拜左金吾大將軍。三年冬，除蔡州刺史，以貪貨大失民情，詔追赴闕。未幾，扈從北征還，以疾臥洛陽之私第。馭家不肅，為其子所弒。

manualTranslations.zh: 張慎思，清河人。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhang Shensi was a Qinghe man.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhang Shensi came from Qinghe.

manualTranslations.zh: 自黃巢軍來歸，累授軍職，曆諸軍都指揮使。
manualTranslations.literal: Returning from Huang Chao's army, he successively received military posts and served as overall commander of various armies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Defecting from Huang Chao, he rose through commands to overall army commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 從平巢、蔡、兗、鄆，皆著功，表授檢校工部尚書，兼宋州長史。
manualTranslations.literal: Following the pacification of Chao, Cai, Yan, and Yun, he distinguished himself in merit and was memorialized as honorary Minister of Works and concurrent Song prefecture chief secretary.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He distinguished himself pacifying Chao, Cai, Yan, and Yun and became honorary Minister of Works and Song chief secretary.

manualTranslations.zh: 光化中，加檢校右僕射，權知亳州。
manualTranslations.literal: In Guanghua he was made honorary Right Vice Director and provisional Bo prefecture military commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Guanghua he became honorary Right Vice Director and acting Bo commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 天復三年，昭宗還長安，以從太祖迎駕功，賜號迎鑾毅勇功臣，尋除汝州防禦使。
manualTranslations.literal: Tianfu year 3, when Zhaozong returned to Chang'an, for merit in following the Founder to welcome the imperial carriage he was granted the title Welcome-the-Carriage, Resolute-and-Brave Merit Minister; soon he was made Ruzhou defense commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tianfu 3, for welcoming the emperor with the Founder, he received the title Welcome-the-Carriage Merit Minister and became Ruzhou commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 天祐元年，授左龍武統軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianyou year 1 he was appointed Left Dragon Martial army commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tianyou 1 he became Left Dragon Martial commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 其冬，除許州匡國軍節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: That winter he was made Xu prefecture Kuangguo military commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That winter he became Xu Kuangguo commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年十一月，權知徐州武寧軍兩使留後。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month of the next year he was provisional acting commissioner of Xuzhou Wuning military commission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Next year, month 11, he acted as Xuzhou Wuning commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖受禪，入為左金吾大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Founder received the abdication he entered as Left Golden Guard great general.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the abdication he entered as Left Golden Guard great general.

manualTranslations.zh: 開平二年，除宋州刺史，未幾，復拜左金吾大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Kaiping year 2 he was made Song prefecture military commissioner; soon he was again appointed Left Golden Guard great general.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kaiping 2 he governed Song, then again became Left Golden Guard great general.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年冬，除蔡州刺史，以貪貨大失民情，詔追赴闕。
manualTranslations.literal: Winter of year 3 he was made Cai prefecture military commissioner; for greedy seizure of goods he greatly lost the people's hearts and an edict recalled him to court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Winter, year 3, as Cai commissioner greed cost him popular support and he was recalled.

manualTranslations.zh: 未幾，扈從北征還，以疾臥洛陽之私第。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon, returning from escorting the northern campaign, he lay ill in a private residence at Luoyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon after returning from the northern campaign he fell ill at his Luoyang home.

manualTranslations.zh: 馭家不肅，為其子所弒。
manualTranslations.literal: He did not keep his household in order and was murdered by his son.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His household discipline failed and his son murdered him.

sourceRange.text: 四年二月，有詣建告睦王已下八王謀殺建，建囚八王於別宅，放散隨駕殿後軍二萬人，殺捧日都頭李筠。自是天子益微，宿衛之士盡矣。八月，建以兵圍十六宅，通王以下十一王並遇害於石堤穀，以謀逆聞。又害太子詹事馬道殷、將作監許岩士，貶宰相朱樸，皆昭宗寵昵者也。建尋兼同州節度使。光化元年，升華州為興德府，以建為尹。八月，車駕還京。九月，冊拜太傅，進封許國公，並賜鐵券。

manualTranslations.zh: 四年二月，有詣建告睦王已下八王謀殺建，建囚八王於別宅，放散隨駕殿後軍二萬人，殺捧日都頭李筠。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year, someone came to Jian reporting that Prince Mu and eight other princes below him plotted to kill Jian; Jian imprisoned the eight princes in a separate residence, discharged the twenty thousand rear palace-guard troops accompanying the emperor, and killed Pengri column chief Li Yun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In month 2 of the fourth year someone accused eight princes including Prince Mu of plotting against Jian; he imprisoned them, dismissed twenty thousand rear guards, and killed Pengri chief Li Yun.

manualTranslations.zh: 自是天子益微，宿衛之士盡矣。
manualTranslations.literal: From this the Son of Heaven grew ever weaker and the palace guards were gone.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor grew weaker still and lost his guards.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月，建以兵圍十六宅，通王以下十一王並遇害於石堤穀，以謀逆聞。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month Jian surrounded the Sixteen Residences with troops; Prince Tong and eleven other princes below him were all killed at Shidi Valley, reported as a treason plot.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Month 8 he besieged the Sixteen Residences; Prince Tong and ten other princes were killed at Shidi Valley as alleged traitors.

manualTranslations.zh: 又害太子詹事馬道殷、將作監許岩士，貶宰相朱樸，皆昭宗寵昵者也。
manualTranslations.literal: He also killed Crown Prince Administrator Ma Daoyin and Construction Commissioner Xu Yanshi, and demoted Chief Minister Zhu Pu—all men Zhaozong favored.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also killed Ma Daoyin and Xu Yanshi and demoted Zhu Pu, all Zhaozong favorites.

manualTranslations.zh: 建尋兼同州節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian soon added concurrent Tongzhou military commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian soon added Tongzhou commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 光化元年，升華州為興德府，以建為尹。
manualTranslations.literal: Guanghua year 1, Hua prefecture was elevated to Xingde Prefecture and Jian was made its intendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guanghua 1 elevated Hua to Xingde Prefecture and made Jian its intendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月，車駕還京。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month the imperial carriage returned to the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Month 8 the emperor returned to the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月，冊拜太傅，進封許國公，並賜鐵券。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month he was enfeoffed Grand Tutor, advanced to Duke of Xu, and granted an iron certificate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Month 9 he became Grand Tutor, Duke of Xu, and received an iron certificate.

sourceRange.text: 及太祖義旗西征，行襲遣副使魯崇矩稟受制令。會唐昭宗幸鳳翔，太祖帥師奉迎，久之未出。中尉韓全誨遣中官郤文晏等二十餘人分命矯詔，欲征江、淮兵屯於金州，以脅太祖之軍，行襲定策盡殺之，收其詔敕送於太祖。天祐元年，兼領洋州節度使。太祖之伐荊、襄，行襲令其子勖以舟師會於均、房，預收復功，遷匡國軍節度使。到任，誅大吏張澄，暴其罪，州人莫不惴懾。在許三年，上供外，別進助軍羨糧二十萬石。及太祖郊禋，行襲請入覲，貢獻巨萬，恩禮殊厚。尋詔翰林學士杜曉撰德政碑以賜之，累官至兼中書令，冊拜司空。開平中卒，輟朝一日，贈太傅，諡曰忠敬。

manualTranslations.zh: 及太祖義旗西征，行襲遣副使魯崇矩稟受制令。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Founder raised his righteous banner west, Xingxi sent deputy Lu Chongju to receive controlled orders.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Founder marched west, Xingxi sent deputy Lu Chongju for orders.

manualTranslations.zh: 會唐昭宗幸鳳翔，太祖帥師奉迎，久之未出。
manualTranslations.literal: When Tang Zhaozong went to Fengxiang, the Founder led troops to welcome him but after long time did not come out.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhaozong went to Fengxiang the Founder marched to meet him but lingered outside.

manualTranslations.zh: 中尉韓全誨遣中官郤文晏等二十餘人分命矯詔，欲征江、淮兵屯於金州，以脅太祖之軍，行襲定策盡殺之，收其詔敕送於太祖。
manualTranslations.literal: Army Rong Commissioner Han Quanhui sent inner officials Xi Wenyan and more than twenty others with divided forged edicts, wishing to levy Jiang and Huai troops to camp at Jin prefecture and coerce the Founder's army; Xingxi decided on a plan and killed them all, collected their edicts and sent them to the Founder.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Han Quanhui sent Xi Wenyan and twenty eunuchs with forged orders to raise Jiang-Huai troops at Jin and threaten the Founder; Xingxi killed them and sent the edicts to the Founder.

manualTranslations.zh: 天祐元年，兼領洋州節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianyou year 1 he added concurrent Yangzhou military commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tianyou 1 he added Yangzhou commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖之伐荊、襄，行襲令其子勖以舟師會於均、房，預收復功，遷匡國軍節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Founder attacked Jing and Xiang, Xingxi ordered his son Xu with river forces to join at Jun and Fang, sharing in the recovery merit; he was moved to Kuangguo military commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the Jing-Xiang campaign Xingxi sent son Xu by river to Jun and Fang; rewarded, he became Kuangguo commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 到任，誅大吏張澄，暴其罪，州人莫不惴懾。
manualTranslations.literal: On reaching his post he executed senior clerk Zhang Cheng, exposed his crimes, and the prefecture people were all fearful.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taking office he executed clerk Zhang Cheng and terrified the prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 在許三年，上供外，別進助軍羨糧二十萬石。
manualTranslations.literal: At Xu for three years, beyond tribute he separately presented two hundred thousand piculs of surplus grain to aid the army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For three years at Xu he sent two hundred thousand piculs of extra grain beyond tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 及太祖郊禋，行襲請入覲，貢獻巨萬，恩禮殊厚。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Founder performed suburban sacrifice, Xingxi asked to enter court audience, presented gifts worth tens of thousands, and favor and courtesy were exceptionally thick.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the suburban rites Xingxi came to court with lavish gifts and exceptional honor.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋詔翰林學士杜曉撰德政碑以賜之，累官至兼中書令，冊拜司空。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon an edict ordered Hanlin academician Du Xiao to compose a merit stele to bestow on him; he rose through offices to concurrent Chief Minister of the Secretariat and was enfeoffed Grand Marshal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Du Xiao wrote his merit stele; he rose to concurrent chief minister and Grand Marshal.

manualTranslations.zh: 開平中卒，輟朝一日，贈太傅，諡曰忠敬。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in Kaiping; court mourning ceased one day; he was posthumously made Grand Tutor with posthumous title Loyal and Respectful.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in Kaiping; mourning paused one day; posthumously Grand Tutor, loyal and respectful.

sourceRange.text: ，河陽人也。

localRange.text: 趙克裕，河陽人也。

context.beforeSource: 惟德昭克全終始，有所稱雲。
context.afterSource: 祖、父皆為軍吏。

manualTranslations.zh: 光化元年十二月，晉之潞帥薛誌勤卒，罕之乘其喪，自澤州率眾徑入潞州，自稱留後，以狀聞於克用曰：「聞誌勤之喪，新帥未至，慮為他盜所窺，不俟命，已屯於潞矣。」
manualTranslations.literal: Guanghua year 1, twelfth month, Jin's Lu commander Xue Zhiqin died; Hanzhi seized the mourning interval, led his forces from Ze prefecture straight into Lu prefecture, declared himself acting commissioner, and reported to Keyong: "Hearing of Zhiqin's death, the new commander has not arrived; fearing other bandits may spy, without awaiting orders I have already encamped at Lu."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guanghua 1, month 12, after Xue Zhiqin died as Lu commander, Hanzhi marched from Ze into Lu, declared himself commissioner, and told Keyong, "With Zhiqin dead and no successor yet, I feared raiders and garrisoned Lu without orders."

manualTranslations.zh: 克用怒，遣李昭嗣討之，罕之執其守將馬溉、伊鐸、何萬友，沁州刺史傅瑤等，遣其子顥拘送於太祖以求援焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Keyong was angry and sent Li Zhaosi to attack him; Hanzhi seized the garrison commanders Ma Gai, Yi Duo, He Wanyou, Qin prefecture commissioner Fu Yao, and the rest, and sent his son Hao bound to the Founder to beg for aid.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Keyong sent Li Zhaosi against him; Hanzhi seized Ma Gai, Yi Duo, He Wanyou, Fu Yao, and others and sent his son Hao to the Founder for help.

manualTranslations.zh: （《新唐書》：全忠表罕之昭義軍節度使。）
manualTranslations.literal: (The 《New Book of Tang》: Quanzhong memorialized Hanzhi as Zhaoyi military commissioner.)
manualTranslations.idiomatic: (The 《New Book of Tang》 says Quanzhong made Hanzhi Zhaoyi commissioner.)

manualTranslations.zh: 會罕之暴病，不能視事。
manualTranslations.literal: When Hanzhi suddenly fell ill he could not handle affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hanzhi then fell suddenly ill and could not govern.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年六月，病篤，太祖令丁會代之，移罕之為河陽節度使；
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month of the next year, gravely ill, the Founder had Ding Hui replace him and moved Hanzhi to Heyang military commissioner;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Next year, month 6, the Founder replaced him with Ding Hui and made Hanzhi Heyang commissioner;

manualTranslations.zh: 行至懷州，卒於傳舍，時年五十八。
manualTranslations.literal: reaching Huai prefecture he died at the relay station at age fifty-eight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: he died at a relay station in Huai at fifty-eight.

manualTranslations.zh: 其子顥以舟載柩，歸葬河陰縣。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Hao carried the coffin by boat and buried him in Heyin county.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Son Hao brought the coffin by boat to bury him in Heyin.

manualTranslations.zh: 開平二年春，詔贈中書令。
manualTranslations.literal: In the spring of Kaiping year 2 an edict posthumously made him Chief Minister of the Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kaiping 2 spring he was posthumously named Chief Minister.

items.acceptedSourceText: 光化元年十二月，晉之潞帥薛誌勤卒，罕之乘其喪，自澤州率眾徑入潞州，自稱留後，以狀聞於克用曰：「聞誌勤之喪，新帥未至，慮為他盜所窺，不俟命，已屯於潞矣。」克用怒，遣李昭嗣討之，罕之執其守將馬溉、伊鐸、何萬友，沁州刺史傅瑤等，遣其子顥拘送於太祖以求援焉。（《新唐書》：全忠表罕之昭義軍節度使。）會罕之暴病，不能視事。明年六月，病篤，太祖令丁會代之，移罕之為河陽節度使；行至懷州，卒於傳舍，時年五十八。其子顥以舟載柩，歸葬河陰縣。開平二年春，詔贈中書令。

sourceRange.text: 天復元年三月，與氏叔琮討太原，從周以兗、鄆之眾，自土門路入，與諸軍會於晉陽城下，以糧運不給，班師。頃之，從周染疾，會青州將劉鄩陷兗州，太祖命討之，遂力疾臨戎。三年十一月，鄩舉城降，以功授檢校太傅。太祖以從周抱疾既久，命康懷英代之，授左金吾上將軍，以風恙不任朝謁，改右衛上將軍致仕。養疾偃師縣亳邑鄉之別墅。頃之，授太子太師，依前致仕。末帝即位，製授潞州節度使，令坐食其俸，加開府儀同三司、檢校太師、兼侍中，封陳留郡王，累食邑至七千戶，命近臣賚旌節就別墅以賜之。貞明初，卒於家。冊贈太尉。

context.beforeSource: 從周追襲至青山口，斬首五千級，獲其將王郃郎、楊師悅等，得馬千匹，表授檢校太保，兼徐州兩使留後，尋為兗州節度使。
context.afterSource: 謝彥章，許州人。

manualTranslations.zh: 天復元年三月，與氏叔琮討太原，從周以兗、鄆之眾，自土門路入，與諸軍會於晉陽城下，以糧運不給，班師。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month of Tianfu year 1, with Shi Shuzong he campaigned against Taiyuan; Congzhou led the Yan and Yun forces in by the Tumen route, joined the armies beneath Jinyang, and withdrew when grain transport failed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tianfu 1, month 3, with Shi Shuzong he marched on Taiyuan; Congzhou led the Yan and Yun forces in by the Tumen route, joined the armies below Jinyang, and withdrew when supplies failed.

manualTranslations.zh: 頃之，從周染疾，會青州將劉鄩陷兗州，太祖命討之，遂力疾臨戎。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon after Congzhou fell ill; when Qingzhou general Liu Xun took Yanzhou, the Founder ordered him to attack and he took the field despite illness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon after he fell ill; when Liu Xun of Qingzhou took Yanzhou, the Founder ordered him to attack and he took the field despite illness.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年十一月，鄩舉城降，以功授檢校太傅。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month of year 3, Xun surrendered the city; for merit he was made honorary Grand Tutor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Month 11, Tianfu 3, Xun surrendered the city and Congzhou was made honorary Grand Tutor for the merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖以從周抱疾既久，命康懷英代之，授左金吾上將軍，以風恙不任朝謁，改右衛上將軍致仕。
manualTranslations.literal: The Founder, since Congzhou's illness had long lingered, ordered Kang Huaiying to replace him and made Congzhou General of the Left Golden Crow Guards; because wind ailment prevented court attendance, he was changed to General of the Right Guard and retired.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Founder, since Congzhou's illness had long lingered, had Kang Huaiying replace him and made Congzhou Left Golden Crow general; wind ailment kept him from court, so he was changed to Right Guard general and retired.

manualTranslations.zh: 養疾偃師縣亳邑鄉之別墅。
manualTranslations.literal: He nursed his illness at a villa in Boyi township, Yanshi county.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He nursed his illness at a villa in Boyi township, Yanshi county.

manualTranslations.zh: 頃之，授太子太師，依前致仕。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon after he was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, still retired as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon after he was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, still retired as before.

manualTranslations.zh: 末帝即位，製授潞州節度使，令坐食其俸，加開府儀同三司、檢校太師、兼侍中，封陳留郡王，累食邑至七千戶，命近臣賚旌節就別墅以賜之。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Last Emperor came to the throne, an edict appointed him military commissioner of Lu with seated salary, added Bearer of the Golden Pocket with Honored Equal to the Three Dukes, honorary Grand Preceptor, and concurrent Palace Secretary, enfeoffed him as Prince of Chenliu commandery with cumulative food domain to seven thousand households, and ordered a close official to bring banners and credentials to his villa as gifts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Last Emperor came to the throne, an edict made him Lu commissioner with seated salary, added the Golden Pocket and Honored Equal to the Three Dukes, honorary Grand Preceptor, and Palace Secretary, enfeoffed him as Prince of Chenliu with a fief reaching seven thousand households, and sent a close official with banners and credentials to his villa.

manualTranslations.zh: 貞明初，卒於家。
manualTranslations.literal: Early in Zhenming he died at home.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Zhenming he died at home.

manualTranslations.zh: 冊贈太尉。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Marshal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Marshal.

sourceRange.text: 李重胤，宋州下邑人。狀貌雄武，初在黃巢黨中，推為剛鷙。唐中和四年五月，同尚讓、李讜等率眾至繁台，與太祖之軍相拒。及巢寇漸衰，乃率眾來降。太祖素識之，拔用不次，署為先鋒步軍都頭。與胡真援河陽，逼懷州。重胤以部下兵突之，射中蕃將安休休。又令與李讜率騎軍至陝，應接郭言，回次澠池，破賊帥黃花子之眾，改滑州夾馬指揮使。蔡賊圍汴，重胤以步兵攻下三寨，擄獲甚多。太祖大舉伐宗權，俾重胤以滑兵為先鋒。及東討徐州，下豐、蕭二邑，轉右廂馬步軍指揮使。大順元年秋，從郴王友裕收澤州，與晉軍戰於馬牢川，王師敗績，回守河陽。太祖謂諸將曰：「李讜、重胤違我節度，不能立功，頗辜任使。」於是與李讜並戮於河橋。範居實，絳州翼城人。事太祖，初為隊將，從討巢、蔡有功。又從朱珍收滑州，改左廂都虞候。預破兗、鄆功。遷感義都頭、鄭州馬軍指揮使。幽州劉仁恭舉眾南下，寇魏郡北，居實與葛從周、張存敬率兵救魏，大破幽、滄之眾於內黃。太祖迎昭宗於岐下，以居實為河中馬軍都指揮使。及昭宗還京，賜迎鑾毅勇功臣，遙領錦州刺史，又遷左龍驤馬軍都指揮使。從征淮南回，改登州刺史，轉左神勇軍使。開平元年，用軍於潞州，命居實統軍以解澤州之圍。授耀州刺史，令以郡兵屯固鎮，尋除澤州刺史。居實拳勇善戰，頗立軍功，在郡以戎備不理，詔追赴闕，暴其玩寇之罪而斬之。

context.beforeSource: 太祖遣追還，廷責其罪，戮之於河橋。
context.afterSource: 史臣曰：叔琮而下，咸以鷹犬之才，適遇雲龍之會，勤勞王室，踐履將壇，然俱不得其死，豈不惜哉！
context.beforeLocal: 太祖遣追還，廷責其罪，戮之於河橋。

manualTranslations.zh: 李重胤，宋州下邑人。
manualTranslations.literal: Li Chongyin was a native of Xiayi in Songzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li Chongyin came from Xiayi in Songzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 狀貌雄武，初在黃巢黨中，推為剛鷙。
manualTranslations.literal: In bearing he was bold and martial; at first among Huang Chao's party he was acclaimed as fierce and harsh.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Bold and martial in bearing, he was first acclaimed among Huang Chao's followers as fierce and harsh.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐中和四年五月，同尚讓、李讜等率眾至繁台，與太祖之軍相拒。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month of Zhonghe 4 of Tang, together with Shang Rang, Li Dang, and others he led masses to Fantai and faced the Founder's army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Zhonghe 4 he joined Shang Rang, Li Dang, and others at Fantai to face the Founder's army.

manualTranslations.zh: 及巢寇漸衰，乃率眾來降。
manualTranslations.literal: When Chao's bandits gradually declined, he then led the masses to surrender.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As Chao's cause waned, he led his men to surrender.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖素識之，拔用不次，署為先鋒步軍都頭。
manualTranslations.literal: The Founder had long known him and raised him out of turn, appointing him vanguard infantry commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Founder already knew him and promoted him out of turn, making him vanguard infantry commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 與胡真援河陽，逼懷州。
manualTranslations.literal: With He Zhen he relieved Heyang and pressed Huai prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With He Zhen he relieved Heyang and pressed Huai prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 重胤以部下兵突之，射中蕃將安休休。
manualTranslations.literal: Chongyin with his command's troops charged them and shot the foreign general An Xiuxiu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chongyin charged with his own troops and shot the foreign general An Xiuxiu.

manualTranslations.zh: 又令與李讜率騎軍至陝，應接郭言，回次澠池，破賊帥黃花子之眾，改滑州夾馬指揮使。
manualTranslations.literal: He was again ordered with Li Dang to lead cavalry to Shan to link with Guo Yan; returning he halted at Mianchi and broke the band of the rebel chief Huang Huazi; he was changed to Huazhou Jiamma commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was again ordered with Li Dang to lead cavalry to Shan to link with Guo Yan; on the return march he stopped at Mianchi and broke the band of the rebel chief Huang Huazi, then became Jiamma commander at Huazhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 蔡賊圍汴，重胤以步兵攻下三寨，擄獲甚多。
manualTranslations.literal: When Cai bandits besieged Bian, Chongyin with infantry stormed three camps and captured very many.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Cai rebels besieged Bian, Chongyin's infantry took three camps and captured many prisoners.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖大舉伐宗權，俾重胤以滑兵為先鋒。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Founder launched a great campaign against Zongquan, he had Chongyin lead the Huazhou troops as vanguard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Founder launched a major campaign against Zongquan, he put Chongyin and the Huazhou troops in the vanguard.

manualTranslations.zh: 及東討徐州，下豐、蕭二邑，轉右廂馬步軍指揮使。
manualTranslations.literal: When he campaigned east against Xuzhou and took the districts of Feng and Xiao, he was transferred to Right Wing horse-and-foot commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eastern campaign against Xuzhou he took Feng and Xiao and was made commander of the Right Wing horse-and-foot corps.

manualTranslations.zh: 大順元年秋，從郴王友裕收澤州，與晉軍戰於馬牢川，王師敗績，回守河陽。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn of Dashun 1 he followed Prince of Chen Youyu in recovering Zezhou; the imperial army fought Jin forces at Malao River, was defeated, and withdrew to hold Heyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn of Dashun 1 he followed Prince of Chen Youyu to recover Zezhou; at Malao River the imperial army was beaten by the Jin and fell back to Heyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖謂諸將曰：「李讜、重胤違我節度，不能立功，頗辜任使。」
manualTranslations.literal: The Founder told the generals: "Li Dang and Chongyin violated my command and could not establish merit—they have quite betrayed the trust placed in them."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Founder told his generals: "Li Dang and Chongyin disobeyed my orders and won no merit—they have badly failed the trust I placed in them."

manualTranslations.zh: 於是與李讜並戮於河橋。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon he and Li Dang were together executed at He Bridge.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He and Li Dang were then executed together at He Bridge.

manualTranslations.zh: 範居實，絳州翼城人。
manualTranslations.literal: Fan Jushi was a native of Yicheng in Jiangzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fan Jushi came from Yicheng in Jiangzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 事太祖，初為隊將，從討巢、蔡有功。
manualTranslations.literal: Serving the Founder, at first he was a squad commander; following campaigns against Chao and Cai he had merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Serving the Founder, he began as a squad commander and won merit in the campaigns against Chao and Cai.

manualTranslations.zh: 又從朱珍收滑州，改左廂都虞候。
manualTranslations.literal: He again followed Zhu Zhen in recovering Huazhou and was changed to Left Wing chief adjutant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed Zhu Zhen in recovering Huazhou and was made Left Wing chief adjutant.

manualTranslations.zh: 預破兗、鄆功。
manualTranslations.literal: He shared in the merit of breaking Yan and Yun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He shared in the victories over Yan and Yun.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷感義都頭、鄭州馬軍指揮使。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to Ganyi squad chief and Zhengzhou cavalry commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He became Ganyi squad chief and cavalry commander at Zhengzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 幽州劉仁恭舉眾南下，寇魏郡北，居實與葛從周、張存敬率兵救魏，大破幽、滄之眾於內黃。
manualTranslations.literal: When Youzhou's Liu Rengong raised masses and marched south, raiding north of Wei commandery, Jushi with Ge Congzhou and Zhang Cunjing led troops to rescue Wei and greatly defeated the You and Cang forces at Neihuang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Liu Rengong of Youzhou marched south and raided north of Wei, Jushi joined Ge Congzhou and Zhang Cunjing to relieve Wei and routed the You and Cang armies at Neihuang.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖迎昭宗於岐下，以居實為河中馬軍都指揮使。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Founder welcomed Zhaozong at Qixia, he made Jushi Hezhong cavalry commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Founder welcomed Zhaozong at Qixia, he made Jushi cavalry commander of Hezhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 及昭宗還京，賜迎鑾毅勇功臣，遙領錦州刺史，又遷左龍驤馬軍都指揮使。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhaozong returned to the capital, he was granted the title Resolute and Brave Merit Lord of the Imperial Welcome, held Jing prefecture in absentia, and was again transferred to Left Dragon Flying cavalry commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhaozong returned to the capital, he received the title Resolute and Brave Merit Lord of the Imperial Welcome, held Jing prefecture in absentia, and was made Left Dragon Flying cavalry commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 從征淮南回，改登州刺史，轉左神勇軍使。
manualTranslations.literal: Returning from the Huainan campaign, he was changed to Dengzhou prefect and transferred to Left Divine Valor commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the Huainan campaign he became prefect of Dengzhou and then commissioner of the Left Divine Valor Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 開平元年，用軍於潞州，命居實統軍以解澤州之圍。
manualTranslations.literal: In Kaiping 1, when troops were deployed at Luzhou, Jushi was ordered to command an army to lift the siege of Zezhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Kaiping 1, when troops were deployed at Luzhou, he was ordered to command an army to lift the siege of Zezhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 授耀州刺史，令以郡兵屯固鎮，尋除澤州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He was appointed Yaozhou prefect and ordered to station the prefecture's troops at Guzhen; soon he was removed to Zezhou prefect.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was made prefect of Yaozhou and ordered to station his troops at Guzhen; soon he was transferred to prefect of Zezhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 居實拳勇善戰，頗立軍功，在郡以戎備不理，詔追赴闕，暴其玩寇之罪而斬之。
manualTranslations.literal: Jushi was fierce in fist and brave in battle and considerably established military merit; in the prefecture he neglected military readiness; an edict recalled him to court, exposed his crime of treating the enemy lightly, and executed him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jushi was a fierce fighter who won solid merit, but as prefect he neglected defense; recalled to court, he was condemned for treating the enemy lightly and executed.

sourceRange.text: 胡規，兗州人。初事朱瑾為中軍都校。兗州平，署為宣武軍都虞候。佐葛從周伐鎮、定，從張存敬收晉、絳，皆有功，署為河中都虞候，榷鹽務。天復中，太祖迎駕至岐下，以規權知洽州。昭宗還長安，詔授皇城使。及東遷，以為御營使。駕至洛，授內園莊宅使。天祐三年，佐李周彝討相州，獨當州之一面，頗以功聞，軍還，權知耀州事。明年，討滄州，為諸軍壕寨使。太祖受禪，除右羽林統軍，尋佐劉鄩統兵收潼關，擒劉知浣獻之，乃以為右龍虎統軍兼侍衛指揮使。乾化元年，詔修洛河堤堰，軍士因之斬伐百姓園林太甚，河南尹張宗奭奏之，規得罪，賜死。

context.beforeSource: 文靖驍果善戰，諸將皆惜之。
context.afterSource: 李讜，河中臨晉人。
context.beforeLocal: 文靖驍果善戰，諸將皆惜之。
context.afterLocal: 李讜，河中臨晉人。

manualTranslations.zh: 胡規，兗州人。
manualTranslations.literal: Hu Gui was a native of Yanzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hu Gui came from Yanzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 初事朱瑾為中軍都校。
manualTranslations.literal: At first he served Zhu Jin as central-army commandant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He first served Zhu Jin as a central-army commandant.

manualTranslations.zh: 兗州平，署為宣武軍都虞候。
manualTranslations.literal: When Yanzhou was pacified, he was appointed Xuanwu Army chief adjutant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Yanzhou fell he was made chief adjutant of the Xuanwu Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 佐葛從周伐鎮、定，從張存敬收晉、絳，皆有功，署為河中都虞候，榷鹽務。
manualTranslations.literal: He aided Ge Congzhou in attacking Zhen and Ding, followed Zhang Cunjing in taking Jin and Jiang—all with merit—and was appointed chief adjutant of Hezhong and put in charge of the salt monopoly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He helped Ge Congzhou against Zhen and Ding and Zhang Cunjing against Jin and Jiang, winning merit each time; he was then made chief adjutant of Hezhong and put in charge of the salt monopoly.

manualTranslations.zh: 天復中，太祖迎駕至岐下，以規權知洽州。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianfu, when the Founder welcomed the imperial carriage to Qixia, he made Gui acting prefect of Qiazhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Tianfu, when the Founder welcomed the emperor to Qixia, he made Gui acting prefect of Qiazhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 昭宗還長安，詔授皇城使。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhaozong returned to Chang'an, an edict appointed him imperial-city commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhaozong returned to Chang'an, an edict made him imperial-city commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 及東遷，以為御營使。
manualTranslations.literal: When the court moved east, he was made imperial-camp commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the court moved east, he was made imperial-camp commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 駕至洛，授內園莊宅使。
manualTranslations.literal: When the carriage reached Luoyang, he was appointed commissioner of the inner gardens and estates.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the emperor reached Luoyang, he was made commissioner of the inner gardens and estates.

manualTranslations.zh: 天祐三年，佐李周彝討相州，獨當州之一面，頗以功聞，軍還，權知耀州事。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianyou 3 he aided Li Zhouyi against Xiangzhou, alone holding one face of the prefecture, and won considerable fame; when the army returned he was acting prefect of Yaozhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianyou 3 he aided Li Zhouyi at Xiangzhou, holding one sector of the siege alone and winning fame; after the campaign he acted as prefect of Yaozhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，討滄州，為諸軍壕寨使。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year, campaigning against Cangzhou, he was trench-and-camp commissioner for the armies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next year, in the campaign against Cangzhou, he served as trench-and-camp commissioner for the combined armies.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖受禪，除右羽林統軍，尋佐劉鄩統兵收潼關，擒劉知浣獻之，乃以為右龍虎統軍兼侍衛指揮使。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Founder received the mandate, Gui was made Right Feathered Forest commander; soon he aided Liu Yan in leading troops to recover Tong Pass, captured Liu Zhihuan and presented him, and was then made Right Dragon-Tiger commander and also commander of the palace guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the Liang founding he was made Right Feathered Forest commander; he soon helped Liu Yan recover Tong Pass, captured Liu Zhihuan and presented him, and was then made Right Dragon-Tiger commander and commander of the palace guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾化元年，詔修洛河堤堰，軍士因之斬伐百姓園林太甚，河南尹張宗奭奏之，規得罪，賜死。
manualTranslations.literal: In Qianhua 1 an edict ordered repair of the Luo River dikes; soldiers used this to cut down commoners' gardens and groves far too much; Henan governor Zhang Zongshi memorialized it; Gui was found guilty and ordered to die.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Qianhua 1 an edict ordered repairs on the Luo River dikes; soldiers used the work to strip commoners' gardens and groves, and Henan governor Zhang Zongshi reported it; Gui was condemned and put to death.

sourceRange.text: 光化二年，罷歸，復為左衙都將兼馬步教練使。天復元年，授潞州馬步都指揮使，法令嚴整，士庶安之。及追赴行在，士卒泣送者不絕於道，加金紫光祿大夫、檢校司空，改滑州左衙步軍指揮使，知邢州軍州事。天祐元年，授邢州團練使。時州兵才及二百人，晉人知之，以大軍來寇。太祖在鄴，發長直兵二千人赴援，存節率壯健出鬥，以家財賞激戰士，並軍急攻，七日不能克而去。太祖召至，勞慰久之，厚賚金帛鞍馬，加檢校司徒。冬，罷軍，署為元帥府左都押衙。四年，太祖受禪，除右千牛衛上將軍。其秋，攻潞州，以存節為行營馬步軍都排陣使。

context.beforeSource: 淮人訝其神速，震恐而退，諸將服其智識。
context.afterSource: 開平二年二月，自右監門衛上將軍轉右龍虎統軍，駐留洛下。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Guanghua 2 he was dismissed to return home, then reappointed commander of the Left Garrison and joint horse-and-foot drill instructor.

manualTranslations.zh: 天復元年，授潞州馬步都指揮使，法令嚴整，士庶安之。
manualTranslations.literal: Tianfu year 1, appointed overall horse-and-foot commander of Lu; laws and orders were strict and orderly, officials and people were at peace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianfu 1 he was made Lu's horse-and-foot commander; his regulations were strict and the people lived secure.

manualTranslations.zh: 及追赴行在，士卒泣送者不絕於道，加金紫光祿大夫、檢校司空，改滑州左衙步軍指揮使，知邢州軍州事。
manualTranslations.literal: When summoned to the imperial camp, soldiers weeping to see him off lined the road without end; he was advanced to Grand Master of Splendid Brightness with the Golden Cassia seal and acting Minister of Works, changed to commander of Hua's Left Garrison foot army, and made acting military commissioner of Xing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Summoned to court, troops wept along the road as he left; he rose to Grand Master of Splendid Brightness with Golden Cassia seal and acting Minister of Works, became commander of Hua Left Garrison infantry, and acted as Xing prefect and military commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 天祐元年，授邢州團練使。
manualTranslations.literal: Tianyou year 1, appointed defense commissioner of Xing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianyou 1 he received Xing as defense commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 時州兵才及二百人，晉人知之，以大軍來寇。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the prefectural troops numbered barely two hundred; the Jin learned of it and came raiding with a great army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prefecture had only two hundred troops; the Jin learned this and marched in force.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖在鄴，發長直兵二千人赴援，存節率壯健出鬥，以家財賞激戰士，並軍急攻，七日不能克而去。
manualTranslations.literal: The Founder was at Ye and sent two thousand long-service troops to the relief; Cunjie led the strong men out to fight, rewarded the warriors with his household wealth to spur them on; the allied armies pressed the attack fiercely but after seven days could not take the place and withdrew.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At Ye the Founder sent two thousand long-service men; Cunjie led his best troops out, paid warriors from his own purse, and with the relief force assaulted hard for seven days before the enemy withdrew.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖召至，勞慰久之，厚賚金帛鞍馬，加檢校司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: The Founder summoned him, comforted him at length, richly rewarded him with gold, silks, saddles, and horses, and advanced him to acting Minister of Education.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Founder summoned him, consoled him at length, gave rich gifts of gold, silk, saddles and horses, and made him acting Minister of Education.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬，罷軍，署為元帥府左都押衙。
manualTranslations.literal: Winter, the army was disbanded; he was appointed Left Chief Escort Officer of the Marshal's headquarters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That winter the army was stood down and he was made Left Chief Escort of the Marshal's headquarters.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，太祖受禪，除右千牛衛上將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Year 4, when the Founder received the abdication, he was appointed senior general of the Right Palace Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 4, when the Founder took the throne, he was made senior general of the Right Palace Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 其秋，攻潞州，以存節為行營馬步軍都排陣使。
manualTranslations.literal: That autumn, attacking Lu Prefecture, Cunjie was made overall array-master of the camp horse and foot.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That autumn, during the Lu campaign, he was named the field army's master of battle arrays for horse and foot.

sourceRange.text: 康懷英，兗州人也。本名懷貞，避末帝御名，故改之。始以驍勇事朱瑾為列校。唐乾寧四年春，太祖既平鄆，命葛從周乘勝急攻兗州。時朱瑾在豐沛間搜索糧餉，留懷英守其城。及從周軍至，懷英聞鄆失守，乃出降。太祖素聞其名，得之甚喜，尋署為軍校。光化元年秋，從氏叔琮伐襄、漢，懷英以一軍攻下鄧州。三年，從征河朔，佐張存敬敗燕軍於易水之上。天復元年冬，太祖率師迎昭宗於鳳翔。時李茂貞遣大將符道昭領兵萬餘屯武功以拒，太祖命諸軍擊之，以懷英為前鋒，領眾先登，一鼓而大破之，擄甲士六千餘人，奪馬二千匹。翌日，太祖方至，顧左右曰：「邑名武功，今首蕩逆黨，真武功也。」乃召懷英，大加獎激，仍以駿馬、珍器賜之。

context.beforeSource: 長子光圖，仕後唐，為供奉官。
context.afterSource: 二年四月，符道昭復領大軍屯於虢縣之漢穀。

context.afterLocal: 二年四月，符道昭復領大軍屯於虢縣之漢穀。

manualTranslations.zh: 康懷英，兗州人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Kang Huaiying was a man of Yanzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kang Huaiying came from Yanzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 本名懷貞，避末帝御名，故改之。
manualTranslations.literal: His original given name was Huaizhen; to avoid the taboo name of the Last Emperor, it was changed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His original name was Huaizhen; to avoid the Last Emperor's taboo name, it was changed.

manualTranslations.zh: 始以驍勇事朱瑾為列校。
manualTranslations.literal: At first, for his fierce valor, he served Zhu Jin as a column commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For his fierce valor he first served Zhu Jin as a column commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐乾寧四年春，太祖既平鄆，命葛從周乘勝急攻兗州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year of Qianning of Tang, after the Founder had pacified Yun, he ordered Ge Congzhou to press the victory and attack Yanzhou in haste.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the spring of Tang Qianning 4, after the Founder took Yun, he ordered Ge Congzhou to press the victory and storm Yanzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 時朱瑾在豐沛間搜索糧餉，留懷英守其城。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Zhu Jin was searching for grain and fodder between Feng and Pei, leaving Huaiying to hold the city.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhu Jin was foraging between Feng and Pei and left Huaiying to hold the city.

manualTranslations.zh: 及從周軍至，懷英聞鄆失守，乃出降。
manualTranslations.literal: When Congzhou's army arrived, Huaiying heard that Yun had fallen and came out to surrender.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Congzhou arrived, Huaiying heard Yun had fallen and surrendered.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖素聞其名，得之甚喜，尋署為軍校。
manualTranslations.literal: The Founder had long known his name and was greatly pleased to get him; he soon appointed him a military instructor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Founder had long known his name and was delighted; he soon made him a military instructor.

manualTranslations.zh: 光化元年秋，從氏叔琮伐襄、漢，懷英以一軍攻下鄧州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the autumn of the first year of Guanghua, he followed Shi Shucong in campaigning against Xiang and Han; Huaiying with one army captured Deng prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the autumn of Guanghua 1 he followed Shi Shucong against Xiang and Han and took Deng prefecture with one army.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，從征河朔，佐張存敬敗燕軍於易水之上。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year he followed campaigns in Hebei and assisted Zhang Cunjing in defeating the Yan army above the Yishui.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 3 he campaigned in Hebei and helped Zhang Cunjing rout the Yan army above the Yishui.

manualTranslations.zh: 天復元年冬，太祖率師迎昭宗於鳳翔。
manualTranslations.literal: In the winter of the first year of Tianfu, the Founder led troops to welcome Emperor Zhaozong at Fengxiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the winter of Tianfu 1 the Founder led troops to welcome Emperor Zhaozong at Fengxiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 時李茂貞遣大將符道昭領兵萬餘屯武功以拒，太祖命諸軍擊之，以懷英為前鋒，領眾先登，一鼓而大破之，擄甲士六千餘人，奪馬二千匹。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Li Maozhen sent the great general Fu Daozhao with more than ten thousand troops to encamp at Wugong to resist; the Founder ordered the armies to strike; Huaiying was made vanguard, led the host up first, and in one drum broke them utterly, capturing more than six thousand armored men and seizing two thousand horses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li Maozhen sent Fu Daozhao with more than ten thousand men to hold Wugong; the Founder ordered an attack and made Huaiying vanguard. He led the charge, broke the enemy at one stroke, captured more than six thousand armored men, and seized two thousand horses.

manualTranslations.zh: 翌日，太祖方至，顧左右曰：「邑名武功，今首蕩逆黨，真武功也。」
manualTranslations.literal: The next day, when the Founder had just arrived, he looked to his attendants and said: "The district is named Wugong; today we first swept away rebels—truly Wugong indeed."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next day, when the Founder arrived, he told his attendants, "The place is called Wugong; today we first swept away rebels—truly martial merit indeed."

manualTranslations.zh: 乃召懷英，大加獎激，仍以駿馬、珍器賜之。
manualTranslations.literal: He then summoned Huaiying, greatly commended and roused him, and furthermore bestowed fine horses and precious vessels on him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He summoned Huaiying, praised him warmly, and gave him fine horses and precious vessels.

sourceRange.text: 其年夏，同州劉知俊反，引岐人襲據長安，分兵扼河、潼。太祖幸陝，命鄩西討，即奮取潼關，擒知俊弟知浣以獻。遂引兵收復長安，知俊棄郡奔鳳翔。太祖以鄩為佑國、同州軍兩使留後。尋改佑國軍為永平軍，以鄩為節度使、檢校司徒，行大安尹、金州管內觀察使。是時，西鄙未寧，密邇寇境，鄩練兵撫眾，獨當一面。四年，加檢校太保、同平章事。庶人友珪篡位，加檢校太傅。乾化三年正月，丁內艱，友珪命起復視事。未帝即位，尤深倚重。明年夏，詔鄩歸闕，授開封尹，遙領鎮南軍節度使。旋屬晉人寇河朔，鄩奉詔與魏節度使楊師厚禦之而退。

context.beforeSource: 五月，改左龍武統軍，充侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使。
context.afterSource: 九月，徐州節度使蔣殷據城叛。

manualTranslations.zh: 其年夏，同州劉知俊反，引岐人襲據長安，分兵扼河、潼。
manualTranslations.literal: That summer, Liu Zhijun of Tongzhou rebelled, led Qi men in a surprise seizure of Chang'an, and divided troops to hold the Yellow River and Tong Pass.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That summer Liu Zhijun of Tongzhou rebelled, led Qi troops in a surprise seizure of Chang'an, and posted men to hold the Yellow River and Tong Pass.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖幸陝，命鄩西討，即奮取潼關，擒知俊弟知浣以獻。
manualTranslations.literal: The Founder went to Shan and ordered Xun to campaign west; he boldly seized Tong Pass and captured Zhijun's younger brother Zhi Huan for presentation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Founder went to Shan, ordered Xun west, seized Tong Pass at once, and captured Zhijun's younger brother Zhi Huan for presentation.

manualTranslations.zh: 遂引兵收復長安，知俊棄郡奔鳳翔。
manualTranslations.literal: He then led troops to recover Chang'an; Zhijun abandoned the commandery and fled to Fengxiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then recovered Chang'an; Zhijun abandoned the commandery and fled to Fengxiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖以鄩為佑國、同州軍兩使留後。
manualTranslations.literal: The Founder made Xun acting commissioner of both Youguo and Tongzhou armies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Founder made Xun acting commissioner of both the Youguo and Tongzhou armies.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋改佑國軍為永平軍，以鄩為節度使、檢校司徒，行大安尹、金州管內觀察使。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon Youguo army was changed to Yongping army, and Xun was made military commissioner, acting Minister of Education, acting Grand Marshal of Da'an, and surveillance commissioner over Jin prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon the Youguo army was renamed Yongping army; Xun was made military commissioner, acting Minister of Education, acting Grand Marshal of Da'an, and surveillance commissioner over Jin prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時，西鄙未寧，密邇寇境，鄩練兵撫眾，獨當一面。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the western frontier was not yet settled and closely bordered the enemy; Xun drilled troops and comforted the masses, holding one face alone.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The western frontier was still unsettled and lay close to the enemy; Xun drilled troops, steadied the men, and held the line alone.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，加檢校太保、同平章事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he was made acting Grand Guardian and Co-Rector of State.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 4 he was made acting Grand Guardian and co-rector of state.

manualTranslations.zh: 庶人友珪篡位，加檢校太傅。
manualTranslations.literal: When the commoner Yougui usurped the throne, he was made acting Grand Tutor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yougui the commoner usurped the throne, he was made acting Grand Tutor.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾化三年正月，丁內艱，友珪命起復視事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of the third year of Qianhua he mourned his mother; Yougui ordered him to resume office while in mourning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of Qianhua 3 he mourned his mother; Yougui ordered him to resume office while in mourning.

manualTranslations.zh: 未帝即位，尤深倚重。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Last Emperor acceded, he relied on him especially deeply.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Last Emperor acceded, he relied on him especially deeply.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年夏，詔鄩歸闕，授開封尹，遙領鎮南軍節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: The next summer an edict summoned Xun to court; he was made Prefect of Kaifeng and commissioner of Zhennan army in absentia.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next summer an edict recalled Xun to court; he was made Prefect of Kaifeng and commissioner of Zhennan army in absentia.

manualTranslations.zh: 旋屬晉人寇河朔，鄩奉詔與魏節度使楊師厚禦之而退。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon thereafter the Jin raided Hebei; Xun received an edict and with Wei military commissioner Yang Shihou repelled them and withdrew.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon the Jin raided Hebei; Xun by edict joined Wei commissioner Yang Shihou, repelled them, and withdrew.

sourceRange.text: 文德元年二月，僖宗自興元還京。三月，僖宗崩，昭宗即位，以武皇為開府儀同三司、檢校太師、兼侍中、隴西郡王，食邑七千戶，食實封二百戶。河南尹張全義潛兵夜襲李罕之於河陽，城陷，舉族為全義所擄；罕之逾垣獲免，遂來歸於武皇。遣李存孝、薛阿檀、史儼兒、安金俊、安休休將七千騎送罕之至河陽。汴將丁會、牛存節、葛從周將兵赴援，李存孝率精騎逆戰於溫縣。汴人既扼太行之路，存孝殿軍而退。騎將安休休以戰不利，奔於蔡。武皇以罕之為澤州刺史，遙領河陽節度使。十月，邢州孟方立遣大將奚忠信將兵三萬寇遼州，武皇大破之，斬首萬級，生擒奚忠信。

context.beforeSource: 時張全義自河陽據澤州，及李罕之收復河陽，召全義令守洛陽，全義乃棄澤州而去，故以金俊守之。
context.afterSource: 龍紀元年五月，遣李罕之、李存孝攻邢州。
