manualTranslations.zh: 光允，光逢之弟也，
manualTranslations.literal: Guangyun was Guangfeng's younger brother.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guangyun was Guangfeng's younger brother.

manualTranslations.zh: （新舊《唐書》俱云：趙隱子三人，光逢、光裔、光允。
manualTranslations.literal: (Both the Old and New Books of Tang state: Zhao Yin had three sons—Guangfeng, Guangyi, and Guangyun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: (Both the Old and New Books of Tang state: Zhao Yin had three sons—Guangfeng, Guangyi, and Guangyun.

manualTranslations.zh: 為後唐相者，光允也。
manualTranslations.literal: The one who became chief minister under Later Tang was Guangyun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The one who became chief minister under Later Tang was Guangyun.

manualTranslations.zh: 原本作光裔，係誤。）
manualTranslations.literal: The original text had Guangyi, which was an error.)
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The original text had Guangyi, which was an error.)

manualTranslations.zh: 俱以詞藝知名，亦登進士第。
manualTranslations.literal: Both were renowned for literary talent and also passed the jinshi examination.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Both were renowned for literary talent and also passed the jinshi examination.

manualTranslations.zh: （《舊唐書》云：大順二年，進士登第。
manualTranslations.literal: (According to the Old Book of Tang: in the second year of Dashun he passed the jinshi examination.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: (According to the Old Book of Tang: in the second year of Dashun he passed the jinshi examination.

manualTranslations.zh: 天祐初，累官至駕部郎中。）
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Tianyou he rose through successive posts to director of the Bureau of Transport.)
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianyou he rose through successive posts to director of the Bureau of Transport.)

manualTranslations.zh: 光允仕梁，曆清顯，伯仲之間，咸以方雅自高，北人聞其名者，皆望風欽重。
manualTranslations.literal: Guangyun served Liang in prominent offices; among the brothers each held himself aloof with refined reserve, and northerners who heard their names all bowed to their reputation from afar.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guangyun served Liang in prominent offices. Among the brothers each held himself aloof with refined reserve, and northerners who heard their names all revered them from afar.

manualTranslations.zh: 及莊宗平定汴、洛，時盧程以狂妄免，郭崇韜自勳臣拜，議者以為國朝典禮故實，須訪前代名家，咸曰光允有宰相器。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhuangzong pacified Bian and Luo, Lu Cheng was dismissed for arrogance and Guo Chongyao was appointed from among meritorious ministers. Commentators held that the dynasty's ritual and precedents required consulting celebrated masters of former ages, and all said Guangyun had the makings of a chief minister.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong pacified Bian and Luoyang, Lu Cheng was dismissed for arrogance and Guo Chongyao was appointed from among meritorious ministers. Commentators held that the dynasty's ritual and precedents required consulting celebrated masters of former ages, and all said Guangyun had the makings of a chief minister.

manualTranslations.zh: 薛廷珪、李琪當武皇為晉王時，嘗因為冊使至太原，故皆有宿望，當時咸謂宜處台司。
manualTranslations.literal: Xue Tinggui and Li Qi, when the Martial Emperor was Prince of Jin, had once served as investiture envoys to Taiyuan and therefore both enjoyed longstanding reputation; at the time all said they were fit for the highest council posts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xue Tinggui and Li Qi, when the Martial Emperor was Prince of Jin, had once served as investiture envoys to Taiyuan and therefore both enjoyed longstanding reputation; at the time all said they were fit for the highest council posts.

manualTranslations.zh: 郭崇韜采言事者雲，廷珪朽老，浮華無相業；
manualTranslations.literal: Guo Chongyao adopted the words of memorialists, saying Tinggui was decrepit and aged, showy without ministerial substance;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guo Chongyao adopted the words of memorialists, saying Tinggui was decrepit and aged, showy without ministerial substance;

manualTranslations.zh: 琪雖文學高，傾險無士風，皆不可相，乃止。
manualTranslations.literal: and though Qi's literary learning was high, he was treacherous without the bearing of a gentleman—neither could be made chief minister, and the matter was dropped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: and though Qi's literary learning was high, he was treacherous without the bearing of a gentleman—neither could be made chief minister, and the matter was dropped.

manualTranslations.zh: 同光元年十一月，光允與韋說並拜平章事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Tongguang, Guangyun and Wei Yue were jointly appointed grand councilors.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the first year of Tongguang, Guangyun and Wei Yue were jointly appointed grand councilors.

sourceRange.text: 及明宗即位，豆盧革、韋說得罪，任圜陳奏，請命琪為相，為孔循、鄭玨排沮，乃相崔協。琪時為御史大夫，安重誨於台門前專殺殿直馬延。雖曾彈奏，而依違詞旨，不敢正言其罪，以是托疾，三上章請老；朝旨不允，除授尚書左僕射。自是之後，尤為宰執所忌，凡有奏陳，靡不望風橫沮。天成末，明宗自汴州還洛，琪為東都留司官班首，奏請至偃師奉迎。時琪奏中有「敗契丹之凶黨，破真定之逆賊」之言，詔曰：「契丹即為凶黨，真定不是逆賊，李琪罰一月俸。」又嘗秦敕撰《霍彥威神道碑》文。琪，梁之故相也，敘彥威仕梁曆任，不言其偽。中書奏曰：「不分真偽，是混功名，望令改撰。」詔從之。多此類也。

context.beforeSource: 莊宗深重之，尋命為國計使，垂為輔相，俄遇蕭牆之難而止。
context.afterSource: 琪雖博學多才，拙於遵養時晦，知時不可為，然猶多岐取進，動而見排，由己不能鎮靜也。

manualTranslations.zh: 及明宗即位，豆盧革、韋說得罪，任圜陳奏，請命琪為相，為孔循、鄭玨排沮，乃相崔協。
manualTranslations.literal: When Mingzong took the throne, Doulu Ge and Wei Yue were punished. Ren Yuan memorialized requesting that Qi be made chief minister, but Kong Xun and Zheng Jue obstructed the appointment, and Cui Xie was made chief minister instead.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Mingzong took the throne, Doulu Ge and Wei Yue were punished. Ren Yuan memorialized requesting that Qi be made chief minister, but Kong Xun and Zheng Jue obstructed the appointment, and Cui Xie was made chief minister instead.

manualTranslations.zh: 琪時為御史大夫，安重誨於台門前專殺殿直馬延。
manualTranslations.literal: Qi was then censor-in-chief. An Chonghui summarily executed palace attendant Ma Yan before the Censorate gate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qi was then censor-in-chief. An Chonghui summarily executed palace attendant Ma Yan before the Censorate gate.

manualTranslations.zh: 雖曾彈奏，而依違詞旨，不敢正言其罪，以是托疾，三上章請老；
manualTranslations.literal: Although Qi had memorialized in impeachment, his language was evasive and he dared not state the crime plainly. On this account he feigned illness and three times submitted memorials requesting retirement;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Although Qi had memorialized in impeachment, his language was evasive and he dared not state the crime plainly. On this account he feigned illness and three times submitted memorials requesting retirement;

manualTranslations.zh: 朝旨不允，除授尚書左僕射。
manualTranslations.literal: the court did not approve and appointed him left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The court did not approve and instead appointed him left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 自是之後，尤為宰執所忌，凡有奏陳，靡不望風橫沮。
manualTranslations.literal: From this time on he was especially resented by the chief ministers; whenever he submitted a memorial it was invariably blocked on sight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From this time on he was especially resented by the chief ministers; whenever he submitted a memorial it was invariably blocked on sight.

manualTranslations.zh: 天成末，明宗自汴州還洛，琪為東都留司官班首，奏請至偃師奉迎。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of Tiancheng, when Mingzong returned from Bian Prefecture to Luoyang, Qi was the senior official of the Eastern Capital retention bureau and memorialized requesting to go as far as Yanshi to welcome him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the end of Tiancheng, when Emperor Mingzong returned from Bian Prefecture to Luoyang, Qi was the senior official of the Eastern Capital retention bureau and memorialized requesting to go as far as Yanshi to welcome him.

manualTranslations.zh: 時琪奏中有「敗契丹之凶黨，破真定之逆賊」之言，詔曰：「契丹即為凶黨，真定不是逆賊，李琪罰一月俸。」
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Qi's memorial contained the words "defeating the vicious faction of the Khitan and crushing the rebel bandits of Zhending." An edict said: "If the Khitan are a vicious faction, then Zhending are not rebel bandits. Li Qi is fined one month's salary."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time Qi's memorial contained the words "defeating the vicious faction of the Khitan and crushing the rebel bandits of Zhending." An edict said: "If the Khitan are a vicious faction, then Zhending are not rebel bandits. Li Qi is fined one month's salary."

manualTranslations.zh: 又嘗秦敕撰《霍彥威神道碑》文。
manualTranslations.literal: He also once memorialized at imperial order to compose the spirit-way stele text for Huo Yanwei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also once memorialized at imperial order to compose the spirit-way stele text for Huo Yanwei.

manualTranslations.zh: 琪，梁之故相也，敘彥威仕梁曆任，不言其偽。
manualTranslations.literal: Qi, a former chief minister of Liang, described Yanwei's successive offices under Liang without mentioning the illegitimate regime.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qi, a former chief minister of Liang, described Yanwei's successive offices under Liang without mentioning the illegitimate regime.

manualTranslations.zh: 中書奏曰：「不分真偽，是混功名，望令改撰。」
manualTranslations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: "Not distinguishing true from false confounds merit and reputation. We ask that he be ordered to rewrite it."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Secretariat memorialized: "Not distinguishing true from false confounds merit and reputation. We ask that he be ordered to rewrite it."

manualTranslations.zh: 詔從之。
manualTranslations.literal: The edict approved.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The edict approved.

manualTranslations.zh: 多此類也。
manualTranslations.literal: There were many instances of this kind.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: There were many instances of this kind.

sourceRange.text: 袁象先，宋州下邑人也。自稱唐中宗朝中書令、南陽郡王恕己之後。曾祖進朝，成都少尹，梁以象先貴，累贈左僕射。祖忠義，忠武軍節度判官，累贈司空。父敬初，太府卿，累贈司徒、駙馬都尉。敬初娶梁祖之妹，初封沛郡太君。開平中，追封長公主。貞明中，追封萬安大長公主。

context.beforeSource: 然瓚能優禮搢紳，抑挫豪猾，故當時士流皆稱仰焉。
context.afterSource: 象先即梁祖之甥也。

manualTranslations.zh: 袁象先，宋州下邑人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Yuan Xiangxian was a native of Xiayi in Song Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuan Xiangxian came from Xiayi in Song Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 自稱唐中宗朝中書令、南陽郡王恕己之後。
manualTranslations.literal: He claimed descent from Shuji, Director of the Secretariat and Prince of Nanyang during the reign of Emperor Zhongzong of Tang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He claimed descent from Shuji, who had served as Secretariat Director and Prince of Nanyang under Emperor Zhongzong of Tang.

manualTranslations.zh: 曾祖進朝，成都少尹，梁以象先貴，累贈左僕射。
manualTranslations.literal: His great-grandfather Jinchao was Vice Prefect of Chengdu; because of Xiangxian's eminence, the Liang court repeatedly posthumously enfeoffed him Left Vice Minister.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Jinchao had been Vice Prefect of Chengdu. When Xiangxian rose to eminence, the Liang court repeatedly posthumously honored him as Left Vice Minister.

manualTranslations.zh: 祖忠義，忠武軍節度判官，累贈司空。
manualTranslations.literal: His grandfather Zhongyi was administrative aide to the Zhongwu military commissioner; was repeatedly posthumously enfeoffed as Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His grandfather Zhongyi had served as administrative aide to the Zhongwu military commissioner and was posthumously promoted to Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 父敬初，太府卿，累贈司徒、駙馬都尉。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Jingchu was Minister of the Grand Treasury; was repeatedly posthumously enfeoffed as Minister of Ceremonial and Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-Law's Household.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Jingchu had served as Minister of the Grand Treasury and was posthumously honored as Minister of Ceremonial and Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-Law's Household.

manualTranslations.zh: 敬初娶梁祖之妹，初封沛郡太君。
manualTranslations.literal: Jingchu married the Liang Founder's younger sister, who was first enfeoffed as Grand Lady of Pei Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jingchu married the Liang Founder's younger sister, who was first titled Grand Lady of Pei.

manualTranslations.zh: 開平中，追封長公主。
manualTranslations.literal: During Kaiping, she was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Princess.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Kaiping she was posthumously enfeoffed Grand Princess.

manualTranslations.zh: 貞明中，追封萬安大長公主。
manualTranslations.literal: During Zhenming, she was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Wan'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Zhenming she was posthumously enfeoffed Grand Princess of Wan'an.

sourceRange.text: 張敬詢，勝州金河縣人，世為振武軍牙校。祖仲阮，曆勝州刺史，父漢環事武皇為牙將。敬詢當武皇時，專掌甲坊十五年，以稱職聞。復以女為武皇子存霸妻，益見親信。莊宗即位，以為沁州刺史，秩滿，復用為甲坊使。莊宗經略山東，敬詢從軍，曆博、澤、慈、隰四州刺史。同光末，授耀州團練使。郭崇韜之征蜀也，以敬詢善督租賦，乃表為利州留後。明宗即位，正授昭武軍節度使。天成二年，詔還京師，復授大同節度使，至鎮，招撫室韋萬餘帳。四年，征為左驍衛上將軍。明年，授滑州節度使。以河水連年溢堤，乃自酸棗縣界至濮州，廣堤防一丈五尺，東西二百里，民甚賴之。三年，秩滿歸京，卒。輟視朝一日。

context.afterSource: 劉彥琮，字比德，雲中人也。

manualTranslations.zh: 張敬詢，勝州金河縣人，世為振武軍牙校。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhang Jingxun was a native of Jinhe county in Shengzhou; his family for generations served as junior officers in the Zhenwu army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhang Jingxun came from Jinhe in Sheng; his family had served for generations as junior officers of the Zhenwu army.

manualTranslations.zh: 祖仲阮，曆勝州刺史，父漢環事武皇為牙將。
manualTranslations.literal: His grandfather Zhong Ruan successively served as prefect of Shengzhou; his father Hanhuan served the Martial Emperor as a junior general.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His grandfather Zhong Ruan had served as prefect of Sheng; his father Hanhuan had been a junior general under the Martial Emperor.

manualTranslations.zh: 敬詢當武皇時，專掌甲坊十五年，以稱職聞。
manualTranslations.literal: During the Martial Emperor's reign Jingxun solely managed the armor workshop for fifteen years and was famed for competence in office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under the Martial Emperor, Jingxun spent fifteen years in sole charge of the armor workshop and earned a reputation for competence.

manualTranslations.zh: 復以女為武皇子存霸妻，益見親信。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, because his daughter became wife to the Martial Emperor's son Cunba, he was still more trusted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His daughter also married the Martial Emperor's son Cunba, which brought him still closer favor.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊宗即位，以為沁州刺史，秩滿，復用為甲坊使。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhuangzong took the throne, he was appointed prefect of Qinzhou; when his term ended he was again appointed armor-workshop commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong succeeded, Jingxun was made prefect of Qin; after his term ended he was again made armor-workshop commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊宗經略山東，敬詢從軍，曆博、澤、慈、隰四州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhuangzong campaigned in Shandong, Jingxun followed the army and successively served as prefect of Bo, Ze, Ci, and Xi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Zhuangzong's Shandong campaign Jingxun served with the army and successively governed Bo, Ze, Ci, and Xi.

manualTranslations.zh: 同光末，授耀州團練使。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of Tongguang he was appointed regimental commander of Yaozhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the end of the Tongguang era he was made regimental commander of Yao.

manualTranslations.zh: 郭崇韜之征蜀也，以敬詢善督租賦，乃表為利州留後。
manualTranslations.literal: When Guo Chongtao campaigned against Shu, because Jingxun was skilled at supervising land tax and corvée levies, he was memorialized for appointment as acting governor of Lizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Guo Chongtao's Shu campaign, Jingxun's skill at collecting taxes and grain led to his nomination as acting governor of Li.

manualTranslations.zh: 明宗即位，正授昭武軍節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: When Mingzong took the throne he was formally appointed military commissioner of the Zhaowu army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Mingzong succeeded, Jingxun was formally made commissioner of Zhaowu.

manualTranslations.zh: 天成二年，詔還京師，復授大同節度使，至鎮，招撫室韋萬餘帳。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tiancheng 2 he was ordered back to the capital, then again appointed military commissioner of Datong; upon reaching his commission he pacified and won over more than ten thousand Xiwei households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tiancheng 2 he was recalled to court, then sent out again as commissioner of Datong; once there he pacified more than ten thousand Xiwei households.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，征為左驍衛上將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he was summoned as left Elite Cavalry great general.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was recalled as Left Elite Cavalry great general.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，授滑州節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year he was appointed military commissioner of Huazhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The following year he was made commissioner of Hua.

manualTranslations.zh: 以河水連年溢堤，乃自酸棗縣界至濮州，廣堤防一丈五尺，東西二百里，民甚賴之。
manualTranslations.literal: Because the Yellow River for successive years overflowed its dikes, he from the border of Suanzao county to Puzhou widened the dikes one zhang and five chi, two hundred li east to west; the people relied greatly upon it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As the Yellow River breached its dikes year after year, he widened the embankments from Suanzao county to Pu—one zhang and five chi high and two hundred li long—and the people came to depend on the work.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，秩滿歸京，卒。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year his term ended and he returned to the capital; he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When his third term ended he returned to the capital and died there.

manualTranslations.zh: 輟視朝一日。
manualTranslations.literal: Court audiences were suspended for one day.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Court audiences were suspended for a day.

sourceRange.text: 張遵誨，魏州人也。父為宗城令，羅紹威殺牙軍之歲，為梁軍所害。遵誨奔太原，武皇以為牙門將。莊宗定山東，遵誨以典客從，曆幽、鎮二府馬步都虞候。同光中，為金吾大將軍。明宗即位，任圜保薦，授西都副留守，知留守事、京兆尹。天成四年，入為客省使、守衛尉卿。及將有事於南郊，為修儀仗法物使。初，遵誨自以歷位尹正，與安重誨素亦相款，衷心有望於節鉞。及郊禋畢，止為絳州刺史，鬱鬱不樂。離京之日，白衣乘馬於隼之下，至郡無疾，翌日而卒。

manualTranslations.zh: 及將有事於南郊，為修儀仗法物使。

manualTranslations.zh: 及郊禋畢，止為絳州刺史，鬱鬱不樂。

manualTranslations.zh: 離京之日，白衣乘馬於隼之下，至郡無疾，翌日而卒。

sourceRange.text: 漢賓少勇健，及晚歲飲啖過人，其狀貌偉如也。凡所履曆，不聞逾法。梁時，嘗領軍屯魏州莘縣，適值連帥去郡，諸軍咸以利見誘，請自為留後，漢賓則斬其言者，拒而不從，聞者賞焉。在曹日，飛蝗去境，父老歌之。臨平陽遇旱，親齋潔禱龍子祠，逾日雨足，四封大稔，咸以為善政之所致也。及致仕，東還亳郡，見鄉舊親戚淪沒者，有塋兆未辦，則給以棺斂；有婚嫁未畢，則助以資幣，受其惠者數百家，郡人義之。尋還洛陽，有第在懷仁裏，北限洛水，南枕通衢，層屋連甍，修木交幹，笙歌羅綺，日以自娛，養彼太和，保其餘齒，此乃近朝知止之良將也。晉高祖即位，贈太子少傅，諡曰貞惠。

context.afterSource: 子四人，長曰崇勳，官至左武衛將軍。

manualTranslations.zh: 漢賓少勇健，及晚歲飲啖過人，其狀貌偉如也。
manualTranslations.literal: Hanbin in youth was brave and hardy, and in his later years his eating and drinking exceeded others; his appearance was grand and imposing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In youth Hanbin was brave and hardy; in old age he ate and drank more than most, and his bearing remained imposing.

manualTranslations.zh: 凡所履曆，不聞逾法。
manualTranslations.literal: In all posts he held, nothing was heard of his transgressing the law.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In every post he held, no one heard of his breaking the law.

manualTranslations.zh: 梁時，嘗領軍屯魏州莘縣，適值連帥去郡，諸軍咸以利見誘，請自為留後，漢賓則斬其言者，拒而不從，聞者賞焉。
manualTranslations.literal: During Liang, he once led troops stationed at Shen County in Wei Prefecture. When the circuit commander left the prefecture, all the troops, tempted by profit, urged him to make himself regent; Hanbin beheaded the one who spoke and refused to comply, and those who heard praised him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under Liang he once garrisoned Shen County in Wei. When the circuit commander left, the troops, tempted by gain, urged him to declare himself regent; Hanbin beheaded the spokesman and refused, and those who heard commended him.

manualTranslations.zh: 在曹日，飛蝗去境，父老歌之。
manualTranslations.literal: While in Cao, flying locusts left the borders, and the elders sang of him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: While governing Cao, locusts left the borders, and the elders sang his praise.

manualTranslations.zh: 臨平陽遇旱，親齋潔禱龍子祠，逾日雨足，四封大稔，咸以為善政之所致也。
manualTranslations.literal: Governing Pingyang he encountered drought; he personally fasted and prayed at the Longzi Shrine; the next day rain was sufficient, the four quarters had a great harvest, and all attributed it to good governance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As prefect of Pingyang he met drought, personally fasted and prayed at the Longzi Shrine, and rain came the next day; the whole region had a great harvest, and all credited his good rule.

manualTranslations.zh: 及致仕，東還亳郡，見鄉舊親戚淪沒者，有塋兆未辦，則給以棺斂；
manualTranslations.literal: When he retired, he returned east to Bo commandery. Seeing old kinsmen fallen into ruin, where graves were not yet prepared he provided coffins for burial;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After retirement he returned east to Bo. Seeing old kinsmen ruined, he supplied coffins where graves were still unmade;

manualTranslations.zh: 有婚嫁未畢，則助以資幣，受其惠者數百家，郡人義之。
manualTranslations.literal: where marriages were unfinished he helped with funds; those who received his kindness numbered several hundred households, and the people of the commandery praised his righteousness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: where marriages were unfinished he helped with funds; several hundred households received his aid, and the people of the commandery praised his righteousness.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋還洛陽，有第在懷仁裏，北限洛水，南枕通衢，層屋連甍，修木交幹，笙歌羅綺，日以自娛，養彼太和，保其餘齒，此乃近朝知止之良將也。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he returned to Luoyang and had a mansion in Huairen Lane, bounded north by the Luo River and south by the main thoroughfare, with layered roofs and connected eaves, tall trees interlacing branches, singing, silk, and brocade for daily amusement, nurturing great harmony and preserving his remaining years—this was a fine general of recent times who knew when to stop.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was back in Luoyang, with a mansion in Huairen Lane facing the Luo to the north and the main road to the south—tiered roofs, tall trees, music and brocade for daily pleasure, nurturing ease and keeping his last years; a fine general of recent times who knew when to stop.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉高祖即位，贈太子少傅，諡曰貞惠。
manualTranslations.literal: When Jin's Gaozu took the throne, he was posthumously made Junior Mentor of the Heir and given the posthumous title Zhenhui.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Jin's Gaozu took the throne, he was posthumously made Junior Mentor of the Heir with the posthumous name Zhenhui—Loyal and Kind.

sourceRange.text: 孔勍，字鼎文，兗州人，後徙家宿州。少便騎射，為軍中小校，事梁祖漸至郡守，累遷齊州防禦使、唐鄧節度使。梁貞明中，王球據襄州叛，討平之，因授山南東道節度使。莊宗至洛陽，自鎮來朝，復令歸鎮，尋移昭義節度使。同光季年，監軍楊繼源與都將謀據潞州，事泄，誅之。明宗即位之歲，詔還京師，授河陽節度使。未幾，以太子太師致仕，卒年七十九。贈太尉。劉玘，汴州雍邱人也。世為宣武軍牙將。玘少負壯節，梁祖鎮汴州，玘求自試，補隊長。從梁祖征伐，所至有功，遷為牙將，曆滑、徐、襄三州都指揮使。開平中，襄帥王班為帳下所害，亂軍推玘為留後，玘詭從之，翌日受賀，衙庭享士，伏甲幕下，盡斬其亂將。以功曆復、亳二州刺史，征為侍衛都將，出為安州刺史。貞明中，為晉州留後。莊宗至汴，玘來朝。玘在晉州八年，日與上黨、太原之師交鬥於境上。莊宗見而勞之曰：「劉侯無恙，控我晉陽之南鄙，歲時久矣，不早相見。」玘頓首謝罪。復命歸鎮，正授節旄，移鎮安州。明宗即位，遷鄧州節度使。天成末，以史敬鎔代之。玘還京師，卒。贈侍中。

context.beforeSource: 子四人，長曰崇勳，官至左武衛將軍。
context.afterSource: 有子師道，仕皇朝，為右讚善大夫。
context.beforeLocal: 子四人，長曰崇勳，官至左武衛將軍。
context.afterLocal: 有子師道，仕皇朝，為右讚善大夫。

manualTranslations.zh: 孔勍，字鼎文，兗州人，後徙家宿州。
manualTranslations.literal: Kong Qing, whose courtesy name was Dingwen, was from Yan Prefecture and later moved his household to Su Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kong Qing, courtesy name Dingwen, came from Yan Prefecture and later moved his household to Su.

manualTranslations.zh: 少便騎射，為軍中小校，事梁祖漸至郡守，累遷齊州防禦使、唐鄧節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: Skilled in horsemanship and archery in youth, he served as a junior officer in the army, followed the Liang Founder and gradually rose to prefect, and was repeatedly transferred to Defense Commissioner of Qi Prefecture and Military Commissioner of the Tang-Deng circuit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Skilled in riding and archery from youth, he served as a junior army officer under the Liang Founder, rose to prefect, and was repeatedly made defense commissioner of Qi and military commissioner of the Tang-Deng circuit.

manualTranslations.zh: 梁貞明中，王球據襄州叛，討平之，因授山南東道節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: In Zhenming of Liang, Wang Qiu seized Xiang Prefecture and rebelled; Qing suppressed him and was accordingly made military commissioner of the Shannan East circuit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Liang's Zhenming era Wang Qiu seized Xiangzhou and rebelled; Qing put him down and was made military commissioner of the Shannan East circuit.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊宗至洛陽，自鎮來朝，復令歸鎮，尋移昭義節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhuangzong reached Luoyang, Qing came from his post to audience and was again ordered to return; soon he was transferred to military commissioner of the Zhaoyi circuit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong reached Luoyang, Qing came from his post to court and was sent back; soon he was transferred to military commissioner of Zhaoyi.

manualTranslations.zh: 同光季年，監軍楊繼源與都將謀據潞州，事泄，誅之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the closing years of Tongguang, army supervisor Yang Jiyuan and a chief general plotted to seize Lu Prefecture; when the affair leaked, Qing executed him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Late in Tongguang, army supervisor Yang Jiyuan and a chief general plotted to seize Luzhou; when the plot leaked, Qing executed him.

manualTranslations.zh: 明宗即位之歲，詔還京師，授河陽節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the year Mingzong took the throne, he was recalled to the capital by edict and made military commissioner of Heyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The year Mingzong took the throne, an edict recalled him to the capital and made him military commissioner of Heyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 未幾，以太子太師致仕，卒年七十九。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long he retired as Grand Tutor of the Heir and died at seventy-nine.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he retired as Grand Tutor of the Heir and died at seventy-nine.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈太尉。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Commandant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The court posthumously enfeoffed him as Grand Commandant.

manualTranslations.zh: 劉玘，汴州雍邱人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Liu Qi was from Yongqiu in Bian Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liu Qi came from Yongqiu in Bian Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 世為宣武軍牙將。
manualTranslations.literal: His family for generations were teeth generals of the Xuanwu army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His family had served for generations as teeth generals of the Xuanwu army.

manualTranslations.zh: 玘少負壯節，梁祖鎮汴州，玘求自試，補隊長。
manualTranslations.literal: Qi in youth possessed bold integrity; when the Liang Founder held Bian Prefecture, Qi asked to prove himself and was appointed squad leader.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As a youth Qi had bold integrity; when the Liang Founder held Bianzhou, Qi asked to prove himself and was made squad leader.

manualTranslations.zh: 從梁祖征伐，所至有功，遷為牙將，曆滑、徐、襄三州都指揮使。
manualTranslations.literal: Following the Liang Founder on campaigns, wherever he went he had merit; he was promoted to teeth general and served successively as chief commander of Hua, Xu, and Xiang prefectures.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Following the Liang Founder on campaigns he won merit wherever he went, rose to teeth general, and served successively as chief commander of Hua, Xu, and Xiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 開平中，襄帥王班為帳下所害，亂軍推玘為留後，玘詭從之，翌日受賀，衙庭享士，伏甲幕下，盡斬其亂將。
manualTranslations.literal: In Kaiping, Xiang commander Wang Ban was killed by his own men; the mutinous troops pushed Qi as regent; Qi feigned consent; the next day at the congratulatory reception in the court hall he feasted the officers with armed men hidden beneath the curtains and executed all the mutinous generals.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Kaiping the Xiang commander Wang Ban was killed by his own men; the mutineers made Qi regent, and Qi pretended to accept. The next day, at the congratulatory feast in the court hall, he hid armed men beneath the curtains and executed all the rebel leaders.

manualTranslations.zh: 以功曆復、亳二州刺史，征為侍衛都將，出為安州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: For merit he successively served as prefect of Fu and Bo, was recalled as commandant of the palace guards, and went out as prefect of An.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For his merit he served successively as prefect of Fu and Bo, was recalled as commandant of the palace guards, and was sent out as prefect of An.

manualTranslations.zh: 貞明中，為晉州留後。
manualTranslations.literal: In Zhenming he was regent of Jin Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhenming he was regent of Jin Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊宗至汴，玘來朝。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhuangzong reached Bian, Qi came to audience.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong reached Bian, Qi came to court.

manualTranslations.zh: 玘在晉州八年，日與上黨、太原之師交鬥於境上。
manualTranslations.literal: Qi was at Jin Prefecture eight years, daily fighting on the border with forces from Shangdang and Taiyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qi held Jin Prefecture eight years, fighting daily on the border with forces from Shangdang and Taiyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊宗見而勞之曰：「劉侯無恙，控我晉陽之南鄙，歲時久矣，不早相見。」
manualTranslations.literal: Zhuangzong saw him and comforted him, saying: "Marquis Liu, are you well? You have held our southern border at Jinyang for many years—why did we not meet sooner?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong saw him and said with praise, "Marquis Liu, are you well? You have held our southern border at Jinyang for many years—why did we not meet sooner?"

manualTranslations.zh: 玘頓首謝罪。
manualTranslations.literal: Qi prostrated himself and begged forgiveness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qi prostrated himself and begged forgiveness.

manualTranslations.zh: 復命歸鎮，正授節旄，移鎮安州。
manualTranslations.literal: He was again ordered to return to his post, formally granted the commissioner seal, and transferred to An Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was ordered back to his post, formally granted the commissioner seal, and transferred to An Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 明宗即位，遷鄧州節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: When Mingzong took the throne, Qi was transferred to military commissioner of Deng Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Mingzong took the throne, he was made military commissioner of Deng.

manualTranslations.zh: 天成末，以史敬鎔代之。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of Tiancheng, Shi Jingrong replaced him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Late in Tiancheng, Shi Jingrong replaced him.

manualTranslations.zh: 玘還京師，卒。
manualTranslations.literal: Qi returned to the capital and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qi returned to the capital and died.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously honored as Palace Attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as Palace Attendant.

sourceRange.text: 秦王為天下兵馬元帥，氣焰熏灼，大臣皆懼，求為外任。義誠以明宗委遇，無以解退，乃令其子以弓馬事秦王以自結。明宗不豫，秦王諷義誠為助，義誠曲意承奉，亦非真誠。及朱弘昭、馮贇等懼禍，謀於義誠，但云：「仆為將校，不敢預議，但相公所使耳。」及秦王既誅，明宗宴駕，閔帝即位，加檢校太尉、兼侍中，判六軍諸衛事。未幾，鳳翔變起，西軍不利，義誠懼，乃請行，蓋欲盡率駕下諸軍送降於潞王求免也。會與朱洪實議事不葉，洪實因厲聲言義誠苞藏之志，閔帝曖昧，不能明辨，而誅洪實。及義誠率軍至新安，諸軍爭先趨陝，解甲迎降，義誠以部下數十人見潞王請罪，潞王雖罪其奸回，未欲行法。清泰元年四月，斬於興教門外，夷其族。

context.beforeSource: ）長興末，加同平章事。
context.afterSource: 藥彥稠，沙陀三部落人。
context.beforeLocal: 長興末，加同平章事。
context.afterLocal: 藥彥稠，沙陀三部落人。

manualTranslations.zh: 秦王為天下兵馬元帥，氣焰熏灼，大臣皆懼，求為外任。
manualTranslations.literal: The Prince of Qin was marshal of all armies under heaven; his arrogance blazed hot; the chief ministers all feared and sought posts away from court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Prince of Qin became commander of all armies; his arrogance blazed; ministers feared him and sought posts away from court.

manualTranslations.zh: 義誠以明宗委遇，無以解退，乃令其子以弓馬事秦王以自結。
manualTranslations.literal: Yicheng, owing to Mingzong's favor, had no way to resign; he therefore had his son serve the Prince of Qin in archery and horsemanship to curry favor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Favored by Mingzong, Yicheng could not resign; he had his son serve the Prince of Qin in archery and horsemanship to win favor.

manualTranslations.zh: 明宗不豫，秦王諷義誠為助，義誠曲意承奉，亦非真誠。
manualTranslations.literal: When Mingzong fell ill, the Prince of Qin urged Yicheng to help; Yicheng bent to flatter him, yet it was not sincere.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Mingzong fell ill, the Prince of Qin urged Yicheng to aid him; Yicheng flattered him insincerely.

manualTranslations.zh: 及朱弘昭、馮贇等懼禍，謀於義誠，但云：「仆為將校，不敢預議，但相公所使耳。」
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhu Hongzhao, Feng Yun, and the rest feared calamity and plotted with Yicheng, he only said, "I am a military officer; I dare not join deliberations—I do only as the chief councilor commands."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhu Hongzhao, Feng Yun, and the rest feared disaster and plotted with Yicheng, he only said, "I am a military officer; I dare not take part in counsel—I do only as the chief councilor orders."

manualTranslations.zh: 及秦王既誅，明宗宴駕，閔帝即位，加檢校太尉、兼侍中，判六軍諸衛事。
manualTranslations.literal: After the Prince of Qin was executed, Mingzong died, and Emperor Min ascended; Yicheng was given acting Grand Commandant and concurrent Palace Attendant, and directed the Six Armies and all guards.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the Prince of Qin was killed, Mingzong died, and Emperor Min took the throne; Yicheng was made acting Grand Commandant and Palace Attendant and put in charge of the Six Armies and all guards.

manualTranslations.zh: 未幾，鳳翔變起，西軍不利，義誠懼，乃請行，蓋欲盡率駕下諸軍送降於潞王求免也。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long the Fengxiang revolt rose; the western army fared poorly; Yicheng feared and asked to march—likely intending to lead all troops at the emperor's side in surrender to the Prince of Lu to save himself.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon the Fengxiang revolt broke out; the western army fared badly; Yicheng, afraid, asked to march—likely meaning to lead the emperor's troops in surrender to the Prince of Lu to save himself.

manualTranslations.zh: 會與朱洪實議事不葉，洪實因厲聲言義誠苞藏之志，閔帝曖昧，不能明辨，而誅洪實。
manualTranslations.literal: He happened to dispute strategy with Zhu Hongshi; Hongshi cried out that Yicheng harbored treacherous intent; Emperor Min, bewildered, could not judge clearly and executed Hongshi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He disputed strategy with Zhu Hongshi; Hongshi cried that Yicheng harbored treachery; Emperor Min, confused, could not judge and had Hongshi executed.

manualTranslations.zh: 及義誠率軍至新安，諸軍爭先趨陝，解甲迎降，義誠以部下數十人見潞王請罪，潞王雖罪其奸回，未欲行法。
manualTranslations.literal: When Yicheng led the army to Xin'an, the troops raced ahead to Shan, laid down arms and welcomed surrender; Yicheng came with several dozen followers to beg pardon of the Prince of Lu; though the prince blamed his treachery, he did not yet wish to punish.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yicheng reached Xin'an, the troops raced to Shan, laid down arms, and surrendered; Yicheng came with several dozen men to beg pardon of the Prince of Lu; though the prince blamed his treachery, he did not yet punish him.

manualTranslations.zh: 清泰元年四月，斬於興教門外，夷其族。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth month of Qingtai year 1 he was beheaded outside the Xingjiao Gate and his clan was exterminated.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Qingtai 1 he was beheaded outside the Xingjiao Gate and his clan was wiped out.

sourceRange.text: 莊宗將即位，求四鎮判官可為宰輔者。時盧汝弼、蘇循相次淪沒，當用判官盧質。質性疏放，不願重位；求留太原，乃舉定州判官豆盧革，次舉程，即詔征之，並命為平章事。程本非重器，驟曆顯位，舉止不恒。時朝廷草創，庶物未備，班列蕭然，寺署多缺。程、革受命之日，即乘肩輿，騶導喧沸。莊宗聞訶導之聲，詢於左右，曰：「宰相擔子入門。」莊宗駭異，登樓視之，笑曰：「所謂似是而非者也。」頃之，遣程使晉陽宮冊皇太后。山路險阻，往復綿邈，程安坐肩輿，所至州縣，驅率丁夫，長吏迎謁，拜伏輿前，少有忤意，因加笞辱。

context.beforeSource: 後曆觀察判官。
context.afterSource: 及汴將王彥章陷德勝南城，爭攻楊劉，莊宗禦軍苦戰，臣下憂之，鹹白宰臣，欲連章規諫，請不躬禦士伍。
context.beforeLocal: 後曆觀察判官。
context.afterLocal: 及汴將王彥章陷德勝南城，爭攻楊劉，莊宗禦軍苦戰，臣下憂之，鹹白宰臣，欲連章規諫，請不躬禦士伍。

manualTranslations.zh: 莊宗將即位，求四鎮判官可為宰輔者。
manualTranslations.literal: As Emperor Zhuangzong was about to take the throne, he sought adjutants from the four circuits who could serve as chief ministers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As Emperor Zhuangzong prepared to take the throne, he looked for adjutants from the four circuits who could serve as chief ministers.

manualTranslations.zh: 時盧汝弼、蘇循相次淪沒，當用判官盧質。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Lu Rubi and Su Xun had successively perished; the adjutant Lu Zhi was the one to be used.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By then Lu Rubi and Su Xun had successively died, and adjutant Lu Zhi was the man for the post.

manualTranslations.zh: 質性疏放，不願重位；
manualTranslations.literal: Zhi was by nature easygoing and unrestrained, and did not wish for a weighty post;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhi was easygoing by nature and did not want a weighty post;

manualTranslations.zh: 求留太原，乃舉定州判官豆盧革，次舉程，即詔征之，並命為平章事。
manualTranslations.literal: he asked to remain at Taiyuan and therefore recommended Dou Luge, adjutant of Dingzhou, and next recommended Cheng; both were summoned by edict and appointed Grand Councilors.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He asked to stay at Taiyuan and recommended Dou Luge, adjutant of Dingzhou, then Cheng. Both were summoned by edict and appointed Grand Councilors.

manualTranslations.zh: 程本非重器，驟曆顯位，舉止不恒。
manualTranslations.literal: Cheng was never material for great office, yet he suddenly rose through eminent ranks and his conduct was unsteady.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cheng was not material for high office, yet he suddenly rose to eminent rank and his conduct was erratic.

manualTranslations.zh: 時朝廷草創，庶物未備，班列蕭然，寺署多缺。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the court was newly founded, goods were not yet in order, the ranks of officials stood sparse, and many monasteries and offices were vacant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The court was still being founded, supplies were not yet in order, the official ranks stood sparse, and many monasteries and offices were vacant.

manualTranslations.zh: 程、革受命之日，即乘肩輿，騶導喧沸。
manualTranslations.literal: On the day Cheng and Ge received their commissions they at once rode in sedan chairs, with herald escorts clamorous and bustling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The day Cheng and Ge received their commissions, they at once rode in sedan chairs with herald escorts clamoring about them.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊宗聞訶導之聲，詢於左右，曰：「宰相擔子入門。」
manualTranslations.literal: Zhuangzong heard the sound of heralds shouting and asked those beside him, saying: "The chief ministers are entering in sedan chairs."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong heard the heralds shouting and asked those beside him, "The chief ministers are entering in sedan chairs."

manualTranslations.zh: 莊宗駭異，登樓視之，笑曰：「所謂似是而非者也。」
manualTranslations.literal: Zhuangzong was startled and amazed; he mounted the tower to look and laughed, saying: "This is what they call seeming so yet not being so."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong was startled. He mounted the tower to look and laughed, "This is what they call seeming so yet not being so."

manualTranslations.zh: 頃之，遣程使晉陽宮冊皇太后。
manualTranslations.literal: Shortly afterward he dispatched Cheng to the Jinyang Palace to perform the investiture of the Empress Dowager.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he sent Cheng to the Jinyang Palace to invest the Empress Dowager.

sourceRange.text: 陳乂，薊門人也。少好學，善屬文。因避亂，客於浮陽，轉徙於大梁。梁將張漢傑延於私邸，表授太子舍人。莊宗平梁，郭崇韜遙領常山，召居賓榻。崇韜從魏王繼岌伐蜀，署為招討判官。崇韜死，明宗即位，隨任圜歸闕，圜薦之於朝，除膳部員外郎、知制誥，累遷中書舍人。乂性陰僻，寡與人合，不為當路所與。尋移左散騎常侍，由是忿以成疾，逾月而卒。乂微有才術，嘗自恃其能。為判官日，人有造者，垂帷深處，罕見其面。及居西掖，而姿態愈倨，位竟不至公卿，蓋器度促狹者也。然乂性孤執，尤廉於財。長興中，嘗自舍人銜命冊晉國公主石氏於太原，晉高祖善待之，但訝其高岸。人或有獻可於乂，宜陳一謳頌以稱晉高祖之美，可邀其厚賄耳。乂曰：「人生貧富，咸有定分，未有持天子命違禮以求利，既損國綱，且虧士行，乂今生所不為也。」聞者嘉之。晉高祖即位，贈禮部尚書。

manualTranslations.zh: 陳乂，薊門人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Chen Yi was a man of Jimen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chen Yi was a native of Jimen.

manualTranslations.zh: 少好學，善屬文。
manualTranslations.literal: In youth he loved learning and was skilled at literary composition.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth he loved learning and was skilled at literary composition.

manualTranslations.zh: 因避亂，客於浮陽，轉徙於大梁。
manualTranslations.literal: To escape the turmoil he stayed as a guest in Fuyang and then moved to Daliang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: To escape the turmoil he lived as a guest in Fuyang and then moved to Daliang.

manualTranslations.zh: 梁將張漢傑延於私邸，表授太子舍人。
manualTranslations.literal: The Liang general Zhang Hanjie invited him to his private residence and memorialized his appointment as Attendant of the Heir Apparent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Liang general Zhang Hanjie invited him to his private residence and memorialized his appointment as attendant of the heir apparent.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊宗平梁，郭崇韜遙領常山，召居賓榻。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhuangzong pacified Liang, Guo Chongtao held distant charge of Changshan and summoned him to his guest couch.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong pacified Liang, Guo Chongtao held distant charge of Changshan and summoned him to his guest couch.

manualTranslations.zh: 崇韜從魏王繼岌伐蜀，署為招討判官。
manualTranslations.literal: When Chongtao followed the Prince of Wei Jiji in the campaign against Shu, he appointed him pacification commissioner-assessor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Chongtao followed the Prince of Wei Jiji in the campaign against Shu, he appointed him pacification commissioner-assessor.

manualTranslations.zh: 崇韜死，明宗即位，隨任圜歸闕，圜薦之於朝，除膳部員外郎、知制誥，累遷中書舍人。
manualTranslations.literal: After Chongtao died and Mingzong took the throne, he followed Ren Yuan back to court; Yuan recommended him to the court, and he was appointed Vice Director of the Board of Provisions and Drafting Commissioner, then successively promoted to Secretariat Drafting Secretary.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Chongtao died and Mingzong took the throne, he followed Ren Yuan back to court. Yuan recommended him, and he was appointed vice director of the Board of Provisions and drafting commissioner, then rose to Secretariat drafting secretary.

manualTranslations.zh: 乂性陰僻，寡與人合，不為當路所與。
manualTranslations.literal: Yi's nature was dark and withdrawn; he seldom got along with others and was not favored by those in power.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yi was secretive and withdrawn, seldom got along with others, and was not favored by those in power.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋移左散騎常侍，由是忿以成疾，逾月而卒。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Left Honorary Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary; thereby resentment became illness, and after more than a month he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred to left honorary cavalier attendant-in-ordinary. Resentment turned to illness, and after more than a month he died.

manualTranslations.zh: 乂微有才術，嘗自恃其能。
manualTranslations.literal: Yi had modest talent and skill and once relied on his own ability.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yi had modest talent and once relied heavily on his own ability.

manualTranslations.zh: 為判官日，人有造者，垂帷深處，罕見其面。
manualTranslations.literal: When he was an assessor, if someone came to visit him he would hang curtains deep within and rarely show his face.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: While serving as an assessor, when visitors came he hung curtains deep within and rarely showed his face.

manualTranslations.zh: 及居西掖，而姿態愈倨，位竟不至公卿，蓋器度促狹者也。
manualTranslations.literal: When he held office in the western secretariat his bearing became all the more haughty; in the end his rank never reached the highest offices—likely because his capacity was narrow and cramped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Once he held office in the western secretariat his bearing grew all the more haughty. In the end his rank never reached the highest offices—likely because his capacity was narrow.

manualTranslations.zh: 然乂性孤執，尤廉於財。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet Yi's nature was solitary and stubborn, and he was especially scrupulous about money.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet Yi was solitary and stubborn and especially scrupulous about money.

manualTranslations.zh: 長興中，嘗自舍人銜命冊晉國公主石氏於太原，晉高祖善待之，但訝其高岸。
manualTranslations.literal: During Changxing, as drafting secretary he carried orders to invest Princess Shi of the Jin state at Taiyuan; the Gaozu of Jin treated him well but was surprised at his lofty and stern bearing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Changxing, as drafting secretary he carried orders to invest Princess Shi of Jin at Taiyuan. The Gaozu of Jin treated him well but was surprised at his lofty and stern bearing.

manualTranslations.zh: 人或有獻可於乂，宜陳一謳頌以稱晉高祖之美，可邀其厚賄耳。
manualTranslations.literal: Some advised Yi that he should present a eulogy praising the beauty of the Gaozu of Jin and thereby win a generous reward.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Some advised Yi to present a eulogy praising the Gaozu of Jin and thereby win a generous reward.

manualTranslations.zh: 乂曰：「人生貧富，咸有定分，未有持天子命違禮以求利，既損國綱，且虧士行，乂今生所不為也。」
manualTranslations.literal: Yi said: "Whether one's life is poor or rich has its fixed allotment; there has never been one who held Heaven's Son's command yet violated ritual to seek profit—this harms the state's norms and moreover shames the scholar's conduct; this is something Yi will never do in this life."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yi said, "Whether life is poor or rich has its fixed allotment. No one who bears Heaven's Son's command should violate ritual to seek profit—this harms the state's norms and shames a scholar's conduct. That is something I will never do in this life."

manualTranslations.zh: 聞者嘉之。
manualTranslations.literal: Those who heard praised him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those who heard praised him.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉高祖即位，贈禮部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Gaozu of Jin took the throne, he was posthumously awarded Minister of Rites.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Gaozu of Jin took the throne, Yi was posthumously awarded minister of rites.

sourceRange.text: 劉延皓，應州渾元人。祖建立，父茂成，皆以軍功推為邊將。延皓即劉後之弟也。末帝鎮鳳翔，署延皓元隨都校，奏加檢校戶部尚書。清泰元年，除宮苑使，加檢校司空。俄改宣徽南院使、檢校司徒。二年，遷樞密使、太保，出為鄴都留守、檢校太傅。延皓禦軍失政，為屯將張令昭所逐，出奔相州，尋詔停所任。及晉高祖入洛，延皓逃匿龍門廣化寺，數日，自經而死。延皓始以後戚自藩邸出入左右，甚以溫厚見稱，故末帝嗣位之後，委居近密。及出鎮大名，而所執一變，掠人財賄，納人園宅，聚歌僮為長夜之飲，而三軍所給不時，內外怨之，因為令昭所逐。時執政以延皓失守，請舉舊章，末帝以劉後內政之故，止從罷免而已，由是清泰之政弊矣。

context.beforeSource: 其後以選求計使，難得其人，甚追悔焉。
context.afterSource: 劉延朗，宋州虞城人也。

manualTranslations.literal: Liu Yanhao was a man of Hunyuan in Yingzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liu Yanhao was a native of Hunyuan in Yingzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 祖建立，父茂成，皆以軍功推為邊將。
manualTranslations.literal: His grandfather Jianli and his father Maocheng were both promoted to frontier generals for military merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His grandfather Jianli and his father Maocheng were both promoted to frontier generals for military merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 延皓即劉後之弟也。
manualTranslations.literal: Yanhao was the younger brother of Empress Liu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yanhao was the younger brother of Empress Liu.

manualTranslations.zh: 末帝鎮鳳翔，署延皓元隨都校，奏加檢校戶部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Last Emperor was posted at Fengxiang he appointed Yanhao commander of his original followers and memorialized to add acting minister of revenue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Last Emperor was posted at Fengxiang he appointed Yanhao commander of his original followers and memorialized to add acting minister of revenue.

manualTranslations.zh: 清泰元年，除宮苑使，加檢校司空。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Qingtai he was made palace park commissioner and promoted to acting minister of works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qingtai he was made palace park commissioner and promoted to acting minister of works.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄改宣徽南院使、檢校司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon afterward he was changed to commissioner of the southern bureau of the Palace Domestic Service and acting Grand Mentor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was changed to commissioner of the southern bureau of the Palace Domestic Service and acting Grand Mentor.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，遷樞密使、太保，出為鄴都留守、檢校太傅。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year he was transferred to commissioner of military affairs and Grand Guardian, then sent out as intendant at Ye and acting Grand Tutor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year he was transferred to commissioner of military affairs and Grand Guardian, then sent out as intendant at Ye and acting Grand Tutor.

manualTranslations.zh: 延皓禦軍失政，為屯將張令昭所逐，出奔相州，尋詔停所任。
manualTranslations.literal: Yanhao governed the army badly; the garrison officer Zhang Lingzhao expelled him, he fled to Xiangzhou, and soon an edict stripped him of office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yanhao governed the army badly; the garrison officer Zhang Lingzhao expelled him, he fled to Xiangzhou, and soon an edict stripped him of office.

manualTranslations.zh: 及晉高祖入洛，延皓逃匿龍門廣化寺，數日，自經而死。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Gaozu of Jin entered Luoyang, Yanhao hid in the Guanghua Temple at Longmen; after several days he hanged himself.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Gaozu of Jin entered Luoyang, Yanhao hid in Guanghua Temple at Longmen; after several days he hanged himself.

manualTranslations.zh: 延皓始以後戚自藩邸出入左右，甚以溫厚見稱，故末帝嗣位之後，委居近密。
manualTranslations.literal: At first Yanhao, as a maternal relative from the princely household, came and went at the sovereign's side and was greatly praised for his mildness; therefore after the Last Emperor succeeded to the throne he was entrusted with intimate duties.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first Yanhao, as a maternal relative from the princely household, came and went at the sovereign's side and was greatly praised for his mildness; therefore after the Last Emperor succeeded to the throne he was entrusted with intimate duties.

manualTranslations.zh: 及出鎮大名，而所執一變，掠人財賄，納人園宅，聚歌僮為長夜之飲，而三軍所給不時，內外怨之，因為令昭所逐。
manualTranslations.literal: But when he went out to command at Daming his conduct changed entirely: he seized people's wealth as bribes, took their gardens and residences, gathered singing boys for all-night drinking, and paid the three armies' supplies irregularly; inside and outside complained of him, and thereby he was expelled by Lingzhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: But when he went out to command at Daming his conduct changed entirely: he seized people's wealth as bribes, took their gardens and residences, gathered singing boys for all-night drinking, and paid the three armies' supplies irregularly; inside and outside complained of him, and thereby he was expelled by Lingzhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 時執政以延皓失守，請舉舊章，末帝以劉後內政之故，止從罷免而已，由是清泰之政弊矣。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the chief ministers, because Yanhao had lost his command, asked to apply the old regulations; the Last Emperor, because of Empress Liu's influence in the inner court, only went so far as dismissal—thereby the government of Qingtai was harmed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time the chief ministers, because Yanhao had lost his command, asked to apply the old regulations; the Last Emperor, because of Empress Liu's influence in the inner court, only went so far as dismissal—thereby the government of Qingtai was harmed.

sourceRange.text: 思立本出陰山諸部，性純厚，善撫將士，明宗素重之，故即位之始，以應州所生之地授焉。其後曆三郡三鎮，皆得百姓之譽。末帝以其年高，征居環衛。及出幸懷州，以北師不利，乃命思立統駕下騎軍赴團柏穀以益軍勢，俄而楊光遠以大軍降於太原，思立因憤激，疾作而卒焉。晉高祖即位，追其宿舊，為輟朝一日，贈太子少師。

manualTranslations.zh: 思立本出陰山諸部，性純厚，善撫將士，明宗素重之，故即位之始，以應州所生之地授焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Sili was originally from the tribes of Yinshan. His nature was pure and generous, and he was skilled at comforting officers and soldiers. Mingzong had long valued him, so at the start of his enthronement he granted him the place of his birth in Ying Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sili was originally from the Yinshan tribes. Pure and generous by nature, he was skilled at winning over officers and soldiers. Mingzong had long valued him, and at the start of his reign granted him his birthplace in Ying Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 其後曆三郡三鎮，皆得百姓之譽。
manualTranslations.literal: Afterward he passed through three prefectures and three garrisons, and in each won the praise of the common people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He later served in three prefectures and three garrisons, winning the people's praise in each.

manualTranslations.zh: 末帝以其年高，征居環衛。
manualTranslations.literal: The Last Emperor, because of his advanced age, summoned him to dwell in the palace guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because of his advanced age, the Last Emperor summoned him to serve in the palace guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 及出幸懷州，以北師不利，乃命思立統駕下騎軍赴團柏穀以益軍勢，俄而楊光遠以大軍降於太原，思立因憤激，疾作而卒焉。
manualTranslations.literal: When the emperor went on an excursion to Huaizhou and the northern army fared poorly, he ordered Sili to command the cavalry under the imperial escort to Tuanbai Valley to strengthen the army. Soon afterward Yang Guangyuan surrendered his great army at Taiyuan; Sili, stirred by indignation, fell ill and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the emperor visited Huaizhou and the northern army fared poorly, he ordered Sili to lead the cavalry of the imperial escort to Tuanbai Valley to reinforce the army. Soon Yang Guangyuan surrendered his great army at Taiyuan; stirred to fury, Sili fell ill and died.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉高祖即位，追其宿舊，為輟朝一日，贈太子少師。
manualTranslations.literal: When Jin Gaozu took the throne, he recalled their old friendship, halted court for one day, and posthumously enfeoffed him as Vice Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Jin Gaozu took the throne, he honored their old friendship by halting court for one day and posthumously enfeoffing him as Vice Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sourceRange.text: ）末帝聞其歿也，愴慟久之。契丹主告其部曲及漢之降者曰：「為臣當如此人！」令部人收葬之。晉高祖即位後，所有田宅，鹹賜其妻子焉。時議者以敬達嘗事數帝，亟立軍功，及領藩郡，不聞其濫，繼屯守塞垣，復能撫下，而臨難固執，不求苟免，乃近代之忠臣也。晉有天下，不能追懋官封，賞其事跡，非激忠之道也。

context.beforeSource: 清晨，光遠上謁，見敬達左右無人，遂殺之。
context.beforeLocal: 清晨，光遠上謁，見敬達左右無人，遂殺之。

manualTranslations.zh: ）末帝聞其歿也，愴慟久之。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Last Emperor heard of his death, he mourned deeply for a long time.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Last Emperor heard of his death, he mourned deeply for a long time.

manualTranslations.zh: 契丹主告其部曲及漢之降者曰：「為臣當如此人！」
manualTranslations.literal: The Khitan ruler told his subordinates and the Han who had surrendered, saying: "A subject ought to be like this man!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Khitan ruler told his followers and the Han who had surrendered, "A subject ought to be like this man!"

manualTranslations.zh: 令部人收葬之。
manualTranslations.literal: He ordered his followers to gather and bury him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He ordered his men to gather and bury him.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉高祖即位後，所有田宅，鹹賜其妻子焉。
manualTranslations.literal: After Jin Gaozu took the throne, all his fields and residences were bestowed upon his wife and children.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Jin Gaozu took the throne, all his fields and residences were bestowed upon his wife and children.

manualTranslations.zh: 時議者以敬達嘗事數帝，亟立軍功，及領藩郡，不聞其濫，繼屯守塞垣，復能撫下，而臨難固執，不求苟免，乃近代之忠臣也。
manualTranslations.literal: Commentators of the time held that Jingda had served several emperors, repeatedly won military merit, and when governing frontier prefectures was never heard to abuse his power; he then guarded the border ramparts, could still comfort his subordinates, and when facing hardship stood firm and did not seek to escape at any cost—he was a loyal minister of recent times.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Commentators held that Jingda had served several emperors, won repeated military honors, and when governing frontier prefectures was never known to abuse his power; he then guarded the border, could still win over his men, and when facing hardship stood firm rather than seek escape—a loyal minister of recent times.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉有天下，不能追懋官封，賞其事跡，非激忠之道也。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet when Jin possessed the realm it could not posthumously ennoble him with high offices and reward his deeds—this was no way to stir loyalty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet once Jin held the realm it failed to posthumously ennoble him with high honors and reward his deeds—hardly the way to stir loyalty.

sourceRange.text: 藥縱之，太原人，少為儒。明宗刺代州，署為軍事衙推。從明宗鎮邢州，為掌書記，曆天平、宣武兩鎮節度副使。明宗鎮常山，被病不從。及即位，縱之見於洛邑，安重誨怒其觀望，久無所授。明宗曰：「德勝用兵時，縱之饑寒相伴，不離我左右。今有天下，何人不富貴，何為獨棄縱之！」浹旬，授磁州刺史。歲餘，自戶部侍郎遷吏部侍郎，銓總之法，惘然莫知。長興初，為曹州刺史。清泰元年九月，以疾受代而卒。

context.beforeSource: 子士明，仕周，終於邑宰。
context.afterSource: 賈馥，故鎮州節度使王鎔判官也。
context.beforeLocal: 子士明，仕周，終於邑宰。
context.afterLocal: 賈馥，故鎮州節度使王鎔判官也。

manualTranslations.zh: 藥縱之，太原人，少為儒。
manualTranslations.literal: Yao Zongzhi was a man of Taiyuan. In youth he studied as a Confucian scholar.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yao Zongzhi came from Taiyuan and in youth pursued Confucian learning.

manualTranslations.zh: 明宗刺代州，署為軍事衙推。
manualTranslations.literal: When Mingzong was military commissioner at Daizhou, he appointed him military affairs aide.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Mingzong served as military commissioner at Daizhou, he appointed Zongzhi military affairs aide.

manualTranslations.zh: 從明宗鎮邢州，為掌書記，曆天平、宣武兩鎮節度副使。
manualTranslations.literal: Following Mingzong when he governed Xingzhou, he served as chief secretary and passed through vice military commissioner at the Tianping and Xuanwu circuits.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed Mingzong to Xingzhou as chief secretary and later served as vice military commissioner at Tianping and Xuanwu.

manualTranslations.zh: 明宗鎮常山，被病不從。
manualTranslations.literal: When Mingzong governed Changshan, Zongzhi fell ill and did not follow.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Mingzong governed Changshan, illness kept Zongzhi from accompanying him.

manualTranslations.zh: 及即位，縱之見於洛邑，安重誨怒其觀望，久無所授。
manualTranslations.literal: When Mingzong took the throne, Zongzhi appeared at Luoyang; An Chonghui was angered by his hedging and long withheld any appointment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Mingzong took the throne, Zongzhi came to Luoyang; An Chonghui resented his fence-sitting and long gave him no post.

manualTranslations.zh: 明宗曰：「德勝用兵時，縱之饑寒相伴，不離我左右。
manualTranslations.literal: Mingzong said: "When I was campaigning at Desheng, Zongzhi shared hunger and cold with me and never left my side.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Mingzong said, "When I was campaigning at Desheng, Zongzhi shared hunger and cold with me and never left my side.

manualTranslations.zh: 今有天下，何人不富貴，何為獨棄縱之！」
manualTranslations.literal: Now that I have the realm, who would not be enriched—why abandon Zongzhi alone!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now that I have the realm, who would not prosper—why abandon Zongzhi alone!"

manualTranslations.zh: 浹旬，授磁州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Within ten days he was appointed prefect of Cizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Within ten days he was appointed prefect of Cizhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 歲餘，自戶部侍郎遷吏部侍郎，銓總之法，惘然莫知。
manualTranslations.literal: After more than a year he was transferred from Vice Minister of Revenue to Vice Minister of Personnel, but the methods of evaluation and selection were beyond his understanding.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After a year he rose from Vice Minister of Revenue to Vice Minister of Personnel, yet he was at a loss over the methods of evaluation and selection.

manualTranslations.zh: 長興初，為曹州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Early in the Changxing era he was made prefect of Caozhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in the Changxing era he was appointed prefect of Caozhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 清泰元年九月，以疾受代而卒。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month of the first year of Qingtai he was relieved because of illness and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Qingtai 1 he was relieved for illness and died.

sourceRange.text: 夏四月，召為樞密使，加特進，與郭崇韜對掌機務。

sourceRange.text: 康延孝，塞北部落人也。初隸太原，因得罪，亡命於汴梁。開平、乾化中，自隊長積勞至部校。梁末帝時，頻立軍功。同光元年八月，段凝率眾五萬營於王村，時延孝為右先鋒指揮使，率百騎來奔。莊宗得之，喜，解禦衣金帶以賜之。翌日，賜田宅於鄴，以為捧日軍使兼南面招討指揮使、檢校司空，守博州刺史。莊宗屏人問梁兵機，延孝備陳利害，語在《莊宗紀》中。莊宗平汴，延孝頗有力焉，以功授檢校太保、鄭州防禦使，賜姓，名紹琛。明年，郊禮畢，授保義軍節度使。

context.afterSource: 三年，討蜀，以延孝為西南行營馬步軍先鋒、排陣斬斫等使。
context.afterLocal: 三年，討蜀，以延孝為西南行營馬步軍先鋒、排陣斬斫等使。

manualTranslations.zh: 康延孝，塞北部落人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Kang Yanxiao was a man of the northern frontier tribes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kang Yanxiao came from the northern frontier tribes.

manualTranslations.zh: 初隸太原，因得罪，亡命於汴梁。
manualTranslations.literal: At first he was subordinated to Taiyuan; having offended, he fled his life to Bianliang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He first served under Taiyuan; after committing an offense he fled to Bianliang.

manualTranslations.zh: 開平、乾化中，自隊長積勞至部校。
manualTranslations.literal: During Kaiping and Qianhua, through accumulated service he rose from squad leader to company commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Kaiping and Qianhua reigns he worked his way up from squad leader to company commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 梁末帝時，頻立軍功。
manualTranslations.literal: Under Liang's Last Emperor, he repeatedly won military merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under the Last Emperor of Liang he won military honors again and again.

manualTranslations.zh: 同光元年八月，段凝率眾五萬營於王村，時延孝為右先鋒指揮使，率百騎來奔。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Tongguang, Duan Ning led fifty thousand troops and encamped at Wang Village; at that time Yanxiao was Right Vanguard Commander and led a hundred horsemen to defect.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Tongguang 1, Duan Ning camped at Wang Village with fifty thousand men. Yanxiao, then Right Vanguard Commander, came over with a hundred riders.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊宗得之，喜，解禦衣金帶以賜之。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhuangzong received him, rejoiced, and removed his imperial robe and gold belt to bestow them on him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong welcomed him gladly, stripped off his own imperial robe and gold belt, and gave them to him.

manualTranslations.zh: 翌日，賜田宅於鄴，以為捧日軍使兼南面招討指揮使、檢校司空，守博州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: The next day he bestowed fields and a residence at Ye, appointing him commander of the Sun-Rising Army and simultaneous southern-route pacification commander, acting Sikong, and defender of Bo Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next day he granted him fields and a house at Ye and made him commander of the Sun-Rising Army, southern-route pacification commander, acting Sikong, and defender of Bo Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊宗屏人問梁兵機，延孝備陳利害，語在《莊宗紀》中。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhuangzong dismissed attendants and questioned him on Liang military affairs; Yanxiao fully set forth advantages and disadvantages—the account is in the "Annals of Zhuangzong."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong sent everyone else away and asked about Liang's military situation. Yanxiao laid out the pros and cons in full; the account appears in the "Annals of Zhuangzong."

manualTranslations.zh: 莊宗平汴，延孝頗有力焉，以功授檢校太保、鄭州防禦使，賜姓，名紹琛。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhuangzong pacified Bian, Yanxiao contributed considerably; for his merit he was appointed acting Grand Guardian and Zhengzhou defense commissioner, granted the surname with the name Shaochen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong took Bian, Yanxiao had done much to help. For his service he was made acting Grand Guardian and Zhengzhou defense commissioner and granted the surname with the name Shaochen.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，郊禮畢，授保義軍節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year, after the suburban rites were completed, he was appointed military commissioner of the Baoyi Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The following year, after the suburban sacrifices, he was appointed military commissioner of the Baoyi Army.

sourceRange.text: 長興元年二月，明宗南郊禮畢，加檢校太尉，增食邑五百戶，尋詔歸任。時鄴都繁富為天下之冠，而土俗獷悍，民多爭訟，帝令投函府門，一一覽之，及逾年，盈積几案，滯於獄者甚眾，時論以此減之。九月，東川董璋叛，朝廷命帝為東川行營都招討使，兼知東川行府事。十月，至自魏博，董眾西征。二年春，以川路險艱，糧運不繼，詔班師。四月，復兼六軍諸衛副使。六月，改河陽節度使，仍兼兵柄。

context.beforeSource: 五月丁未，加駙馬都尉。
context.afterSource: 是時，秦王從榮奏：「伏見北面頻奏報，契丹族移帳近塞，吐渾、突厥已侵邊地，戍兵雖多，未有統帥，早宜命大將一人，以安雲、朔。
context.beforeLocal: 五月丁未，加駙馬都尉。
context.afterLocal: 是時，秦王從榮奏：「伏見北面頻奏報，契丹族移帳近塞，吐渾、突厥已侵邊地，戍兵雖多，未有統帥，早宜命大將一人，以安雲、朔。

manualTranslations.zh: 長興元年二月，明宗南郊禮畢，加檢校太尉，增食邑五百戶，尋詔歸任。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Changxing, when Mingzong had completed the southern suburban sacrifice, he added for the Emperor the title of Honorary Grand Commandant, increased his fief by five hundred households, and soon ordered him to return to his post.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Changxing, when Mingzong had completed the southern suburban sacrifice, he added for the Emperor the title of Honorary Grand Commandant, increased his fief by five hundred households, and soon ordered him to return to his post.

manualTranslations.zh: 時鄴都繁富為天下之冠，而土俗獷悍，民多爭訟，帝令投函府門，一一覽之，及逾年，盈積几案，滯於獄者甚眾，時論以此減之。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Yedu was the wealthiest place under heaven, but local customs were fierce and truculent and the people were much given to lawsuits. The Emperor ordered that complaint letters be deposited in a box at the government gate, and he read each one in turn. After more than a year the desks were piled full, and many cases backloged in the courts; contemporary opinion lowered its estimate of him on this account.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time Yedu was the wealthiest place under heaven, but local customs were fierce and truculent and the people were much given to lawsuits. The Emperor ordered that complaint letters be deposited in a box at the government gate and read each one himself. After more than a year his desks were piled high, and many cases backloged in the courts; contemporary opinion lowered its estimate of him on this account.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月，東川董璋叛，朝廷命帝為東川行營都招討使，兼知東川行府事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month Dong Zhang of Dongchuan rebelled; the court appointed the Emperor eastern campaign marshal and commander-in-chief of the Dongchuan expeditionary forces, with concurrent control of the Dongchuan expeditionary headquarters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Dong Zhang of Dongchuan rebelled. The court appointed the Emperor commander-in-chief of the Dongchuan expeditionary forces and gave him concurrent control of the Dongchuan expeditionary headquarters.

manualTranslations.zh: 十月，至自魏博，董眾西征。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth month, having returned from Weibo, he led the host west on campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, having returned from Weibo, he led the army west on campaign.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年春，以川路險艱，糧運不繼，詔班師。
manualTranslations.literal: In the spring of the second year, because the Sichuan routes were perilous and arduous and grain transport could not keep up, an edict ordered withdrawal of the army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the spring of the second year, because the Sichuan routes were perilous and arduous and grain transport could not keep up, an edict ordered withdrawal of the army.

manualTranslations.zh: 四月，復兼六軍諸衛副使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth month he was again made concurrent deputy commander of the Six Armies and various guards.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he was again made concurrent deputy commander of the Six Armies and various guards.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月，改河陽節度使，仍兼兵柄。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month he was transferred to military commissioner of Heyang, while retaining command of the army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he was transferred to military commissioner of Heyang while retaining command of the army.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月戊午，鴻臚卿劉頎卒，贈太子賓客。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, on wuwu, Director of the Court for Dependencies Liu Qi died and was posthumously granted Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the third month, Liu Qi, director of the Court for Dependencies, died and was posthumously made Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬戌，東上閣門使、前司農卿蘇繼顏改鴻臚卿充職。
manualTranslations.literal: On renxu, Su Jiyan, Commissioner of the Eastern Upper Gate and former Director of the Directorate of Agriculture, was changed to Director of the Court for Dependencies with concurrent duty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renxu, Su Jiyan, Eastern Upper Gate commissioner and former director of agriculture, was transferred to director of the Court for Dependencies with concurrent duty.

manualTranslations.zh: 回鶻可汗王仁美進野馬、獨峰駝、玉團、碙砂等方物。
manualTranslations.literal: The Uyghur qaghan Renmei presented wild horses, single-hump camels, jade orbs, sal ammoniac, and other local products.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Uyghur qaghan Renmei presented wild horses, dromedaries, jade orbs, sal ammoniac, and other tribute goods.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲戌，永壽長公主薨，輟朝一日。
manualTranslations.literal: On jiaxu, Princess Yongshou died; court audiences were suspended for one day.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Princess Yongshou died, and court audiences were suspended for one day.

manualTranslations.zh: 故涇州節度觀察留後盧順密贈右驍衛上將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: The late acting military commissioner of Jing, Lu Shunmi, was posthumously granted Senior General of the Right Brave Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lu Shunmi, late acting Jing military commissioner, was posthumously made Senior General of the Right Brave Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁丑，詔禁止私下打造鑄瀉銅器。
manualTranslations.literal: On dingchou, an edict prohibited privately forging and casting copper vessels.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingchou an edict forbade the private forging and casting of copper vessels.

sourceRange.text: 十一月丁未，鄭王夫人張氏薨。福州王延羲遣使貢方物。甲寅，遣太子賓客聶延祚、吏部郎中盧撰持節冊天下兵馬元帥、守尚書令、吳越國王錢元瓘。甲子，以御史中丞王松為尚書右丞，中書舍人、史館修撰判館事王易簡為御史中丞，戶部侍郎張昭遠為兵部侍郎，國子祭酒田敏以本官兼戶部侍郎。辛未，太妃、皇后至自東京。壬申，遣給事中李式、考功郎中張鑄持節冊閩國王王延羲。甲戌，太子少傅致仕王權卒，贈左僕射。丁丑，襄州安從進舉兵叛，以西京留守高行周為南面行營都部署，率兵討之，以前同州節度使宋彥筠為副，以宣徽南院使張從恩監護焉。

context.beforeSource: 壬寅，詔唐梁國公狄仁傑可贈太師。
context.afterSource: 十二月丙戌朔，以東京留守、開封尹、鄭王重貴為廣晉尹，進封齊王；

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月丁未，鄭王夫人張氏薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On dingwei in the eleventh month, Lady Zhang, wife of the Prince of Zheng, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the eleventh month, Lady Zhang, consort of the Prince of Zheng, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 福州王延羲遣使貢方物。
manualTranslations.literal: Wang Yanxi of Fuzhou dispatched envoys to present local products.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Yanxi of Fuzhou sent envoys bearing local tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲寅，遣太子賓客聶延祚、吏部郎中盧撰持節冊天下兵馬元帥、守尚書令、吳越國王錢元瓘。
manualTranslations.literal: On jiayin, Nie Yanzuo, Mentor of the Heir Apparent, and Lu Zhuan, Bureau Director in the Ministry of Personnel, were dispatched with credentials to invest Qian Yuanguan, Commander-in-Chief of All Armies Under Heaven, Acting Director of the Chancellery, and King of Wuyue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Mentor of the Heir Apparent Nie Yanzuo and Personnel Bureau Director Lu Zhuan were sent with credentials to invest Commander-in-Chief of All Armies Under Heaven Qian Yuanguan, Acting Director of the Chancellery and King of Wuyue.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲子，以御史中丞王松為尚書右丞，中書舍人、史館修撰判館事王易簡為御史中丞，戶部侍郎張昭遠為兵部侍郎，國子祭酒田敏以本官兼戶部侍郎。
manualTranslations.literal: On jiazi, Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Song was made Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs; Wang Yijian, Secretariat Drafter and compiler of the Historiography Institute administering its affairs, was made Vice Censor-in-Chief; Vice Minister of Revenue Zhang Zhaoyuan was made Vice Minister of War; and Tian Min, Director of the Imperial University, retained his office and was made concurrent Vice Minister of Revenue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Song became Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs; Secretariat Drafter and Historiography Institute compiler Wang Yijian became Vice Censor-in-Chief; Vice Minister of Revenue Zhang Zhaoyuan became Vice Minister of War; and Imperial University Director Tian Min kept his post and was made concurrent Vice Minister of Revenue.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛未，太妃、皇后至自東京。
manualTranslations.literal: On xinwei, the Imperial Consort and Empress arrived from the Eastern Capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the Imperial Consort and Empress returned from the Eastern Capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬申，遣給事中李式、考功郎中張鑄持節冊閩國王王延羲。
manualTranslations.literal: On renshen, Supervising Secretary Li Shi and Bureau Director in the Ministry of Personnel for merit evaluation Zhang Zhu were dispatched with credentials to invest Wang Yanxi as King of Min.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renshen, Supervising Secretary Li Shi and Personnel merit-evaluation Bureau Director Zhang Zhu were sent with credentials to invest Wang Yanxi as King of Min.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲戌，太子少傅致仕王權卒，贈左僕射。
manualTranslations.literal: On jiaxu, Wang Quan, retired Mentor of the Heir Apparent, died and was posthumously granted Left Vice Director.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, retired Mentor of the Heir Apparent Wang Quan died and was posthumously made Left Vice Director.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁丑，襄州安從進舉兵叛，以西京留守高行周為南面行營都部署，率兵討之，以前同州節度使宋彥筠為副，以宣徽南院使張從恩監護焉。
manualTranslations.literal: On dingchou, An Congjin of Xiangzhou raised troops in rebellion; Gao Xingzhou, defender of the Western Capital, was made overall commander of the southern field camp to lead troops against him, with Song Yanyun, former military commissioner of Tongzhou, as deputy and Zhang Congen, Southern Chancellor of the Palace Secretariat, as overseer.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingchou, An Congjin of Xiangzhou rebelled and took up arms. Western Capital defender Gao Xingzhou was made southern field commander to lead troops against him, with former Tongzhou commissioner Song Yanyun as deputy and Southern Palace Secretariat Chancellor Zhang Congen as overseer.

sourceRange.text: 二月壬戌朔，日有蝕之。詔滑州皇甫遇率兵援糧入易、定等州。甲子，以滄州留後王景為本州節度使。右僕射和凝逐月別給錢五萬、傔糧芻粟等，優舊相也。辛未，魯國大長公主史氏薨，輟朝三日。丙子，光祿卿致仕王宏贄卒，贈太常卿。回鶻遣使貢方物。升桂州全義縣為溥州，仍隸桂州，其全義縣改為德昌縣，從湖南馬希範所請也。壬午，以前晉昌軍節度使安彥威充北面行營副都統，以宣徽北院使兼太府卿孟承誨為右武衛大將軍充職；是日幸南莊，命臣僚泛舟飲酒，因幸杜威園，醉方歸內。甲申，河陽節度使李從溫薨，輟朝，贈太師。

context.beforeSource: 延壽奉命於磁州檢苗，受贓二百餘匹，準律當絞，有司以二王後入議，故貸其死。
context.afterSource: 三月壬辰朔，以權知河西節度使張遵古為河西留後。
context.beforeLocal: 延壽奉命於磁州檢苗，受贓二百餘匹，準律當絞，有司以二王後入議，故貸其死。
context.afterLocal: 三月壬辰朔，以權知河西節度使張遵古為河西留後。

manualTranslations.zh: 二月壬戌朔，日有蝕之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, on the first day renxu, there was an eclipse of the sun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the first day renxu of the second month there was a solar eclipse.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔滑州皇甫遇率兵援糧入易、定等州。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict ordered Huangfu Yu of Hua Prefecture to lead troops escorting grain into Yi, Ding, and other prefectures.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Huangfu Yu of Hua to lead troops escorting grain into Yi, Ding, and other prefectures.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲子，以滄州留後王景為本州節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: On jiazi, Wang Jing, acting commander of Cang Prefecture, was made military commissioner of that prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiazi Wang Jing, Cang acting commander, became military commissioner of Cang.

manualTranslations.zh: 右僕射和凝逐月別給錢五萬、傔糧芻粟等，優舊相也。
manualTranslations.literal: He Ning, Right Vice Director, was separately given fifty thousand strings of cash each month along with attendant provisions of grain and fodder—a favor to a former chief counselor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Right Vice Director He Ning was granted fifty thousand cash monthly plus attendant grain and fodder—a favor to a former chief counselor.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛未，魯國大長公主史氏薨，輟朝三日。
manualTranslations.literal: On xinwei, Grand Princess of Lu of the Shi clan died; court audiences were suspended for three days.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinwei Grand Princess of Lu of the Shi clan died; court was suspended for three days.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙子，光祿卿致仕王宏贄卒，贈太常卿。
manualTranslations.literal: On bingzi, retired Director of the Imperial Household Wang Hongzan died; he was posthumously made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On bingzi retired Director of the Imperial Household Wang Hongzan died and was posthumously made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

manualTranslations.zh: 回鶻遣使貢方物。
manualTranslations.literal: The Uyghurs sent envoys presenting local products.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Uyghurs sent tribute envoys with local products.

manualTranslations.zh: 升桂州全義縣為溥州，仍隸桂州，其全義縣改為德昌縣，從湖南馬希範所請也。
manualTranslations.literal: Quanyi County of Gui Prefecture was elevated to Pu Prefecture while remaining subordinate to Gui; Quanyi County was changed to Dechang County, pursuant to the request of Ma Xifan of Hunan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Quanyi County of Gui was elevated to Pu Prefecture, still subordinate to Gui; Quanyi was renamed Dechang County at the request of Ma Xifan of Hunan.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬午，以前晉昌軍節度使安彥威充北面行營副都統，以宣徽北院使兼太府卿孟承誨為右武衛大將軍充職；
manualTranslations.literal: On renwu, An Yanwei, former military commissioner of the Jinchang Army, was appointed deputy overall commander of the Northern Circuit field headquarters; Meng Chenghui, Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat and Concurrent Director of the Imperial Treasury, was made General of the Right Martial Guard while retaining his commission;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renwu former Jinchang commissioner An Yanwei became deputy northern commander, and Northern Bureau Commissioner and Concurrent Director of the Imperial Treasury Meng Chenghui became General of the Right Martial Guard while retaining his post;

manualTranslations.zh: 是日幸南莊，命臣僚泛舟飲酒，因幸杜威園，醉方歸內。
manualTranslations.literal: That day the emperor visited the Southern Estate, ordered officials to banquet on boats, and also visited Du Wei's garden; only when drunk did he return to the palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That day he visited the Southern Estate and ordered officials boating and drinking; he also visited Du Wei's garden and returned to the palace drunk.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲申，河陽節度使李從溫薨，輟朝，贈太師。
manualTranslations.literal: On jiashen, Li Congwen, military commissioner of Heyang, died; court audiences were suspended, and he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiashen Heyang commissioner Li Congwen died; audiences were suspended and he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.

sourceRange.text: 漢乾祐元年四月，永康王至遼陽，帝與太后並詣帳中，帝御白衣紗帽，永康止之，以常服謁見。帝伏地雨泣，自陳過咎，永康使左右扶帝上殿，慰勞久之，因命設樂行酒，從容而罷。永康帳下從官及教坊內人望見故主，不勝悲咽，內人皆以衣帛藥餌獻遺於帝。及永康發離遼陽，取內官十五人、東西班十五人及皇子延煦，並令隨帳上陘，陘即蕃王避暑之地也。有禪奴舍利者，即永康之妻兄也，知帝有小公主在室，詣帝求之，帝辭以年幼不可。又有東西班數輩善於歌唱，禪奴又請之，帝乃與之。後數日，永康王馳取帝幼女而去，以賜綽諾錫裏。至八月，永康王下陘，太后馳至霸州，詣永康，求於漢兒城寨側近賜養種之地，永康許諾，令太后於建州住泊。

context.beforeSource: 又行二百里，會國母為永康王所執，永康王請帝卻往遼陽城駐泊，帝遣使奉表於永康，且賀克捷，自是帝一行稍得供給。
context.afterSource: 漢乾祐二年二月，帝自遼陽城發赴建州。

context.afterLocal: 漢乾祐二年二月，帝自遼陽城發赴建州。
