manualTranslations.zh: 漢乾祐元年四月，永康王至遼陽，帝與太后並詣帳中，帝御白衣紗帽，永康止之，以常服謁見。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth month of Han Qianyou 1, the Prince of Yongkang reached Liaoyang; the Emperor and Empress Dowager together went to his tent; the Emperor wore white robes and a gauze cap, but Yongkang stopped him and received him in ordinary dress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Qianyou 1 of Han the Prince of Yongkang reached Liaoyang; the emperor and empress dowager went together to his tent; the emperor came in white robes and a gauze cap, but Yongkang stopped him and received him in ordinary dress.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝伏地雨泣，自陳過咎，永康使左右扶帝上殿，慰勞久之，因命設樂行酒，從容而罷。
manualTranslations.literal: The Emperor prostrated himself weeping, confessing his faults; Yongkang had attendants help the Emperor up to the hall, consoled him at length, then ordered music and wine, and dismissed him at ease.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor prostrated himself weeping and confessed his faults; Yongkang had attendants help him into the hall, consoled him at length, ordered music and wine, and dismissed him at ease.

manualTranslations.zh: 永康帳下從官及教坊內人望見故主，不勝悲咽，內人皆以衣帛藥餌獻遺於帝。
manualTranslations.literal: Yongkang's attendants and inner women of the music bureau saw their former lord and could not overcome their grief; the inner women all presented robes, silks, and medicines to the Emperor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yongkang's attendants and palace women of the music bureau saw their former lord and wept; the inner women all presented robes, silks, and medicines to the emperor.

manualTranslations.zh: 及永康發離遼陽，取內官十五人、東西班十五人及皇子延煦，並令隨帳上陘，陘即蕃王避暑之地也。
manualTranslations.literal: When Yongkang departed Liaoyang, he took fifteen inner eunuchs, fifteen eastern and western shift attendants, and Prince Yanxu, and had them follow his camp up to the pass—the pass being the Khitan king's summer retreat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yongkang left Liaoyang he took fifteen eunuchs, fifteen eastern and western shift attendants, and Prince Yanxu, and had them follow his camp up to the pass—the Khitan king's summer retreat.

manualTranslations.zh: 有禪奴舍利者，即永康之妻兄也，知帝有小公主在室，詣帝求之，帝辭以年幼不可。
manualTranslations.literal: There was one Channu Sheli, Yongkang's wife's elder brother, who knowing the Emperor had a young princess at home came to request her; the Emperor declined on grounds of her youth.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: One Channu Sheli, Yongkang's wife's elder brother, learning the emperor had a young princess at home asked for her; the emperor refused on grounds of her youth.

manualTranslations.zh: 又有東西班數輩善於歌唱，禪奴又請之，帝乃與之。
manualTranslations.literal: There were also several from the eastern and western shifts skilled at singing whom Channu again requested, and the Emperor gave them up.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Several eastern and western shift attendants skilled at singing were also requested by Channu, and the emperor gave them up.

manualTranslations.zh: 後數日，永康王馳取帝幼女而去，以賜綽諾錫裏。
manualTranslations.literal: Several days later the Prince of Yongkang rode off with the Emperor's young daughter and gave her to Chuonuo Xili.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Several days later the Prince of Yongkang rode off with the emperor's young daughter and gave her to Chuonuo Xili.

manualTranslations.zh: 至八月，永康王下陘，太后馳至霸州，詣永康，求於漢兒城寨側近賜養種之地，永康許諾，令太后於建州住泊。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, as the Prince of Yongkang descended from the pass, the Empress Dowager rode in haste to Bazhou to see Yongkang and ask for land to farm and settle near the Han'er stockade; Yongkang agreed and had the Empress Dowager lodge at Jianzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, as the Prince of Yongkang descended from the pass, the empress dowager rode in haste to Bazhou to see Yongkang and ask for land to farm near the Han'er stockade; Yongkang agreed and had her lodge at Jianzhou.

sourceRange.text: 四月，封永寧公主；九月，進封魏國公主；九月，改封晉國長公主；至十一月，尊為皇后；

context.afterSource: 七年六月，尊為皇太后。

sourceRange.text: 壽王重乂，字宏理，高祖第三子也。幼岐嶷，好儒書，亦通兵法，高祖素所鐘愛。及即位，自北京皇城使拜左驍衛大將軍。車駕幸浚郊，加檢校司空，權東都留守。未幾，鄴都範延光叛，朝廷遣楊光遠討之，詔前靈武節度使、洛都巡檢使張從賓發盟津屯兵赴鄴下。會從賓密通延光，與婁繼英等先劫河橋，次亂洛邑，因害重乂於河南府，時年十九。從賓敗，高祖發哀於便殿，輟視朝三日，詔贈太傅。是歲冬十月，詔遣莊宅使張穎監護喪事，葬於河南府萬安山。天福中，追封壽王。妃李氏，汾州刺史玘之女也。重乂無子，妃後落發為尼，開運中，卒於京師。

context.beforeSource: 重信有子二人，皆幼，長於公宮，及少帝北遷，不知其所終。
context.afterSource: 夔王重進。
context.beforeLocal: 重信有子二人，皆幼，長於公宮，及少帝北遷，不知其所終。

manualTranslations.zh: 壽王重乂，字宏理，高祖第三子也。
manualTranslations.literal: Prince of Shou Chongyi, styled Hongli, was Gaozu's third son.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prince Chongyi of Shou, styled Hongli, was Gaozu's third son.

manualTranslations.zh: 幼岐嶷，好儒書，亦通兵法，高祖素所鐘愛。
manualTranslations.literal: From youth he was precocious and sharp, loved Confucian books, and also understood military strategy; Gaozu had long cherished him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth he was precocious and sharp, loved Confucian books, and also understood military strategy; Gaozu had long cherished him.

manualTranslations.zh: 及即位，自北京皇城使拜左驍衛大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu took the throne, Chongyi was promoted from Beijing Imperial City commissioner to general of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne, Chongyi was promoted from Beijing Imperial City commissioner to general of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 車駕幸浚郊，加檢校司空，權東都留守。
manualTranslations.literal: When the imperial carriage visited the Jun outskirts, he was made Acting Minister of Works and acting defender of the Eastern Capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage visited the Jun outskirts, he was made Acting Minister of Works and acting defender of the Eastern Capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 未幾，鄴都範延光叛，朝廷遣楊光遠討之，詔前靈武節度使、洛都巡檢使張從賓發盟津屯兵赴鄴下。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long Fan Yanguang rebelled at Yedu. The court sent Yang Guangyuan to suppress him and ordered the former military commissioner of Lingwu and Luoyang patrol commissioner Zhang Congbin to mobilize troops stationed at Mengjin and march to Ye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long Fan Yanguang rebelled at Yedu. The court sent Yang Guangyuan to suppress him and ordered former Lingwu military commissioner and Luoyang patrol commissioner Zhang Congbin to mobilize troops at Mengjin and march to Ye.

manualTranslations.zh: 會從賓密通延光，與婁繼英等先劫河橋，次亂洛邑，因害重乂於河南府，時年十九。
manualTranslations.literal: Congbin then secretly communicated with Yanguang. With Lou Jiying and others he first seized Heqiao Bridge, then threw Luoyang into disorder, and thereupon murdered Chongyi in Henan Prefecture. He was nineteen years old.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Congbin then secretly communicated with Yanguang. With Lou Jiying and others he first seized Heqiao Bridge, then threw Luoyang into disorder, and murdered Chongyi in Henan Prefecture. He was nineteen.

manualTranslations.zh: 從賓敗，高祖發哀於便殿，輟視朝三日，詔贈太傅。
manualTranslations.literal: When Congbin was defeated, Gaozu expressed mourning in the side hall, suspended court audiences for three days, and issued an edict posthumously honoring Chongyi as Grand Tutor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Congbin was defeated, Gaozu expressed mourning in the side hall, suspended court audiences for three days, and issued an edict posthumously honoring Chongyi as Grand Tutor.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲冬十月，詔遣莊宅使張穎監護喪事，葬於河南府萬安山。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth month of winter that year, an edict sent Zhang Ying, commissioner of the imperial estates, to supervise the funeral and bury him on Mount Wan'an in Henan Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month that year, an edict sent Zhang Ying, commissioner of the imperial estates, to supervise the funeral and bury him on Mount Wan'an in Henan Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 天福中，追封壽王。
manualTranslations.literal: During Tianfu he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Shou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Tianfu he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Shou.

manualTranslations.zh: 妃李氏，汾州刺史玘之女也。
manualTranslations.literal: His consort was Lady Li, daughter of Qi, prefect of Fenzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His consort was Lady Li, daughter of Qi, prefect of Fen.

manualTranslations.zh: 重乂無子，妃後落發為尼，開運中，卒於京師。
manualTranslations.literal: Chongyi had no sons. His consort later shaved her head and became a nun; during Kaiyun she died in the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chongyi had no sons. His consort later took the tonsure as a nun; during Kaiyun she died in the capital.

sourceRange.text: 梁漢颙，太原人也。少事後唐武皇，初為軍中小校，善騎射，勇於格戰。莊宗之破劉仁恭、王德明，及與梁軍對壘於德勝，皆預其戰，累功至龍武指揮使、檢校司空。梁平，授檢校司徒、濮州刺史。同光三年，魏王繼岌統軍伐蜀，以漢颙為魏王中軍馬步都虞候。天成初，授許州兵馬留後、檢校太保，尋為邠州節度使，歲餘加檢校太傅，充威勝軍節度、唐鄧等州觀察處置等使，在鎮二年，移鎮許州。長興四年夏，以眼疾授太子少師致仕。高祖素與漢颙有舊，及即位之初，漢颙進謁，再希任使，除左威衛上將軍。天福七年冬，以疾卒於洛陽，年七十餘。贈太子太保。

manualTranslations.zh: 梁漢颙，太原人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Liang Hanyong was a native of Taiyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liang Hanyong came from Taiyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 少事後唐武皇，初為軍中小校，善騎射，勇於格戰。
manualTranslations.literal: In youth he served Later Tang's Martial Emperor; at first he was a minor commander in the army, skilled at horsemanship and archery, and bold in close combat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In youth he served Later Tang's Martial Emperor. He began as a minor army commander, skilled at horsemanship and archery and bold in close combat.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊宗之破劉仁恭、王德明，及與梁軍對壘於德勝，皆預其戰，累功至龍武指揮使、檢校司空。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhuangzong defeated Liu Rengong and Wang Deming, and when he faced the Liang army in camp at Desheng, Hanyong took part in all those battles; through repeated merit he rose to Commander of the Dragon Martial Army and Acting Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong defeated Liu Rengong and Wang Deming and faced the Liang army at Desheng, Hanyong fought in every engagement and rose through merit to Commander of the Dragon Martial Army and Acting Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 梁平，授檢校司徒、濮州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: When Liang was pacified, he was granted Acting Minister over the Masses and made prefect of Pu Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Liang was pacified, he was made Acting Minister over the Masses and prefect of Pu.

manualTranslations.zh: 同光三年，魏王繼岌統軍伐蜀，以漢颙為魏王中軍馬步都虞候。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Tongguang, when Prince of Wei Jiji commanded the army campaigning against Shu, Hanyong was made Chief Commissioner of Central Horse and Foot under the Prince of Wei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tongguang 3, when Prince of Wei Jiji led the campaign against Shu, Hanyong was made Chief Commissioner of Central Horse and Foot on the prince's staff.

manualTranslations.zh: 天成初，授許州兵馬留後、檢校太保，尋為邠州節度使，歲餘加檢校太傅，充威勝軍節度、唐鄧等州觀察處置等使，在鎮二年，移鎮許州。
manualTranslations.literal: Early in Tiancheng he was made military superintendent of Xu Prefecture and Acting Grand Guardian; soon he became military commissioner of Bin Prefecture. More than a year later he was advanced to Acting Grand Tutor and made military commissioner of the Weisheng Army and Observation and Disposition Commissioner of Tang, Deng, and other prefectures. After two years at his post he was transferred to Xu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Tiancheng he was made military superintendent of Xu and Acting Grand Guardian, and soon became military commissioner of Bin. More than a year later he was advanced to Acting Grand Tutor and made military commissioner of the Weisheng Army and Observation Commissioner of Tang, Deng, and other prefectures. After two years in command he was transferred to Xu.

manualTranslations.zh: 長興四年夏，以眼疾授太子少師致仕。
manualTranslations.literal: In the summer of the fourth year of Changxing, because of eye disease he was granted Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and retired.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the summer of Changxing 4, because of eye disease he was granted Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and retired.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖素與漢颙有舊，及即位之初，漢颙進謁，再希任使，除左威衛上將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Gaozu had long known Hanyong. When he first took the throne, Hanyong came to audience and again hoped for employment; he was made Senior General of the Left Majestic Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gaozu had long known Hanyong. When he first took the throne, Hanyong came to audience and again sought office; he was made Senior General of the Left Majestic Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 天福七年冬，以疾卒於洛陽，年七十餘。
manualTranslations.literal: In the winter of the seventh year of Tianfu he died of illness at Luoyang, aged over seventy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the winter of Tianfu 7 he died of illness at Luoyang, aged over seventy.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈太子太保。
manualTranslations.literal: Posthumously granted Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sourceRange.text: 尹暉，魏州人也。少以勇健事魏帥楊師厚為軍士，唐莊宗入魏，擢為小校，從征河上，每於馬前步鬥有功。莊宗即位，連改諸軍指揮使。天成、長興中，領數郡刺史，累遷嚴衛都指揮使。唐應順中，王師討末帝於岐下，暉與楊思權首歸，末帝約以鄴都授之。末帝即位，高祖入洛，嘗遇暉於通衢，暉馬上橫鞭以揖高祖。高祖忿之，後因謁謂末帝曰：「尹暉常才，以歸命稱先，陛下欲令出鎮名藩，外論皆云不當。」末帝乃授暉應州節度使。高祖即位，改右衛大將軍。時範延光據鄴謀叛，以暉失意，密使人賫蠟彈，以榮利啖之。暉得延光文字，懼而思竄，欲沿汴水奔於淮南。高祖聞之，尋降詔招喚，未出王畿，為人所殺。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yin Hui came from Wei Prefecture.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In youth, for his courage and vigor he served Wei commander Yang Shihou as a soldier. When Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong entered Wei, he was promoted to company officer and, on the Yellow River campaigns, repeatedly distinguished himself in foot combat before the horses.

manualTranslations.literal: When Zhuangzong took the throne, he was repeatedly reassigned among the various army commands.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong took the throne, he was repeatedly reassigned among the various army commands.

manualTranslations.zh: 天成、長興中，領數郡刺史，累遷嚴衛都指揮使。
manualTranslations.literal: During Tiancheng and Changxing he held several prefectures in succession and was eventually promoted to Commander-in-Chief of the Strict Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Tiancheng and Changxing he held several prefectures in succession and was eventually promoted to Commander-in-Chief of the Strict Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐應順中，王師討末帝於岐下，暉與楊思權首歸，末帝約以鄴都授之。
manualTranslations.literal: During Tang's Yingshun era, when the imperial army campaigned against the Last Emperor at Qi, Hui and Yang Siquan were the first to surrender; the Last Emperor promised to grant him Ye as a commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Tang's Yingshun era, when the imperial army campaigned against the Last Emperor at Qi, Hui and Yang Siquan were the first to surrender, and the Last Emperor promised to grant him Ye.

manualTranslations.zh: 末帝即位，高祖入洛，嘗遇暉於通衢，暉馬上橫鞭以揖高祖。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Last Emperor took the throne and Gaozu entered Luoyang, he once encountered Hui in a public thoroughfare; Hui, on horseback, held his whip across his body to bow to Gaozu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Last Emperor took the throne and Gaozu entered Luoyang, he once met Hui in a public thoroughfare. Hui, on horseback, held his whip across his body to bow to Gaozu.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖忿之，後因謁謂末帝曰：「尹暉常才，以歸命稱先，陛下欲令出鎮名藩，外論皆云不當。
manualTranslations.literal: Gaozu was angered. Later, on an audience visit he told the Last Emperor: "Yin Hui is of ordinary talent. He is praised for being first to submit. Your Majesty wishes to send him out to govern a famous commandery, but outside opinion all says this is improper.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gaozu was angered. Later, on an audience visit he told the Last Emperor: "Yin Hui is of ordinary talent. He is praised for being first to submit. Your Majesty wishes to send him out to govern a famous commandery, but outside opinion all says this is improper.

manualTranslations.zh: 」末帝乃授暉應州節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: " The Last Emperor thereupon appointed Hui military commissioner of Ying Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " The Last Emperor thereupon appointed Hui military commissioner of Ying.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖即位，改右衛大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu took the throne, Hui was reassigned as Senior General of the Right Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne, Hui was reassigned as Senior General of the Right Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 時範延光據鄴謀叛，以暉失意，密使人賫蠟彈，以榮利啖之。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Fan Yanguang held Ye and plotted rebellion; because Hui was disgruntled, he secretly sent men bearing sealed wax messages to entice him with glory and profit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time Fan Yanguang held Ye and plotted rebellion. Because Hui was disgruntled, Yanguang secretly sent men bearing sealed wax messages to entice him with glory and profit.

manualTranslations.zh: 暉得延光文字，懼而思竄，欲沿汴水奔於淮南。
manualTranslations.literal: When Hui received Yanguang's letter, he was afraid and thought of fleeing; he intended to travel down the Bian River to escape to Huainan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Hui received Yanguang's letter, he was afraid and thought of fleeing down the Bian River to Huainan.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖聞之，尋降詔招喚，未出王畿，為人所殺。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu heard of it, he soon issued an edict summoning him back. Before he had left the capital region, he was killed by someone.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu heard of it, he soon issued an edict summoning him back. Before he had left the capital region, he was killed.

sourceRange.text: 在禮歷十餘鎮，善治生殖貨，積財巨萬，兩京及所蒞藩鎮，皆邸店羅列。在宋州日，值天下飛蝗為害，在禮使比戶張幡幟，鳴鼙鼓，蝗皆越境而去，人亦服其智焉。凡聚斂所得，唯以奉權豪、崇釋氏而已。及契丹入汴，自鎮赴闕，時契丹首領、奚王伊喇等在洛下，在禮望塵致敬，首領等倨受其禮，加之淩辱，邀索貨財，在禮不勝其憤。行至鄭州，泊於逆旅，聞同州劉繼勛為契丹所鎖，大驚。丁未歲正月二十五日夜，以衣帶就馬櫪自絞而卒，年六十六。漢高祖即位，贈中書令。

manualTranslations.zh: 在禮歷十餘鎮，善治生殖貨，積財巨萬，兩京及所蒞藩鎮，皆邸店羅列。
manualTranslations.literal: Zaili served in more than ten commands, skilled at managing productive commerce; he amassed wealth in the tens of thousands, and in both capitals and every garrison where he served, shops and inns lined the streets.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zaili served in more than ten commands and was skilled at managing productive commerce. He amassed immense wealth, and in both capitals and every garrison he held, shops and inns lined the streets.

manualTranslations.zh: 在宋州日，值天下飛蝗為害，在禮使比戶張幡幟，鳴鼙鼓，蝗皆越境而去，人亦服其智焉。
manualTranslations.literal: While at Songzhou, when locusts plagued the realm, Zaili had every household raise banners and flags and beat war drums; the locusts all crossed the border and departed, and people admired his cleverness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: While he was at Songzhou, locusts plagued the realm. Zaili had every household raise banners and beat war drums, and the locusts all crossed the border and left. People admired his ingenuity.

manualTranslations.zh: 凡聚斂所得，唯以奉權豪、崇釋氏而已。
manualTranslations.literal: All that he gathered through exactions he used only to serve the powerful and honor Buddhism.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Everything he gathered through exactions went only to serving the powerful and honoring Buddhism.

manualTranslations.zh: 及契丹入汴，自鎮赴闕，時契丹首領、奚王伊喇等在洛下，在禮望塵致敬，首領等倨受其禮，加之淩辱，邀索貨財，在禮不勝其憤。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Khitan entered Bian, Zaili came from his command to the capital. At that time Khitan leaders, including the Xi king Yila, were below Luoyang. Zaili bowed in respect from afar, but the leaders arrogantly received his courtesy, added insult, and demanded goods and wealth; Zaili could not bear his anger.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Khitan entered Bian, Zaili came from his command to the capital. Khitan leaders, including the Xi king Yila, were then below Luoyang. Zaili bowed in respect from afar, but the leaders arrogantly received his courtesy, insulted him, and demanded goods and wealth until he could bear it no longer.

manualTranslations.zh: 行至鄭州，泊於逆旅，聞同州劉繼勛為契丹所鎖，大驚。
manualTranslations.literal: When he reached Zhengzhou and lodged at an inn, he heard that Liu Jixun of Tongzhou had been shackled by the Khitan and was greatly alarmed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he reached Zhengzhou and lodged at an inn, he heard that Liu Jixun of Tongzhou had been shackled by the Khitan and was greatly alarmed.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁未歲正月二十五日夜，以衣帶就馬櫪自絞而卒，年六十六。
manualTranslations.literal: On the night of the twenty-fifth day of the first month in the dingwei year, he hanged himself with his belt from a horse manger and died at age sixty-six.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the night of the twenty-fifth day of the first month in the dingwei year, he hanged himself with his belt from a horse manger and died at sixty-six.

manualTranslations.zh: 漢高祖即位，贈中書令。
manualTranslations.literal: When Han Gaozu took the throne, he was posthumously granted Director of the Department of State Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Gaozu of Han took the throne, he was posthumously granted Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sourceRange.text: 李德充，應州金城人。祖晟，父宗元，皆為邊將。德充少善騎射，事後唐武皇為偏校。及從莊宗戰潞州、柏鄉、德勝渡，繼有軍功，累加檢校尚書左僕射，遙食郡俸。天成中，檢校司空，領蔚州刺史。長興元年，授雄武軍節度、秦成階觀察處置等使，加檢校司徒。二年六月，移鎮定州，充北面副招討使。高祖即位，改鎮涇原，及受代歸闕，會高祖幸鄴，授東京留守，加同平章事。少帝嗣位，移廣晉尹，加檢校太師。開運中，再領涇州，以病卒於鎮。德充幼與明宗俱事武皇，故後之諸將多兄事之，時謂之「李七哥」。所治之地，雖無殊政，然以寬恕及物，家無濫積，亦武將之廉者。

context.afterSource: 田武，字德偉，大名元城人。

manualTranslations.zh: 李德充，應州金城人。
manualTranslations.literal: Li Dechong was a man of Jincheng in Yingzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li Dechong was a native of Jincheng in Yingzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 祖晟，父宗元，皆為邊將。
manualTranslations.literal: His grandfather was Sheng and his father Zongyuan; both were frontier generals.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His grandfather Sheng and his father Zongyuan were both frontier generals.

manualTranslations.zh: 德充少善騎射，事後唐武皇為偏校。
manualTranslations.literal: Dechong in youth was skilled at horsemanship and archery and served Wuhuang of Later Tang as a junior officer.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In youth Dechong was skilled at horsemanship and archery and served Wuhuang of Later Tang as a junior officer.

manualTranslations.zh: 及從莊宗戰潞州、柏鄉、德勝渡，繼有軍功，累加檢校尚書左僕射，遙食郡俸。
manualTranslations.literal: When he followed Zhuangzong in battles at Luzhou, Baixiang, and Desheng Ford, he repeatedly earned military merit and was repeatedly promoted to acting Left Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue, drawing commandery salary in absentia.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Following Zhuangzong at Luzhou, Baixiang, and Desheng Ford, he repeatedly earned military merit and rose to acting Left Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue with commandery salary in absentia.

manualTranslations.zh: 天成中，檢校司空，領蔚州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Tiancheng era he was made acting Minister of Works and appointed prefect of Yu Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Tiancheng he was made acting Minister of Works and prefect of Yu Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 長興元年，授雄武軍節度、秦成階觀察處置等使，加檢校司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Changxing he was appointed military commissioner of the Xiongwu Army and commissioner for observation and disposition of Qin, Cheng, Jie, and Guan, and given acting Minister of Education.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Changxing he was made military commissioner of the Xiongwu Army and commissioner for observation and disposition of Qin, Cheng, Jie, and Guan, with acting Minister of Education.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年六月，移鎮定州，充北面副招討使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year he was transferred to garrison Dingzhou and served as deputy northern suppression commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year he was transferred to garrison Dingzhou as deputy northern suppression commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖即位，改鎮涇原，及受代歸闕，會高祖幸鄴，授東京留守，加同平章事。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu took the throne, Dechong was transferred to command Jingyuan. When he was relieved and returned to court, Gaozu happened to be visiting Ye; he was appointed regent of the Eastern Capital and given concurrent Grand Councilor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne, Dechong was transferred to command Jingyuan. After he was relieved and returned to court, Gaozu happened to be visiting Ye and appointed him regent of the Eastern Capital with concurrent grand councilor.

manualTranslations.zh: 少帝嗣位，移廣晉尹，加檢校太師。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Young Emperor succeeded, he was transferred to Guangjin Intendant and given acting Grand Preceptor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Young Emperor succeeded, he was made Guangjin Intendant and acting Grand Preceptor.

manualTranslations.zh: 開運中，再領涇州，以病卒於鎮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Kaiyun era he again held Jingzhou and died of illness in his command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Kaiyun he again held Jingzhou and died of illness in office.

manualTranslations.zh: 德充幼與明宗俱事武皇，故後之諸將多兄事之，時謂之「李七哥」。
manualTranslations.literal: Dechong in youth served Wuhuang together with Mingzong, so later generals often treated him as an elder brother, and at the time he was called "Seventh Brother Li."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Dechong had served Wuhuang together with Mingzong in youth, so later generals often treated him as an elder brother and called him "Seventh Brother Li."

manualTranslations.zh: 所治之地，雖無殊政，然以寬恕及物，家無濫積，亦武將之廉者。
manualTranslations.literal: In the places he governed, though he had no extraordinary policies, he treated people with leniency and his household had no excessive hoardings; he was also a frugal man among military commanders.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the places he governed he had no extraordinary policies, but he treated people with leniency and kept no excessive hoard at home; he was counted among the frugal military commanders.

sourceRange.text: 李繼忠，字化遠，後唐昭義軍節度使、兼中書令嗣昭之第二子。嗣昭，《唐書》有傳。繼忠少善騎射，從父征討有功，莊宗手制授檢校兵部尚書，充感義馬軍指揮使，改潞府司馬，加檢校尚書右僕射，充安義都巡檢使。天成中，自北京大內皇城使轉河東行軍司馬，入為右驍衛將軍。未幾，授成德軍司馬，加檢校司徒。高祖即位，二年三月，授沂州刺史，加檢校太保，尋移棣州刺史。繼忠舊苦風痹，皆辭以地遠，乃授單州刺史，仍加輸忠奉國功臣。三年，入為右神武統軍。四年三月，出領隰州。七年八月，移刺澤州。開運元年，復入為右監門大將軍。三年秋，以疾卒於東京，年五十一。

context.beforeSource: 弟從恩仕皇朝，為右金吾衛上將軍，卒。
context.afterSource: 始繼忠母楊氏善治產，平生積財巨萬。

manualTranslations.zh: 李繼忠，字化遠，後唐昭義軍節度使、兼中書令嗣昭之第二子。
manualTranslations.literal: Li Jizhong, style name Huayuan, was the second son of Sizhao, Later Tang military governor of Zhaoyi and concurrent Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li Jizhong, whose courtesy name was Huayuan, was the second son of Sizhao, Later Tang military governor of Zhaoyi and concurrent Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 嗣昭，《唐書》有傳。
manualTranslations.literal: Sizhao has a biography in the 《Book of Tang》.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sizhao has a biography in the 《Book of Tang》.

manualTranslations.zh: 繼忠少善騎射，從父征討有功，莊宗手制授檢校兵部尚書，充感義馬軍指揮使，改潞府司馬，加檢校尚書右僕射，充安義都巡檢使。
manualTranslations.literal: Jizhong excelled at mounted archery from youth; he followed his father on campaigns and rendered distinguished service. Zhuangzong personally wrote an edict appointing him Acting Minister of War, serving as Ganyi Cavalry Army Commander, then Lu Prefecture army secretary; he was promoted to Acting Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and made Anyi Circuit inspection commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jizhong excelled at mounted archery from youth and followed his father on campaigns with distinguished service. Zhuangzong personally wrote an edict making him Acting Minister of War and Ganyi Cavalry Army Commander, then Lu Prefecture army secretary; he was promoted to Acting Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and made Anyi Circuit inspection commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 天成中，自北京大內皇城使轉河東行軍司馬，入為右驍衛將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: During Tiancheng he transferred from Northern Capital Inner Palace Imperial City commissioner to Hedong army secretary, then entered court as general of the Right Valiant Cavalry Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Tiancheng he transferred from Northern Capital Inner Palace Imperial City commissioner to Hedong army secretary, then entered court as general of the Right Valiant Cavalry Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 未幾，授成德軍司馬，加檢校司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: Not long afterward he was appointed Chengde Army secretary and promoted to Acting Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Not long afterward he was appointed Chengde Army secretary and promoted to Acting Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖即位，二年三月，授沂州刺史，加檢校太保，尋移棣州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu took the throne, in the third month of the second year he was made prefect of Yi and Acting Grand Guardian; soon he was transferred to prefect of Di.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne, in the third month of the second year he was made prefect of Yi and Acting Grand Guardian; soon he was transferred to prefect of Di.

manualTranslations.zh: 繼忠舊苦風痹，皆辭以地遠，乃授單州刺史，仍加輸忠奉國功臣。
manualTranslations.literal: Jizhong had long suffered from wind paralysis and declined each appointment on the grounds that the posts were too distant, so he was made prefect of Shan and given the honorary title Meritorious Minister of Loyal Submission and Service to the State.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jizhong had long suffered from wind paralysis and declined each appointment on the grounds that the posts were too distant, so he was made prefect of Shan and given the honorary title Meritorious Minister of Loyal Submission and Service to the State.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，入為右神武統軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year he entered court as overall commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year he entered court as overall commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年三月，出領隰州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year he went out to govern Xi Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year he went out to govern Xi Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 七年八月，移刺澤州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month of the seventh year he was transferred to Ze Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the seventh year he was transferred to Ze Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 開運元年，復入為右監門大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Kaiyun he entered court again as Grand General of the Right Gate Guard Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kaiyun he entered court again as Grand General of the Right Gate Guard Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年秋，以疾卒於東京，年五十一。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn of the third year he died of illness at the Eastern Capital, aged fifty-one.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn of the third year he died of illness at the Eastern Capital at the age of fifty-one.

sourceRange.text: 鄭琮，太原人也。始事唐武皇為五院軍小校，屢有軍功。莊宗在河上，為馬步都虞候。戎伍之事，一睹不忘，凡所詰問，應答如流，故所在知名。唐同光末，從明宗伐魏州，時軍情有變，明宗退守魏縣，未知趨向。安重誨將征兵於四方，琮在帳前，歷數諸道屯軍及主將姓名，附口傳檄，相次而至。明宗即位，嘉其功，授防州刺史，秩滿，父老請留。三年八月，授左羽林統軍。唐長興二年二月，出刺武州。高祖即位，復居環衛。久之，以俸薄家貧，郁郁不得志。天福中，以疾終於官。贈司徒。

context.beforeSource: 贈太傅。
context.beforeLocal: 贈太傅。

manualTranslations.zh: 鄭琮，太原人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Zheng Cong was a native of Taiyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zheng Cong was a native of Taiyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 始事唐武皇為五院軍小校，屢有軍功。
manualTranslations.literal: He began by serving Tang's Martial Emperor as a minor officer in the Five-Courts Army and repeatedly won military merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He began by serving Tang's Martial Emperor as a minor officer in the Five-Courts Army and repeatedly won military merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊宗在河上，為馬步都虞候。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhuangzong was on the Yellow River he served as overall tribal-and-Han cavalry and infantry adjutant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong was on the Yellow River he served as overall tribal-and-Han cavalry and infantry adjutant.

manualTranslations.zh: 戎伍之事，一睹不忘，凡所詰問，應答如流，故所在知名。
manualTranslations.literal: In military matters he forgot nothing at a glance; whenever questioned he answered fluently, and so became known wherever he served.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In military matters he forgot nothing at a glance; whenever questioned he answered fluently, and so became known wherever he served.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐同光末，從明宗伐魏州，時軍情有變，明宗退守魏縣，未知趨向。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of Tongguang of Tang he followed Mingzong in the campaign against Weizhou; when army morale shifted Mingzong withdrew to defend Wei County, uncertain where to turn.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the end of Tongguang of Tang he followed Mingzong in the campaign against Weizhou; when army morale shifted Mingzong withdrew to defend Wei County, uncertain where to turn.

manualTranslations.zh: 安重誨將征兵於四方，琮在帳前，歷數諸道屯軍及主將姓名，附口傳檄，相次而至。
manualTranslations.literal: An Chonghui was about to levy troops from all directions; Cong stood before the tent, itemizing the garrison forces of each circuit and the names of their commanders, transmitting edicts orally one after another until they arrived in succession.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An Chonghui was about to levy troops from all directions; Cong stood before the tent, itemizing the garrison forces of each circuit and the names of their commanders, transmitting edicts orally one after another until they arrived in succession.

manualTranslations.zh: 明宗即位，嘉其功，授防州刺史，秩滿，父老請留。
manualTranslations.literal: When Mingzong took the throne he praised Cong's merit, made him prefect of Fang, and when his term ended the elders asked that he remain.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Mingzong took the throne he praised Cong's merit, made him prefect of Fang, and when his term ended the elders asked that he remain.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年八月，授左羽林統軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year he was made overall commander of the Left Yulin Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year he was made overall commander of the Left Yulin Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐長興二年二月，出刺武州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Changxing of Tang he went out to govern Wu Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year of Changxing of Tang he went out to govern Wu Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖即位，復居環衛。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu took the throne Cong returned to palace guard service.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne Cong returned to palace guard service.

manualTranslations.zh: 久之，以俸薄家貧，郁郁不得志。
manualTranslations.literal: After a long time, with slender salary and a poor household, he was depressed and unfulfilled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After a long time, with slender salary and a poor household, he was depressed and unfulfilled.

manualTranslations.zh: 天福中，以疾終於官。
manualTranslations.literal: During Tianfu he died of illness in office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Tianfu he died of illness in office.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously honored as Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as Minister of Works.

sourceRange.text: 周光輔，太原人，後唐蕃漢馬步總管、幽州節度使德威之長子也。德威，有傳在《唐書》。光輔年甫十歲，補幽州中軍兵馬使，有成人之志，德威以牙軍委之，麾下鹹取決焉。及長，體貌魁偉，練於戎事。父卒，授嵐州刺史，從莊宗平梁，遷檢校尚書左僕射、汝州防禦使，仍賜協謀定亂功臣。天成初，移汾州。四年，入為右監門衛大將軍。長興、清泰中，歷陳、懷、磁三郡，繼加檢校司徒。高祖即位，授蔡州刺史，歲餘，卒於郡，時年三十五。贈太保。光輔以功臣子，歷數郡皆無濫政，竟善終於官，雖享年不永，亦可嘉也。

context.afterSource: 光輔有弟數人，光貞歷義、乾二州刺史，入為諸衛將軍。

manualTranslations.zh: 周光輔，太原人，後唐蕃漢馬步總管、幽州節度使德威之長子也。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhou Guangfu of Taiyuan was the eldest son of Dewei, Later Tang overall commander of tribal and Han cavalry and infantry and military governor of You Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhou Guangfu of Taiyuan was the eldest son of Dewei, Later Tang overall commander of tribal and Han cavalry and infantry and military governor of You Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 德威，有傳在《唐書》。
manualTranslations.literal: Dewei has a biography in the 《Book of Tang》.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Dewei has a biography in the 《Book of Tang》.

manualTranslations.zh: 光輔年甫十歲，補幽州中軍兵馬使，有成人之志，德威以牙軍委之，麾下鹹取決焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Guangfu was only ten when appointed Youzhou central army troops and horses commissioner; he showed the spirit of a grown man, and Dewei entrusted the tooth army to him—all under his command deferred to his decisions.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guangfu was only ten when appointed Youzhou central army troops and horses commissioner; he showed the spirit of a grown man, and Dewei entrusted the tooth army to him—all under his command deferred to his decisions.

manualTranslations.zh: 及長，體貌魁偉，練於戎事。
manualTranslations.literal: When he grew up he had a tall and imposing physique and was practiced in military affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he grew up he had a tall and imposing physique and was practiced in military affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 父卒，授嵐州刺史，從莊宗平梁，遷檢校尚書左僕射、汝州防禦使，仍賜協謀定亂功臣。
manualTranslations.literal: After his father's death he was made prefect of Lan, followed Zhuangzong in pacifying Liang, was transferred to Acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and defensive commissioner of Ru Prefecture, and was granted the title Meritorious Minister of Cooperative Counsel and Pacifying Rebellion.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After his father's death he was made prefect of Lan, followed Zhuangzong in pacifying Liang, was transferred to Acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat and defensive commissioner of Ru Prefecture, and was granted the title Meritorious Minister of Cooperative Counsel and Pacifying Rebellion.

manualTranslations.zh: 天成初，移汾州。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Tiancheng he was transferred to Fen Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tiancheng he was transferred to Fen Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，入為右監門衛大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he entered court as Grand General of the Right Gate Guard Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he entered court as Grand General of the Right Gate Guard Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 長興、清泰中，歷陳、懷、磁三郡，繼加檢校司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: During Changxing and Qingtai he governed Chen, Huai, and Ci prefectures in succession and was further promoted to Acting Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Changxing and Qingtai he governed Chen, Huai, and Ci prefectures in succession and was further promoted to Acting Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖即位，授蔡州刺史，歲餘，卒於郡，時年三十五。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu took the throne he was made prefect of Cai; after more than a year he died in the prefecture at the age of thirty-five.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne he was made prefect of Cai; after more than a year he died in the prefecture at the age of thirty-five.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈太保。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously honored as Grand Guardian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as Grand Guardian.

manualTranslations.zh: 光輔以功臣子，歷數郡皆無濫政，竟善終於官，雖享年不永，亦可嘉也。
manualTranslations.literal: As the son of a meritorious minister, Guangfu held several prefectures and never misgoverned; he ended his life well in office, and though his years were not long, his conduct is praiseworthy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As the son of a meritorious minister, Guangfu held several prefectures and never misgoverned; he ended his life well in office, and though his years were not long, his conduct is praiseworthy.

sourceRange.text: 旋丁母，哀毀過制。

localRange.text: 旋丁母艱，哀毀過制。

sourceRange.text: 吳承範，字表微，魏州人也。父瓊，右金吾衛將軍，累贈太子少保。承範少好學，善屬文，唐閔帝之鎮鄴都也，聞其才名，署為賓職，承範懇求隨計，閔帝許之。長興三年春，擢進士第。及閔帝即位，授左拾遺。清泰二年，以本官充史館修撰，與同職張昭遠等共修《明宗實錄》，轉右補闕，依前充職。高祖革命，遷尚書屯田員外郎、知制誥。天福三年，改樞密院直學士，未幾，自祠部郎中、知制誥召充翰林學士，正拜中書舍人，賜金紫。少帝嗣位，遷禮部侍郎，知貢舉，尋遘疾而卒，年四十二。贈工部尚書。

manualTranslations.zh: 吳承範，字表微，魏州人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Wu Chengfan, style name Biaowei, was a man of Weizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wu Chengfan, courtesy name Biaowei, was a native of Weizhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 父瓊，右金吾衛將軍，累贈太子少保。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Qiong was General of the Right Gold Crow Guard and was repeatedly posthumously honored as Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Qiong was general of the Right Gold Crow Guard and was posthumously honored on successive occasions as junior guardian of the heir apparent.

manualTranslations.zh: 承範少好學，善屬文，唐閔帝之鎮鄴都也，聞其才名，署為賓職，承範懇求隨計，閔帝許之。
manualTranslations.literal: Chengfan from youth loved learning and was skilled at literary composition. When the Tang Emperor Min was posted at Yedu, he heard of Chengfan's talent and reputation and appointed him as a guest official. Chengfan earnestly requested to accompany him on the tribute journey, and Emperor Min permitted it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth Chengfan loved learning and was skilled at literary composition. When the Tang Emperor Min was stationed at Yedu, he heard of Chengfan's talent and reputation and appointed him as a guest official. Chengfan earnestly asked to accompany him on the tribute journey to the capital, and Emperor Min agreed.

manualTranslations.zh: 長興三年春，擢進士第。
manualTranslations.literal: In spring of the third year of Changxing, he was selected as a jinshi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In spring of the third year of Changxing he passed the jinshi examination.

manualTranslations.zh: 及閔帝即位，授左拾遺。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Min ascended the throne, he was appointed Left Reminder.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Min took the throne, he was appointed Left Reminder.

manualTranslations.zh: 清泰二年，以本官充史館修撰，與同職張昭遠等共修《明宗實錄》，轉右補闕，依前充職。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Qingtai, in his existing capacity he was made Compiler at the Historiography Institute and together with fellow compiler Zhang Zhaoyuan and others jointly compiled the Veritable Record of Emperor Mingzong. He was transferred to Right Supplementation Censor and continued in his former office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qingtai, while retaining his existing post he was made compiler at the Historiography Institute and, together with fellow compiler Zhang Zhaoyuan and others, jointly compiled the Veritable Record of Emperor Mingzong. He was transferred to Right Supplementation Censor and continued in the same office.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖革命，遷尚書屯田員外郎、知制誥。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu founded the new dynasty, he was transferred to Vice Director of the Revenue Department in the Ministry of Works and Drafter of Edicts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu founded the dynasty, he was promoted to vice director of the Revenue Department in the Ministry of Works and drafter of edicts.

manualTranslations.zh: 天福三年，改樞密院直學士，未幾，自祠部郎中、知制誥召充翰林學士，正拜中書舍人，賜金紫。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Tianfu he was changed to Direct Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs. Before long, from his post as Director in the Ministry of Rites and Drafter of Edicts he was summoned to serve as Hanlin Academician, formally appointed Secretariat Drafter, and granted gold and purple insignia.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tianfu he was made direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs. Before long, from his post as director in the Ministry of Rites and drafter of edicts he was summoned to serve as Hanlin academician, formally appointed Secretariat drafter, and granted gold and purple insignia.

manualTranslations.zh: 少帝嗣位，遷禮部侍郎，知貢舉，尋遘疾而卒，年四十二。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Young Emperor succeeded to the throne, he was transferred to Vice Minister of Rites and placed in charge of the examinations. Soon after he fell ill and died, aged forty-two.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Young Emperor succeeded, he was promoted to vice minister of rites and placed in charge of the examinations. Soon after he fell ill and died at the age of forty-two.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈工部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as minister of works.

sourceRange.text: 盧詹，字楚良，京兆長安人也。唐天祐中，爲河中從事。莊宗即位，擢爲員外郎、知制誥，遷中書舍人。天成中，拜禮部侍郎、知貢舉，歷御史中丞、兵部侍郎、尚書左丞、工部尚書。詹性剛直，議論不避權貴，執政者常惡之。天福初，拜禮部尚書，分司洛下，與右僕射盧質、散騎常侍盧重俱在西都，數相過從。三人俱嗜酒，好遊山水，塔廟林亭花竹之地，無不同往，酣飲爲樂，人無間然，洛中朝士目爲「三盧會」。常委順性命，不營財利。開運初，卒於洛陽。詹家無長物，喪具不給，少帝聞之，賜布帛百段，粟麥百斛，方能襄其葬事。贈太子少保。

context.beforeSource: 專美曾使閩中，遇風水漂至兩浙，逾歲無恙而還，至是善終，人以爲神道福謙之所致也。
context.afterSource: 崔棁，字子文，博陵安平人。

manualTranslations.zh: 盧詹，字楚良，京兆長安人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Lu Zhan, courtesy name Chuliang, was a man of Chang'an in Jingzhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lu Zhan, whose courtesy name was Chuliang, came from Chang'an in Jingzhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐天祐中，爲河中從事。
manualTranslations.literal: During the Tianyou era of Tang he served as staff officer in Hezhong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Tianyou era of Tang he served as staff officer in Hezhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊宗即位，擢爲員外郎、知制誥，遷中書舍人。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhuangzong took the throne, he was promoted to outer director and controller of edicts, then transferred to secretariat drafter.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong took the throne, he was promoted to outer director and controller of edicts, then transferred to secretariat drafter.

manualTranslations.zh: 天成中，拜禮部侍郎、知貢舉，歷御史中丞、兵部侍郎、尚書左丞、工部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: During Tiancheng he was appointed vice minister of rites and supervisor of tribute examinations, and successively served as censor-in-chief, vice minister of war, left assistant director of the Department of State Affairs, and minister of works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Tiancheng he was appointed vice minister of rites and supervisor of tribute examinations, and successively served as censor-in-chief, vice minister of war, left assistant director of the Department of State Affairs, and minister of works.

manualTranslations.zh: 詹性剛直，議論不避權貴，執政者常惡之。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhan was by nature forthright and upright; in debate he did not spare powerful nobles, and those in power often hated him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhan was by nature forthright and upright; in debate he did not spare powerful nobles, and those in power often hated him.

manualTranslations.zh: 天福初，拜禮部尚書，分司洛下，與右僕射盧質、散騎常侍盧重俱在西都，數相過從。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Tianfu he was appointed minister of rites and held a nominal post at Luoyang. Together with Right Vice Director Lu Zhi and Regular Attendant Lu Chong, he was all in the western capital, and they frequently visited one another.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianfu he was appointed minister of rites and held a nominal post at Luoyang. Together with Right Vice Director Lu Zhi and Regular Attendant Lu Chong, he was in the western capital, and they frequently visited one another.

manualTranslations.zh: 三人俱嗜酒，好遊山水，塔廟林亭花竹之地，無不同往，酣飲爲樂，人無間然，洛中朝士目爲「三盧會」。
manualTranslations.literal: All three loved wine and enjoyed touring mountains and rivers; to pagodas, temples, wooded pavilions, and places of flowers and bamboo they went together without exception. They made merry drinking to their hearts' content, and no one found fault with them; the court gentlemen of Luoyang called them the "Three Lu Assembly."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All three loved wine and enjoyed touring mountains and rivers. To pagodas, temples, wooded pavilions, and places of flowers and bamboo they went together without exception, drinking merrily for pleasure, and no one found fault with them. The court gentlemen of Luoyang called them the "Three Lu Assembly."

manualTranslations.zh: 常委順性命，不營財利。
manualTranslations.literal: He always submitted to fate and did not pursue wealth.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He always submitted to fate and did not pursue wealth.

manualTranslations.zh: 開運初，卒於洛陽。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Kaiyun he died in Luoyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Kaiyun he died in Luoyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 詹家無長物，喪具不給，少帝聞之，賜布帛百段，粟麥百斛，方能襄其葬事。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhan's household had few possessions and could not supply funeral goods. When the Lesser Emperor heard of this, he granted a hundred bolts of cloth and silk and a hundred hu of grain and wheat, only then enabling his burial to be properly carried out.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhan's household had few possessions and could not supply funeral goods. When the Lesser Emperor heard of this, he granted a hundred bolts of cloth and silk and a hundred hu of grain and wheat, enabling his burial to be properly carried out.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈太子少保。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously granted the title Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the title Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince.

sourceRange.text: 孫彥韜，字德光，汴州浚儀人也。少以勇力應募從軍。梁祖之兼領四鎮，擢彥韜於行間，歷諸軍偏校。及唐莊宗與梁軍對壘於河上，彥韜知梁運將季，乃間行渡河，北歸莊宗，莊宗嘉而納之，授親從右廂指揮使。及莊宗平梁，出為晉州長步都校，加檢校兵部尚書。天成初，遷綿州刺史、檢校尚書左僕射。至郡逾年，以考課見稱，就加檢校司空。長興、清泰中，歷密、沂、濮三州刺史，累官至檢校太保，賜竭忠建策興復功臣。高祖即位，復授密州刺史，尋卒於任，年六十四。

context.beforeSource: 長子貞文，仕皇朝，為開封少尹，卒。
context.afterSource: 彥韜出於軍旅，植性和厚，理綿州日，甚著綏懷之譽，故有賞典旌焉。
context.beforeLocal: 長子貞文，仕皇朝，為開封少尹，卒。
context.afterLocal: 彥韜出於軍旅，植性和厚，理綿州日，甚著綏懷之譽，故有賞典旌焉。

manualTranslations.zh: 孫彥韜，字德光，汴州浚儀人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Sun Yantao, courtesy name Deguang, was a native of Junyi in Bianzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sun Yantao, courtesy name Deguang, was from Junyi in Bian.

manualTranslations.zh: 少以勇力應募從軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In youth he volunteered for military service through courage and strength.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As a youth he volunteered for military service through courage and strength.

manualTranslations.zh: 梁祖之兼領四鎮，擢彥韜於行間，歷諸軍偏校。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Liang founder concurrently held four commands, he picked Yantao out from the ranks and had him serve through the armies as a junior commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Liang founder concurrently held four commands, he picked Yantao from the ranks and had him serve as a junior commander in several armies.

manualTranslations.zh: 及唐莊宗與梁軍對壘於河上，彥韜知梁運將季，乃間行渡河，北歸莊宗，莊宗嘉而納之，授親從右廂指揮使。
manualTranslations.literal: When Tang's Zhuangzong faced the Liang army in battle array on the Yellow River, Yantao knew Liang's fortune was nearing its end. He secretly crossed the river by a hidden route and returned north to Zhuangzong. Zhuangzong praised and accepted him and made him commander of the personal followers' right wing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong of Tang faced the Liang army on the Yellow River, Yantao knew Liang's fortune was waning. He secretly crossed the river and returned to Zhuangzong, who welcomed him and made him commander of the personal followers' right wing.

manualTranslations.zh: 及莊宗平梁，出為晉州長步都校，加檢校兵部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhuangzong pacified Liang, Yantao was sent out as overall commander of the Jinzhou long-step forces and made Acting Minister of War.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Zhuangzong pacified Liang, Yantao was sent out as overall commander of the Jinzhou long-step forces and made Acting Minister of War.

manualTranslations.zh: 天成初，遷綿州刺史、檢校尚書左僕射。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Tiancheng he was transferred to prefect of Mianzhou and Acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tiancheng he became prefect of Mian and Acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 至郡逾年，以考課見稱，就加檢校司空。
manualTranslations.literal: After more than a year in the commandery he was praised in performance review and was thereupon promoted to Acting Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After more than a year in office he was praised in performance review and was promoted to Acting Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 長興、清泰中，歷密、沂、濮三州刺史，累官至檢校太保，賜竭忠建策興復功臣。
manualTranslations.literal: During Changxing and Qingtai he served in succession as prefect of Mi, Yi, and Pu, rose in cumulative office to Acting Grand Guardian, and was granted the title Meritorious Minister Who Exhausts Loyalty in Planning Restoration.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Changxing and Qingtai he served as prefect of Mi, Yi, and Pu in succession, rose to Acting Grand Guardian, and received the title Meritorious Minister Who Exhausts Loyalty in Planning Restoration.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖即位，復授密州刺史，尋卒於任，年六十四。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu took the throne he was again appointed prefect of Mizhou and soon died in office, aged sixty-four.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne he was again made prefect of Mi and soon died in office at the age of sixty-four.

sourceRange.text: 郭延魯，字德興，沁州綿上人也。父饒，後唐武皇時，以軍功嘗為本郡守，凡九年，有遺愛焉。延魯少有勇，善用槊，莊宗以舊將之子，擢為保衛軍使，頻戍塞下，捍契丹有功。及即位，賜協謀定亂功臣，加檢校兵部尚書、右神武都指揮都知兵馬使。天成中，汴州朱守殷叛，延魯從車駕東幸，至其地，坎壘先登。守殷平，以功授汴州步軍都指揮使，加檢校尚書左僕射。長興中，累加檢校司徒，歷天雄軍北京馬步軍都校，遙領梧州刺史。清泰中，遷復州刺史，正俸之外，未嘗斂貸，庶事就理，一郡賴焉。秩滿，百姓上章舉留，朝廷嘉之。高祖即位，遷單州刺史，加檢校太保，賜輸誠奉義忠烈功臣。到任逾月，以疾卒於理所，時年四十七。詔贈太傅。

context.beforeSource: 長子光被，歷通事舍人。
context.afterSource: 郭金海，本突厥之族。
context.beforeLocal: 長子光被，歷通事舍人。
context.afterLocal: 郭金海，本突厥之族。

manualTranslations.zh: 郭延魯，字德興，沁州綿上人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Guo Yanlu, courtesy name Dexing, was a native of Mianshang in Qinzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guo Yanlu, courtesy name Dexing, was from Mianshang in Qin.

manualTranslations.zh: 父饒，後唐武皇時，以軍功嘗為本郡守，凡九年，有遺愛焉。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Rao, during Later Tang's Martial Emperor, once served as prefect of his home commandery for military merit, for nine years in all, and left a legacy of affection.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Rao had served as prefect of their home commandery for nine years under Later Tang's Martial Emperor and left a legacy of affection.

manualTranslations.zh: 延魯少有勇，善用槊，莊宗以舊將之子，擢為保衛軍使，頻戍塞下，捍契丹有功。
manualTranslations.literal: Yanlu was brave from youth and skilled with the spear. Zhuangzong, because he was the son of an old general, promoted him to commissioner of the Baowei army. He often garrisoned the frontier and had merit in repelling the Khitan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yanlu was brave from youth and a skilled spearman. Zhuangzong, because he was the son of an old general, made him commissioner of the Baowei army. He often garrisoned the frontier and won merit repelling the Khitan.

manualTranslations.zh: 及即位，賜協謀定亂功臣，加檢校兵部尚書、右神武都指揮都知兵馬使。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhuangzong took the throne he was granted the title Meritorious Minister of Cooperative Counsel and Pacifying Rebellion and made Acting Minister of War and overall commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard with charge of troops and horses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong took the throne he received the title Meritorious Minister of Cooperative Counsel and Pacifying Rebellion and was made Acting Minister of War and overall commander of the Right Divine Martial Guard with charge of troops and horses.

manualTranslations.zh: 天成中，汴州朱守殷叛，延魯從車駕東幸，至其地，坎壘先登。
manualTranslations.literal: During Tiancheng, when Zhu Shouyin of Bianzhou rebelled, Yanlu followed the imperial carriage east and, on reaching the place, was first to scale the ramparts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Tiancheng, when Zhu Shouyin of Bian rebelled, Yanlu followed the emperor east and was first to scale the ramparts on arrival.

manualTranslations.zh: 守殷平，以功授汴州步軍都指揮使，加檢校尚書左僕射。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shouyin was pacified, Yanlu was made commander of the Bianzhou infantry for his merit and promoted to Acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Shouyin was suppressed, Yanlu was made commander of the Bian infantry for his service and promoted to Acting Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 長興中，累加檢校司徒，歷天雄軍北京馬步軍都校，遙領梧州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: During Changxing he was further promoted to Acting Minister of Education, served as overall commander of the Tianxiong Army northern capital horse-and-foot forces, and held titular command of Wuzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Changxing he rose to Acting Minister of Education, served as overall commander of the Tianxiong Army northern capital horse-and-foot forces, and held titular command of Wu.

manualTranslations.zh: 清泰中，遷復州刺史，正俸之外，未嘗斂貸，庶事就理，一郡賴焉。
manualTranslations.literal: During Qingtai he was transferred to prefect of Fu. Beyond his regular salary he never collected loans; all affairs were put in order, and the whole commandery relied on him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Qingtai he became prefect of Fu. Beyond his regular salary he never collected loans, put affairs in order, and the whole commandery relied on him.

manualTranslations.zh: 秩滿，百姓上章舉留，朝廷嘉之。
manualTranslations.literal: When his term ended the people submitted a memorial asking that he remain, and the court praised him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When his term ended the people petitioned to keep him, and the court praised him.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖即位，遷單州刺史，加檢校太保，賜輸誠奉義忠烈功臣。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu took the throne Yanlu was transferred to prefect of Shan, promoted to Acting Grand Guardian, and granted the title Meritorious Minister of Loyal Submission, Righteous Service, and Fierce Loyalty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne he became prefect of Shan, Acting Grand Guardian, and received the title Meritorious Minister of Loyal Submission, Righteous Service, and Fierce Loyalty.

manualTranslations.zh: 到任逾月，以疾卒於理所，時年四十七。
manualTranslations.literal: A little more than a month after reaching his post he died of illness in the government offices, aged forty-seven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Little more than a month after taking office he died of illness at his post, aged forty-seven.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔贈太傅。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict posthumously granted him Grand Tutor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the title grand tutor.

sourceRange.text: 王傅拯，吳江人也。父綰，偽虔州節度使。傅拯初事楊溥，為黑雲右廂都指揮使，領本軍戍海州。唐長興元年，傅拯殺海州刺史陳宣，焚州城，以所部兵五千人來歸。明宗喜而納之，授金紫光祿大夫、檢校司徒、曹州刺史，尋移濮州。清泰中，遷貝州防禦使，秩滿有代，會範延光叛，以兵要傅拯入魏城，疑而不用。延光降，高祖授傅拯諸衛將軍，出為寧州刺史。境接蕃部，以前弊政滋章，民甚苦之，傅拯自下車，除去弊政數十件，百姓便之。不數月，移刺虢州。離寧州日，衙門聚數千人，折橋遮道以留之。及赴虢，治理清凈，蒸民愛戴如寧州焉。開運中，歷武州刺史，受代歸洛，遇疾卒。傅拯家本多財，尤好賓客，及歷數郡，不事生產，將即世，甚貧匱，物論惜之。秘瓊，鎮州平山人也。父弘遇，以善射歷本軍偏校，累官至慶州刺史。瓊亦有勇。清泰中，董溫琪為鎮州節度使，擢瓊為衙內指揮，倚以腹心。及溫琪陷蕃，瓊乃害溫琪之家，載其屍，都以一坎瘞之。溫琪在任貪暴，積鏹巨萬，瓊悉輦之，以藏其家，遂自稱留後。高祖即位，遣安重榮代之，授瓊齊州防禦使。時重榮與蕃帥趙思溫同行，部曲甚眾，瓊不敢拒命，尋橐其奇貨，由鄴中以赴任。先是，鄴帥範延光將謀叛，遣牙將範鄴持書構瓊，瓊領書不答。使者還，具達其事，延光深忿之。及聞瓊過其境，密使精騎殺瓊於夏津，以滅其口，一行金寶侍伎，皆為延光所有，由是延光異志益露焉。

context.beforeSource: 故淹翔五郡，位不及廉察，抑有由也。
context.afterSource: 李彥珣，邢州人也。
context.beforeLocal: 故淹翔五郡，位不及廉察，抑有由也。
context.afterLocal: 李彥珣，邢州人也。

manualTranslations.zh: 王傅拯，吳江人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Wang Fuzheng was a native of Wujiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Fuzheng was from Wujiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 父綰，偽虔州節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Wan was military commissioner of the false Qianzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Wan had been military commissioner of false Qian.

manualTranslations.zh: 傅拯初事楊溥，為黑雲右廂都指揮使，領本軍戍海州。
manualTranslations.literal: Fuzheng at first served Yang Pu as commander of the Black Cloud right wing and led his army to garrison Haizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fuzheng first served Yang Pu as commander of the Black Cloud right wing and led his army to garrison Hai.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐長興元年，傅拯殺海州刺史陳宣，焚州城，以所部兵五千人來歸。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Changxing of Tang, Fuzheng killed Chen Xuan, prefect of Haizhou, burned the city walls, and came over with five thousand troops of his command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tang Changxing, Fuzheng killed Hai prefect Chen Xuan, burned the city walls, and defected with five thousand troops.

manualTranslations.zh: 明宗喜而納之，授金紫光祿大夫、檢校司徒、曹州刺史，尋移濮州。
manualTranslations.literal: Mingzong was pleased and accepted him, appointing him Grand Master of Splendid Brightness with Golden Seal and Ribbon, Acting Minister of Education, and prefect of Caozhou; soon he was transferred to Puzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Mingzong welcomed him and made him Grand Master of Splendid Brightness with Golden Seal and Ribbon, Acting Minister of Education, and prefect of Cao; soon he was transferred to Pu.

manualTranslations.zh: 清泰中，遷貝州防禦使，秩滿有代，會範延光叛，以兵要傅拯入魏城，疑而不用。
manualTranslations.literal: During Qingtai he was moved to defense commissioner of Beizhou. When his term ended and a successor was due, Fan Yanguang rebelled and used troops to force Fuzheng into Weicheng, but Yanguang suspected him and did not employ him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Qingtai he became defense commissioner of Bei. When his term ended, Fan Yanguang rebelled and forced Fuzheng into Weicheng with troops, but suspected him and did not employ him.

manualTranslations.zh: 延光降，高祖授傅拯諸衛將軍，出為寧州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: When Yanguang surrendered, Gaozu appointed Fuzheng a guard general and sent him out as prefect of Ningzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yanguang surrendered, Gaozu made Fuzheng a guard general and sent him out as prefect of Ning.

manualTranslations.zh: 境接蕃部，以前弊政滋章，民甚苦之，傅拯自下車，除去弊政數十件，百姓便之。
manualTranslations.literal: His territory bordered foreign tribes. Because former corrupt policies had grown worse, the people suffered greatly. From the day Fuzheng took office he removed dozens of corrupt policies, and the people found relief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His territory bordered foreign tribes. Former corrupt policies had grown worse and the people suffered greatly. From his first day in office Fuzheng removed dozens of corrupt policies, and the people were greatly relieved.

manualTranslations.zh: 不數月，移刺虢州。
manualTranslations.literal: In only a few months he was transferred to serve as prefect of Guozhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Within a few months he was transferred to Guo.

manualTranslations.zh: 離寧州日，衙門聚數千人，折橋遮道以留之。
manualTranslations.literal: On the day he left Ningzhou several thousand people gathered at the government gate, broke the bridge, and blocked the road to keep him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the day he left Ning, several thousand people gathered at the government gate, broke the bridge, and blocked the road to keep him.

manualTranslations.zh: 及赴虢，治理清凈，蒸民愛戴如寧州焉。
manualTranslations.literal: When he went to Guo his governance was clean and pure, and the common people loved and supported him as they had at Ningzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At Guo his governance was clean and pure, and the people loved him as they had at Ning.

manualTranslations.zh: 開運中，歷武州刺史，受代歸洛，遇疾卒。
manualTranslations.literal: During Kaiyun he served as prefect of Wuzhou, was relieved and returned to Luoyang, and died of illness on the way.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Kaiyun he served as prefect of Wu, was relieved and returned to Luoyang, and died of illness on the way.

manualTranslations.zh: 傅拯家本多財，尤好賓客，及歷數郡，不事生產，將即世，甚貧匱，物論惜之。
manualTranslations.literal: Fuzheng's family had originally been very wealthy and he especially loved entertaining guests. After serving in several commanderies he did not attend to production, and as he was about to die he was very poor and destitute; public opinion regretted it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fuzheng's family had been wealthy and he loved entertaining guests, but after serving in several commanderies he did not attend to production and died very poor. Public opinion regretted it.

manualTranslations.zh: 秘瓊，鎮州平山人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Mi Qiong was a native of Pingshan in Zhenzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Mi Qiong was from Pingshan in Zhen.

manualTranslations.zh: 父弘遇，以善射歷本軍偏校，累官至慶州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Hongyu, because of skill in archery, rose through the local army as a junior commander and in cumulative office reached prefect of Qingzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Hongyu, a skilled archer, rose through the local army as a junior commander and eventually became prefect of Qing.

manualTranslations.zh: 瓊亦有勇。
manualTranslations.literal: Qiong too was brave.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qiong too was brave.

manualTranslations.zh: 清泰中，董溫琪為鎮州節度使，擢瓊為衙內指揮，倚以腹心。
manualTranslations.literal: During Qingtai, when Dong Wenqi was military commissioner of Zhenzhou, he promoted Qiong to adjutant commander and relied on him as a trusted confidant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Qingtai, when Dong Wenqi was military commissioner of Zhen, he promoted Qiong to adjutant commander and relied on him as a trusted confidant.

manualTranslations.zh: 及溫琪陷蕃，瓊乃害溫琪之家，載其屍，都以一坎瘞之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wenqi fell into the hands of the foreigners, Qiong killed Wenqi's household, loaded their corpses, and buried them all together in one pit in the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Wenqi was captured by foreigners, Qiong killed Wenqi's household, loaded their corpses, and buried them together in one pit in the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 溫琪在任貪暴，積鏹巨萬，瓊悉輦之，以藏其家，遂自稱留後。
manualTranslations.literal: Wenqi had been greedy and violent in office and amassed tens of thousands in cash. Qiong transported it all to hide in his home and then styled himself acting commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wenqi had been greedy and violent in office and amassed vast wealth. Qiong transported it all to his home and styled himself acting commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖即位，遣安重榮代之，授瓊齊州防禦使。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu took the throne he sent An Chongrong to replace him and appointed Qiong defense commissioner of Qizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne he sent An Chongrong to replace him and made Qiong defense commissioner of Qi.

manualTranslations.zh: 時重榮與蕃帥趙思溫同行，部曲甚眾，瓊不敢拒命，尋橐其奇貨，由鄴中以赴任。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Chongrong was traveling with the foreign commander Zhao Siwen, and his retinue was very large. Qiong did not dare refuse the order. Soon he packed his rare valuables and went through Yezhong to reach his post.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chongrong was then traveling with the foreign commander Zhao Siwen with a very large retinue. Qiong did not dare refuse the order, soon packed his valuables, and went through Yezhong to his post.

manualTranslations.zh: 先是，鄴帥範延光將謀叛，遣牙將範鄴持書構瓊，瓊領書不答。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, Fan Yanguang, military commissioner of Ye, was plotting rebellion and sent his adjutant Fan Ye with a letter to recruit Qiong. Qiong received the letter and did not answer.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier Fan Yanguang of Ye was plotting rebellion and sent his adjutant Fan Ye with a letter to recruit Qiong. Qiong received the letter and did not answer.

manualTranslations.zh: 使者還，具達其事，延光深忿之。
manualTranslations.literal: When the messenger returned and reported everything, Yanguang was deeply resentful.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the messenger returned and reported everything, Yanguang was deeply resentful.

manualTranslations.zh: 及聞瓊過其境，密使精騎殺瓊於夏津，以滅其口，一行金寶侍伎，皆為延光所有，由是延光異志益露焉。
manualTranslations.literal: When he heard that Qiong was passing through his territory, he secretly sent elite cavalry to kill Qiong at Xiajin to silence him. All the gold, treasures, attendants, and performers in the party fell into Yanguang's possession, and from this Yanguang's rebellious intent was further exposed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he learned Qiong was passing through his territory, he secretly sent elite cavalry to kill Qiong at Xiajin to silence him. All the gold, treasures, attendants, and performers in the party fell to Yanguang, and his rebellious intent became still more exposed.

sourceRange.text: 處讓勤於公務，孜孜求理，馭吏民不至苛察，人甚便之。高祖幸鄴都，處讓竭家財貢奉，至於薪炭膏沐之細，悉供億焉。六年，除右金吾衛上將軍，處讓自以嘗經重任，又歷方鎮，謂其入朝必重要職，一旦除授金吾，有所不足。少帝即位之初，處讓與宰臣言，有協翼之論，覃恩之際，又未擢用。一日至中書，宰臣馮道、趙瑩、李崧、和凝在列，處讓因酒酣，歷詆諸相，道笑而不答。月餘稱病。八年，從駕歸汴，寄居於封禪寺，遇疾而卒，年六十三。贈太尉，再贈太師。

context.beforeSource: 處讓居喪期年，起復，授彰德軍節度使、澶衛等州觀察處置等使。
context.afterSource: 子保勛，仕皇朝，位至省郎。
context.beforeLocal: 處讓居喪期年，起復，授彰德軍節度使、澶衛等州觀察處置等使。
context.afterLocal: 子保勛，仕皇朝，位至省郎。

manualTranslations.zh: 處讓勤於公務，孜孜求理，馭吏民不至苛察，人甚便之。
manualTranslations.literal: Churang was diligent in public affairs and tirelessly sought good governance. In governing officials and people he was not harshly scrutinizing, and the people found him very convenient.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Churang was diligent in public affairs and tirelessly sought good governance. He governed officials and people without harsh scrutiny, and the people found him very helpful.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖幸鄴都，處讓竭家財貢奉，至於薪炭膏沐之細，悉供億焉。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu visited Yedu, Churang exhausted his household wealth in tribute, even to the smallest items such as firewood, charcoal, and toiletries, supplying them all.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu visited Yedu, Churang spent his household wealth on tribute, even supplying firewood, charcoal, and toiletries.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，除右金吾衛上將軍，處讓自以嘗經重任，又歷方鎮，謂其入朝必重要職，一旦除授金吾，有所不足。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year he was made senior general of the Right Golden Crow Guard. Churang felt that, having once held weighty office and also served in regional commands, on entering court he would surely receive an important post; to be appointed to the Golden Crow guard all at once fell short of his expectations.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was made senior general of the Right Golden Crow Guard. Churang, having once held weighty office and served in regional commands, expected an important post on entering court and felt the Golden Crow appointment fell short.

manualTranslations.zh: 少帝即位之初，處讓與宰臣言，有協翼之論，覃恩之際，又未擢用。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of the Young Emperor's succession Churang spoke with the chief ministers about assisting the throne, but when favors were broadly granted he was again not promoted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in the Young Emperor's reign Churang spoke with the chief ministers about assisting the throne, but when broad favors were granted he was passed over again.

manualTranslations.zh: 一日至中書，宰臣馮道、趙瑩、李崧、和凝在列，處讓因酒酣，歷詆諸相，道笑而不答。
manualTranslations.literal: One day he came to the Secretariat, where the chief ministers Feng Dao, Zhao Ying, Li Song, and He Ning were in attendance. Churang, flushed with wine, reviled the ministers one by one; Dao only smiled and did not answer.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: One day he came to the Secretariat, where Feng Dao, Zhao Ying, Li Song, and He Ning were in attendance. Drunk, Churang reviled the ministers one by one; Dao only smiled and said nothing.

manualTranslations.zh: 月餘稱病。
manualTranslations.literal: After more than a month he pleaded illness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After more than a month he pleaded illness.

manualTranslations.zh: 八年，從駕歸汴，寄居於封禪寺，遇疾而卒，年六十三。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth year he followed the imperial carriage back to Bian and lodged at Fengchan Temple, where he fell ill and died, aged sixty-three.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he followed the emperor back to Bian and lodged at Fengchan Temple, where he fell ill and died at the age of sixty-three.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈太尉，再贈太師。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously granted Grand Commandant and then again Grand Preceptor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Grand Commandant and later Grand Preceptor.

sourceRange.text: 翟璋，未詳何許人也。好勇多力，時目為大蟲，即「虎癡」之稱也。後唐天成初，自鄴都馬步軍都指揮使領平州刺史，尋改復州防禦使。三年三月，遷新州威塞軍兩使留後。四年五月，正授旄節。長興元年二月，加檢校太保，入為右領軍衛上將軍，轉左羽林統軍。清泰中，復領新州。高祖建義，割新州屬契丹。時契丹大軍歸國，遣璋於管內配率犒宴之資，須及十萬緡，山後地貧，民不堪命。始契丹以軟語撫璋，璋謂必得南歸，及委璋平叛奚、圍雲州皆有功，故留之不遣。璋郁郁不得志，遇疾尋卒焉。

context.beforeSource: 朝野士庶，聞者鹹嘆惜之。
context.afterSource: 程福赟，未詳何許人也。
context.beforeLocal: 朝野士庶，聞者鹹嘆惜之。
context.afterLocal: 程福赟，未詳何許人也。

manualTranslations.zh: 翟璋，未詳何許人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Di Zhang — it is not clear from where he came.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Di Zhang — his place of origin is not recorded.

manualTranslations.zh: 好勇多力，時目為大蟲，即「虎癡」之稱也。
manualTranslations.literal: He was brave and possessed great strength; at the time people called him the "Great Worm," that is, the sobriquet "Tiger Fool."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Brave and powerfully built, he was at the time called the "Great Worm"—the nickname "Tiger Fool."

manualTranslations.zh: 後唐天成初，自鄴都馬步軍都指揮使領平州刺史，尋改復州防禦使。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Tiancheng of Later Tang, from commandant of cavalry and infantry at the capital at Yedu he took office as prefect of Ping Prefecture; soon he was changed to defense commissioner of Fu Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tiancheng of Later Tang, from commandant of cavalry and infantry at the Yedu capital he took Ping prefecture; soon he was made defense commissioner of Fu prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年三月，遷新州威塞軍兩使留後。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, third month, he was transferred to acting commissioner of both offices of the Weisai Army at Xin Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, third month, he was transferred to acting commissioner of the dual posts of the Weisai Army at Xin prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年五月，正授旄節。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, fifth month, he was formally granted the command baton and flag.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, fifth month, he was formally granted a command baton and military commission.

manualTranslations.zh: 長興元年二月，加檢校太保，入為右領軍衛上將軍，轉左羽林統軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Changxing, second month, he was promoted to honorary Grand Guardian, entered court as senior general of the Right Leading Army Guard, and transferred to commander of the Left Imperial Forest Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Changxing, second month, he was promoted honorary Grand Guardian, entered court as senior general of the Right Leading Army Guard, and was made commander of the Left Imperial Forest Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 清泰中，復領新州。
manualTranslations.literal: During Qingtai he again held Xin Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Qingtai he again held Xin prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖建義，割新州屬契丹。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Gaozu raised his righteous campaign, Xin Prefecture was ceded to the Khitans.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Gaozu raised his righteous cause, Xin prefecture was ceded to the Khitans.

manualTranslations.zh: 時契丹大軍歸國，遣璋於管內配率犒宴之資，須及十萬緡，山後地貧，民不堪命。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the Khitan great army was returning home; they sent Zhang to levy within his jurisdiction supplies for rewarding and feasting them, which had to reach one hundred thousand strings of cash; the land beyond the mountains was poor and the people could not bear the burden.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time the main Khitan army was returning home and ordered Zhang to levy within his jurisdiction supplies to reward and feast them, amounting to one hundred thousand strings of cash; the region beyond the mountains was poor and the people could not bear it.

manualTranslations.zh: 始契丹以軟語撫璋，璋謂必得南歸，及委璋平叛奚、圍雲州皆有功，故留之不遣。
manualTranslations.literal: Initially the Khitans comforted Zhang with gentle words, and Zhang believed he would surely be allowed to return south; later when they entrusted Zhang to pacify the rebellious Xi and besiege Yun Prefecture he had merit in both, so they kept him and did not send him away.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first the Khitans reassured Zhang with gentle words, and Zhang believed he would surely return south; when they later entrusted him with pacifying the rebellious Xi and besieging Yun prefecture he succeeded in both, so they kept him and would not send him away.

manualTranslations.zh: 璋郁郁不得志，遇疾尋卒焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhang was depressed and unfulfilled; he fell ill and soon died there.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Depressed and unable to fulfill his ambitions, Zhang fell ill and soon died.

sourceRange.text: 鄭阮，洺州人也。少為本部牙將，唐莊宗略地山東，以阮首歸義旗，繼遷軍職。阮有子，自幼事明宗中門使安重誨，重誨以其桀黠，愛之。及明宗即位，擢阮至鳳翔節度副使。會末帝鎮其地，阮稍狎之。末帝嗣位，以阮為趙州刺史。而阮性貪濁，民間細務，皆密察而紀之，令納賂以贖罪。有屬邑令，因科醵拒命，密以束素募人陰求其過，後竟停其職，人甚非之。又嘗以郡符取部內兇肆中人隸其籍者，遣於青州，舁喪至洺，郡人憚其遠，願輸直百緡以免其行，阮本無喪，即受直放還。識者曰：「此非吉兆也。」未幾，改曹州刺史，為政愈弊。高祖建義入洛，阮自郡來朝，旋為本州指揮使石重立所殺，舉族無孑遺。

context.beforeSource: ）遂止罪繼祚一房，不累其族。
context.afterSource: 胡饒，大梁人也。
