manualTranslations.zh: 鄭阮，洺州人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Zheng Ruan was a man of Mingzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zheng Ruan was a native of Mingzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 少為本部牙將，唐莊宗略地山東，以阮首歸義旗，繼遷軍職。
manualTranslations.literal: In youth he served as a military adjutant of his circuit. When Tang Zhuangzong swept through eastern Shandong, Ruan was the first to join the loyalist banner, and thereafter rose through military posts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In youth he served as a military adjutant of his circuit. When Emperor Zhuangzong of Tang conquered eastern Shandong, Ruan was the first to rally to the loyalist cause and thereafter rose through military ranks.

manualTranslations.zh: 阮有子，自幼事明宗中門使安重誨，重誨以其桀黠，愛之。
manualTranslations.literal: Ruan had a son who from childhood served An Chonghui, the middle-gate commissioner under Emperor Mingzong. Chonghui loved him for his shrewd boldness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ruan had a son who from childhood served An Chonghui, Mingzong's middle-gate commissioner. Chonghui took a liking to him for his clever boldness.

manualTranslations.zh: 及明宗即位，擢阮至鳳翔節度副使。
manualTranslations.literal: When Mingzong took the throne, Ruan was promoted to deputy military governor of Fengxiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Mingzong took the throne, Ruan was promoted to deputy military governor of Fengxiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 會末帝鎮其地，阮稍狎之。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Last Emperor governed that region, Ruan grew somewhat familiar with him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Last Emperor governed the region, Ruan grew somewhat familiar with him.

manualTranslations.zh: 末帝嗣位，以阮為趙州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Last Emperor succeeded to the throne, he appointed Ruan prefect of Zhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Last Emperor succeeded to the throne, he appointed Ruan prefect of Zhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 而阮性貪濁，民間細務，皆密察而紀之，令納賂以贖罪。
manualTranslations.literal: But Ruan was greedy and corrupt. He secretly investigated and recorded every petty matter among the people and ordered bribes to redeem offenses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: But Ruan was greedy and corrupt. He secretly investigated and recorded every petty matter among the people and demanded bribes to redeem offenses.

manualTranslations.zh: 有屬邑令，因科醵拒命，密以束素募人陰求其過，後竟停其職，人甚非之。
manualTranslations.literal: A subordinate county magistrate, refusing a levy assessment, was secretly pursued by men hired with cloth bribes to find his faults; he was eventually removed from office, to public condemnation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When a subordinate county magistrate refused a levy assessment, Ruan secretly hired men with cloth bribes to find his faults; the magistrate was eventually removed from office, to widespread condemnation.

manualTranslations.zh: 又嘗以郡符取部內兇肆中人隸其籍者，遣於青州，舁喪至洺，郡人憚其遠，願輸直百緡以免其行，阮本無喪，即受直放還。
manualTranslations.literal: He also once used a prefectural order to take a registered man from the undertaker's shop within his territory and send him to Qingzhou to bear a coffin back to Ming; the people, dreading the distance, offered one hundred strings of cash to be spared the journey. Ruan had no actual bereavement, yet accepted the payment and released the man.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also once used a prefectural order to take a registered man from an undertaker's shop in his territory and send him to Qingzhou to carry a coffin back to Ming. Dreading the distance, the people offered one hundred strings of cash to be spared the journey. Ruan had no bereavement of his own, yet accepted the payment and released the man.

manualTranslations.zh: 識者曰：「此非吉兆也。」
manualTranslations.literal: The knowing said, "This is no good omen."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The knowing said, "This is no good omen."

manualTranslations.zh: 未幾，改曹州刺史，為政愈弊。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long he was transferred to be prefect of Cao, and his governance grew still more corrupt.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to be prefect of Cao, and his governance grew still more corrupt.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖建義入洛，阮自郡來朝，旋為本州指揮使石重立所殺，舉族無孑遺。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu raised the righteous cause and entered Luoyang, Ruan came from his prefecture to court and was soon killed by Shi Chongli, commander of his native prefecture, with his entire clan wiped out to the last.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu raised the righteous cause and entered Luoyang, Ruan came from his prefecture to court and was soon killed by Shi Chongli, commander of his native prefecture, with his entire clan wiped out to the last.

sourceRange.text: 房暠，京兆長安人也。少為唐宰臣崔魏公家臣，後因亂，客於蒲州。天成中，唐末帝出鎮河中，暠於路左迎謁，求事軍門，末帝愛之，使治賓客。及末帝登極，歷南北院宣徽使，尋與趙延壽同為樞密使。時薛文遇、劉延朗之徒居中用事，暠雖處密地，其聽用之言，十不得三四，但隨勢可否，不為事先。每朝廷有大事，暠與端明學士等環坐會議，多於眾中俯首而睡，其避事也如此。高祖即位，以暠濡足閏朝，不專與奪，故特恩原之，命為左驍衛大將軍，留西京。開運元年春，卒於洛陽。孟承誨，大名人也。始為本府牙校，遇高祖臨其地，升為客將。後奏為宗城令，秩滿，以百姓舉留，為常山槁城令，皆有善政。高祖有天下，擢為閣門副使，累遷宣徽使，官至檢校司空、太府卿、右武衛大將軍。及少帝嗣位，以植性纖巧，善於希旨，復與權臣宦官密相表裏，凡朝廷恩澤美使，必承誨為之，一歲之中，數四不已。由是居第華敞，財帛累積。及契丹入汴，張彥澤引兵逼宮城，少帝召承誨計之，承誨匿身不赴。少帝既出宮，寓於開封府舍，具以承誨背恩之事告彥澤，令捕而殺之，其妻女並配部族。漢高祖即位，詔贈太保。

context.beforeSource: 」群論由此減之。
context.afterSource: 劉繼勛，衛州人也。
context.beforeLocal: 群論由此減之。
context.afterLocal: 劉繼勛，衛州人也。

manualTranslations.zh: 房暠，京兆長安人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Fang Gao was a man of Chang'an in Jingzhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fang Gao was a native of Chang'an in Jingzhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 少為唐宰臣崔魏公家臣，後因亂，客於蒲州。
manualTranslations.literal: In youth he served as a household retainer of the Tang chief minister Duke of Wei surnamed Cui; later, amid the turmoil, he sojourned in Puzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In youth he served as a household retainer of the Tang chief minister, the Duke of Wei surnamed Cui; later, amid the turmoil, he sojourned in Puzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 天成中，唐末帝出鎮河中，暠於路左迎謁，求事軍門，末帝愛之，使治賓客。
manualTranslations.literal: During Tiancheng, when the Last Emperor of Tang went out to govern Hezhong, Gao met him at the roadside and sought service at headquarters. The Last Emperor took a liking to him and had him manage guests.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Tiancheng, when the Last Emperor of Tang went out to govern Hezhong, Gao met him at the roadside and sought service at headquarters. The Last Emperor took a liking to him and put him in charge of guests.

manualTranslations.zh: 及末帝登極，歷南北院宣徽使，尋與趙延壽同為樞密使。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Last Emperor ascended the throne, Gao served successively as commissioner of the southern and northern bureaus of the Palace Secretariat, and soon shared the post of confidential commissioner with Zhao Yanshou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Last Emperor ascended the throne, Gao served successively as commissioner of the southern and northern palace secretariat bureaus, and soon shared the post of confidential commissioner with Zhao Yanshou.

manualTranslations.zh: 時薛文遇、劉延朗之徒居中用事，暠雖處密地，其聽用之言，十不得三四，但隨勢可否，不為事先。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Xue Wenyü, Liu Yanlang, and their like held sway at court. Though Gao sat in the innermost councils, only three or four of every ten words he spoke were heeded; he merely assented or demurred as the tide flowed, never taking the lead.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time Xue Wenyü, Liu Yanlang, and their like held sway at court. Though Gao sat in the innermost councils, only three or four of every ten words he spoke were heeded; he merely assented or demurred as the tide flowed, never taking the lead.

manualTranslations.zh: 每朝廷有大事，暠與端明學士等環坐會議，多於眾中俯首而睡，其避事也如此。
manualTranslations.literal: Whenever the court faced a great matter, Gao would sit in conference with the academicians of the Hall of Bright Clarity and the like, and often slept with bowed head among the assembly—such was his way of avoiding responsibility.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whenever the court faced a great matter, Gao would sit in conference with the academicians of the Hall of Bright Clarity and the like, and often slept with bowed head among the assembly—such was his way of avoiding responsibility.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖即位，以暠濡足閏朝，不專與奪，故特恩原之，命為左驍衛大將軍，留西京。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu took the throne, since Gao had wet his feet in two courts and had not monopolized decisions on life and death, he was specially shown grace and pardoned, appointed grand general of the Left Valiant Guards, and kept at the western capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne, since Gao had served under two dynasties and had not monopolized decisions on life and death, he was specially shown grace and pardoned, appointed grand general of the Left Valiant Guards, and kept at the western capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 開運元年春，卒於洛陽。
manualTranslations.literal: In spring of the first year of Kaiyun he died at Luoyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In spring of the first year of Kaiyun he died at Luoyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 孟承誨，大名人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Meng Chenghui was a man of Daming.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Meng Chenghui was a native of Daming.

manualTranslations.zh: 始為本府牙校，遇高祖臨其地，升為客將。
manualTranslations.literal: At first he was a military adjutant of his prefecture; when Gaozu came to the region, he was promoted to guest officer.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first he was a military adjutant of his prefecture; when Gaozu came to the region, he was promoted to guest officer.

manualTranslations.zh: 後奏為宗城令，秩滿，以百姓舉留，為常山槁城令，皆有善政。
manualTranslations.literal: He was later recommended as magistrate of Zongcheng, and when his term ended the people petitioned to keep him; he was made magistrate of Gaocheng in Changshan, showing good governance in both posts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was later recommended as magistrate of Zongcheng, and when his term ended the people petitioned to keep him; he was made magistrate of Gaocheng in Changshan, showing good governance in both posts.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖有天下，擢為閣門副使，累遷宣徽使，官至檢校司空、太府卿、右武衛大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: After Gaozu possessed the realm, Chenghui was promoted to deputy gate commissioner, rose through posts to palace secretariat commissioner, and reached the offices of honorary minister of works, grand minister of the court treasury, and grand general of the Right Martial Guards.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Gaozu possessed the realm, Chenghui was promoted to deputy gate commissioner, rose through posts to palace secretariat commissioner, and reached the offices of honorary minister of works, grand minister of the court treasury, and grand general of the Right Martial Guards.

manualTranslations.zh: 及少帝嗣位，以植性纖巧，善於希旨，復與權臣宦官密相表裏，凡朝廷恩澤美使，必承誨為之，一歲之中，數四不已。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Young Emperor succeeded, because of his subtle, crafty nature and skill at reading intentions, he again worked in secret concert with powerful officials and eunuchs; every grace mission or favor-bearing embassy from the court went through Chenghui, several times within a single year without cease.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the young emperor succeeded, because of his subtle, crafty nature and skill at reading intentions, he again worked in secret concert with powerful officials and eunuchs; every grace mission or favor-bearing embassy from the court went through Chenghui, several times within a single year without cease.

manualTranslations.zh: 由是居第華敞，財帛累積。
manualTranslations.literal: Hence his residence grew splendid and broad, and wealth piled up.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hence his residence grew splendid and broad, and wealth piled up.

manualTranslations.zh: 及契丹入汴，張彥澤引兵逼宮城，少帝召承誨計之，承誨匿身不赴。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Khitans entered Bian, Zhang Yanzhe led troops to press the palace walls. The Young Emperor summoned Chenghui to counsel him, but Chenghui hid himself and did not come.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Khitans entered Bian, Zhang Yanzhe led troops to press the palace walls. The young emperor summoned Chenghui to counsel him, but Chenghui hid himself and did not come.

manualTranslations.zh: 少帝既出宮，寓於開封府舍，具以承誨背恩之事告彥澤，令捕而殺之，其妻女並配部族。
manualTranslations.literal: After the Young Emperor left the palace and lodged at the Kaifeng prefectural offices, he fully told Yanzhe of Chenghui's betrayal of favor and ordered him captured and killed; his wife and daughters were both assigned to tribal peoples.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the young emperor left the palace and lodged at the Kaifeng prefectural offices, he fully told Yanzhe of Chenghui's betrayal of favor and ordered him captured and killed; his wife and daughters were both assigned to tribal peoples.

manualTranslations.zh: 漢高祖即位，詔贈太保。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu of Han took the throne, an edict posthumously enfeoffed him as Grand Guardian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu of Han took the throne, an edict posthumously enfeoffed him as Grand Guardian.

sourceRange.text: 張延播者，汶陽人也。始為郡之牙將，唐同光初，明宗下其城，因收隸左右。天成中，累授檢校司空、兩河發運營田使、柳州刺史。長興元年，出牧蔡州，加檢校司徒，入為左領軍衛大將軍，充客省使。伐蜀之役，命為馬軍都監。三年，遷鳳州防禦使、西面水陸轉運使。高祖即位，除東都副留守。車駕幸汴，遣兼洛京巡檢使。張從賓作亂，令延播知河南府事。從賓敗，伏誅。

context.beforeSource: 高祖命杜重威、侯益分兵討之，從賓大敗，乘馬入河，溺水而死焉。
context.afterSource: 楊光遠，小字阿檀，及長，止名檀，唐天成中，以明宗改御名為亶，以偏傍字犯之，始改名光遠，字德明，其先沙陀部人也。
context.beforeLocal: 高祖命杜重威、侯益分兵討之，從賓大敗，乘馬入河，溺水而死焉。

manualTranslations.zh: 張延播者，汶陽人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhang Yanbo was a native of Wenyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanbo came from Wenyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 始為郡之牙將，唐同光初，明宗下其城，因收隸左右。
manualTranslations.literal: At first he was a guard officer of the commandery; at the beginning of the Tongguang era of Tang, when Mingzong took his city, he was received into the personal retinue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He first served as a guard officer of the commandery. Early in the Tongguang reign, when Mingzong captured his city, he was brought into Mingzong's personal retinue.

manualTranslations.zh: 天成中，累授檢校司空、兩河發運營田使、柳州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Tiancheng era he was successively appointed Honorary Minister of Works, commissioner for transport and agricultural garrison of the Two Rivers, and prefect of Liuzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Tiancheng reign he was successively appointed Honorary Minister of Works, commissioner for transport and agricultural garrison of the Two Rivers, and prefect of Liuzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 長興元年，出牧蔡州，加檢校司徒，入為左領軍衛大將軍，充客省使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Changxing he went out to govern Caizhou, was given the additional title of acting Grand Mentor, entered office as grand general of the Left Imperial Guards Army, and served as commissioner of the guest bureau.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Changxing 1 he was sent out to govern Caizhou, promoted to acting Grand Mentor, appointed grand general of the Left Imperial Guards Army, and made commissioner of the guest bureau.

manualTranslations.zh: 伐蜀之役，命為馬軍都監。
manualTranslations.literal: In the campaign against Shu he was ordered to be cavalry inspector.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the campaign against Shu he was made cavalry inspector.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，遷鳳州防禦使、西面水陸轉運使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to defense commissioner of Fengzhou and Western land-and-water transport commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year he became defense commissioner of Fengzhou and Western land-and-water transport commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖即位，除東都副留守。
manualTranslations.literal: When the High Ancestor ascended the throne, he was made deputy defender of the Eastern Capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne, he was appointed deputy defender of the Eastern Capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 車駕幸汴，遣兼洛京巡檢使。
manualTranslations.literal: When the imperial carriage visited Bian, he was sent also to serve as capital patrol commissioner for Luoyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the emperor visited Bian, he was also appointed capital patrol commissioner for Luoyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 張從賓作亂，令延播知河南府事。
manualTranslations.literal: When Zhang Congbin rebelled, Yanbo was ordered to administer Henan Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhang Congbin rebelled, Yanbo was put in charge of Henan Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 從賓敗，伏誅。
manualTranslations.literal: When Congbin was defeated, Yanbo was executed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Congbin was defeated, Yanbo was executed.

sourceRange.text: ）安從進。（《歐陽史》：從進，其先索葛部人也。初事莊宗為護駕馬軍都指揮使，領貴州刺史，明宗時為保義彰武軍節度使。湣帝即位，徙領順化。清泰中，徙鎮山南東道。晉高祖即位，加同中書門下平章事。）天福六年，高祖幸鄴，討安重榮。少帝以鄭王留守京師，時和凝請於高祖曰：「陛下北征，臣料安從進必反，何以制之？」高祖曰：「卿意將奈何？」凝曰：「臣聞之兵法，先人者奪人。願陛下為空名宣敕十通授鄭王，有急則命將往。」從進聞高祖往北，遂反，少帝以空名授李建崇、郭金海討之。從進引兵攻鄧州，不克，進至湖陽，遇建崇等，大駭，以為神速，復為野火所燒，遂大敗，從進自焚。張彥澤，其先出於突厥，後為太原人也。祖、父世為陰山府裨將。彥澤少有勇力，目睛黃而夜有光色，顧視若鷙獸焉。以騎射事後唐莊宗、明宗，以從戰有功，繼領郡守。高祖即位，擢為曹州刺史。從楊光遠圍範延光於鄴，以功授華州節度使，尋移鎮涇州，累官至檢校太保。

context.beforeSource: 」未幾，與王師先鋒遇，一戰而敗。
context.afterSource: 有從事張式者，以宗人之分，受其知遇。

items.sourceTextOverride: 安從進。（《歐陽史》：從進，其先索葛部人也。初事莊宗為護駕馬軍都指揮使，領貴州刺史，明宗時為保義彰武軍節度使。湣帝即位，徙領順化。清泰中，徙鎮山南東道。晉高祖即位，加同中書門下平章事。）天福六年，高祖幸鄴，討安重榮。少帝以鄭王留守京師，時和凝請於高祖曰：「陛下北征，臣料安從進必反，何以制之？」高祖曰：「卿意將奈何？」凝曰：「臣聞之兵法，先人者奪人。願陛下為空名宣敕十通授鄭王，有急則命將往。」從進聞高祖往北，遂反，少帝以空名授李建崇、郭金海討之。從進引兵攻鄧州，不克，進至湖陽，遇建崇等，大駭，以為神速，復為野火所燒，遂大敗，從進自焚。張彥澤，其先出於突厥，後為太原人也。祖、父世為陰山府裨將。彥澤少有勇力，目睛黃而夜有光色，顧視若鷙獸焉。以騎射事後唐莊宗、明宗，以從戰有功，繼領郡守。高祖即位，擢為曹州刺史。從楊光遠圍範延光於鄴，以功授華州節度使，尋移鎮涇州，累官至檢校太保。

manualTranslations.zh: 安從進。
manualTranslations.literal: An Congjin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An Congjin.

manualTranslations.zh: （《歐陽史》：從進，其先索葛部人也。
manualTranslations.literal: (Old History of the Five Dynasties: Congjin's ancestors were of the Suoge tribe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: (Old History of the Five Dynasties: Congjin's ancestors were of the Suoge tribe.

manualTranslations.zh: 初事莊宗為護駕馬軍都指揮使，領貴州刺史，明宗時為保義彰武軍節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: At first he served Zhuangzong as commander of the palace-guard cavalry, held the post of prefect of Guizhou, and under Mingzong was military governor of Baoyi and Zhangwu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first he served Zhuangzong as commander of the palace-guard cavalry, held Guizhou as prefect, and under Mingzong was military governor of Baoyi and Zhangwu.

manualTranslations.zh: 湣帝即位，徙領順化。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Min took the throne he was transferred to command Shunhua.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Min took the throne he was transferred to command Shunhua.

manualTranslations.zh: 清泰中，徙鎮山南東道。
manualTranslations.literal: During Qingtai he was transferred to command Shannan East Circuit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Qingtai he was transferred to command Shannan East Circuit.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉高祖即位，加同中書門下平章事。）
manualTranslations.literal: When Jin Gaozu took the throne he was made Acting Chief Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.)
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Jin Gaozu took the throne he was made Acting Chief Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.)

manualTranslations.zh: 天福六年，高祖幸鄴，討安重榮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year of Tianfu Gaozu went to Ye to campaign against An Chongrong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth Tianfu year Gaozu went to Ye to campaign against An Chongrong.

manualTranslations.zh: 少帝以鄭王留守京師，時和凝請於高祖曰：「陛下北征，臣料安從進必反，何以制之？」
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Shaodi had the Prince of Zheng remain at the capital. At that time He Ning petitioned Gaozu, saying, "Your Majesty is campaigning north. I expect An Congjin will certainly rebel. How are we to control him?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Shaodi had the Prince of Zheng remain at the capital. He Ning then petitioned Gaozu, saying, "Your Majesty is campaigning north. I expect An Congjin will certainly rebel. How can he be controlled?"

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖曰：「卿意將奈何？」
manualTranslations.literal: Gaozu said, "What do you propose?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gaozu said, "What do you propose?"

manualTranslations.zh: 凝曰：「臣聞之兵法，先人者奪人。
manualTranslations.literal: Ning said, "I have heard in the art of war that he who strikes first seizes the initiative from others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ning said, "I have heard in the art of war that he who strikes first seizes the initiative from others.

manualTranslations.zh: 願陛下為空名宣敕十通授鄭王，有急則命將往。」
manualTranslations.literal: I beg Your Majesty to prepare ten blank imperial edicts and give them to the Prince of Zheng, so that in an emergency he may commission generals to go."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to prepare ten blank imperial edicts and give them to the Prince of Zheng, so that in an emergency he may commission generals to go."

manualTranslations.zh: 從進聞高祖往北，遂反，少帝以空名授李建崇、郭金海討之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Congjin heard Gaozu had gone north he rebelled. Shaodi used blank commissions to appoint Li Jianchong and Guo Jinhai to suppress him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Congjin heard Gaozu had gone north he rebelled. Shaodi used blank commissions to appoint Li Jianchong and Guo Jinhai to suppress him.

manualTranslations.zh: 從進引兵攻鄧州，不克，進至湖陽，遇建崇等，大駭，以為神速，復為野火所燒，遂大敗，從進自焚。
manualTranslations.literal: Congjin led troops to attack Dengzhou but could not take it. Advancing to Huyang he met Jianchong and the others, was greatly alarmed, took their speed for supernatural swiftness, and was again burned by wildfire. He was utterly defeated and Congjin burned himself to death.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Congjin led troops against Dengzhou but failed to take it. Advancing to Huyang he met Jianchong and the others, was greatly alarmed, took their speed for supernatural swiftness, and was again burned by wildfire. Utterly defeated, Congjin burned himself to death.

manualTranslations.zh: 張彥澤，其先出於突厥，後為太原人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhang Yanze's ancestors came from the Turks and later became men of Taiyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanze's ancestors came from the Turks and later became men of Taiyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 祖、父世為陰山府裨將。
manualTranslations.literal: His grandfather and father for generations were deputy generals of Yinshan Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His grandfather and father for generations were deputy generals of Yinshan Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 彥澤少有勇力，目睛黃而夜有光色，顧視若鷙獸焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Yanze in youth had courage and strength; his eyes were yellow and at night gave off a luminous color; when he turned his gaze he seemed like a fierce beast.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yanze in youth had courage and strength. His eyes were yellow and at night gave off a luminous glow; when he turned his gaze he seemed like a fierce beast.

manualTranslations.zh: 以騎射事後唐莊宗、明宗，以從戰有功，繼領郡守。
manualTranslations.literal: With riding and archery he served Later Tang's Zhuangzong and Mingzong; for meritorious service in battle he successively held prefectures.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With riding and archery he served Later Tang's Zhuangzong and Mingzong. For meritorious service in battle he successively held prefectures.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖即位，擢為曹州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu took the throne he was promoted to prefect of Caozhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne he was promoted to prefect of Caozhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 從楊光遠圍範延光於鄴，以功授華州節度使，尋移鎮涇州，累官至檢校太保。
manualTranslations.literal: Following Yang Guangyuan in besieging Fan Yanguang at Ye, for his achievements he was made military governor of Huazhou, soon transferred to command Jingzhou, and rose to Acting Grand Guardian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Following Yang Guangyuan in besieging Fan Yanguang at Ye, he was made military governor of Huazhou for his achievements, soon transferred to command Jingzhou, and rose to Acting Grand Guardian.

sourceRange.text: ）延壽，本姓劉氏。父曰邧，常山人也，嘗任蓚令。梁開平初，滄州節度使劉守文陷其邑，時德鈞為偏將，獲延壽並其母種氏，遂養之為子。延壽姿貌妍柔，稍涉書史，尤好賓客，亦能為詩。（《太平廣記》引《趙延壽傳》云：延壽幼習武略，即戎之暇，時復以篇什為意，嘗在北庭賦詩曰：「占得高原肥草地，夜深生火折林梢。」南人聞者傳之。）及長，尚明宗女興平公主。初為汴州司馬，明宗即位，授汝州刺史，歷河陽、宋州節度使，入為上將軍，充宣徽使，遷樞密使，兼鎮徐州。及高祖起義於晉陽，唐末帝幸懷州，委延壽北伐。後高祖至潞州，延壽與父德鈞俱陷北庭。未幾，契丹主以延壽為幽州節度使，封燕王，尋為樞密使兼政事令。

context.beforeSource: 德鈞既卒，國主釋延壽而用之。
context.afterSource: 天福末，契丹與少帝絕好，契丹主委延壽以圖南之事，許以中原帝之。

manualTranslations.zh: 延壽，本姓劉氏。
manualTranslations.literal: Yanshou was originally surnamed Liu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yanshou was originally surnamed Liu.

manualTranslations.zh: 父曰邧，常山人也，嘗任蓚令。
manualTranslations.literal: His father was named Kuang, a man of Changshan who had once served as magistrate of Tiao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father was named Kuang, a man of Changshan who had once served as magistrate of Tiao.

manualTranslations.zh: 梁開平初，滄州節度使劉守文陷其邑，時德鈞為偏將，獲延壽並其母種氏，遂養之為子。
manualTranslations.literal: Early in Liang's Kaiping era the Cangzhou military governor Liu Shouwen overran his county. Dejun was then a deputy general, captured Yanshou together with his mother Lady Zhong, and adopted him as son.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Liang's Kaiping era the Cangzhou military governor Liu Shouwen overran his county. Dejun was then a deputy general, captured Yanshou together with his mother Lady Zhong, and adopted him as his son.

manualTranslations.zh: 延壽姿貌妍柔，稍涉書史，尤好賓客，亦能為詩。
manualTranslations.literal: Yanshou had a graceful and delicate appearance, had some knowledge of books and history, especially loved entertaining guests, and could also compose poetry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yanshou had a graceful and delicate appearance, had some knowledge of books and history, especially loved entertaining guests, and could also compose poetry.

manualTranslations.zh: （《太平廣記》引《趙延壽傳》云：延壽幼習武略，即戎之暇，時復以篇什為意，嘗在北庭賦詩曰：「占得高原肥草地，夜深生火折林梢。」
manualTranslations.literal: (Extensive Records of the Taiping Era, citing the Biography of Zhao Yanshou, says: Yanshou in youth studied military strategy, and in intervals from campaigning would turn to verse. Once at Beiting he composed a poem saying, "Choosing a fat meadow on the high plain, deep in the night I kindle fire and break off treetops."

manualTranslations.zh: 南人聞者傳之。）
manualTranslations.literal: Southerners who heard it spread it about.)
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Southerners who heard it spread it about.)

manualTranslations.zh: 及長，尚明宗女興平公主。
manualTranslations.literal: When he came of age he married Mingzong's daughter Princess Xingping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he came of age he married Mingzong's daughter Princess Xingping.

manualTranslations.zh: 初為汴州司馬，明宗即位，授汝州刺史，歷河陽、宋州節度使，入為上將軍，充宣徽使，遷樞密使，兼鎮徐州。
manualTranslations.literal: At first he was vice prefect of Bianzhou. When Mingzong took the throne he was made prefect of Ruzhou, held the military governorships of Heyang and Songzhou in succession, entered court as Grand General, served as Palace Commissioner, was transferred to Commissioner of Military Affairs, and concurrently commanded Xuzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first he was vice prefect of Bianzhou. When Mingzong took the throne he was made prefect of Ruzhou, held the military governorships of Heyang and Songzhou in succession, entered court as Grand General, served as Palace Commissioner, was transferred to Commissioner of Military Affairs, and concurrently commanded Xuzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 及高祖起義於晉陽，唐末帝幸懷州，委延壽北伐。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu raised righteous arms at Jinyang, Tang's last emperor went to Huaizhou and entrusted Yanshou with the northern campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu raised righteous arms at Jinyang, Tang's last emperor went to Huaizhou and entrusted Yanshou with the northern campaign.

manualTranslations.zh: 後高祖至潞州，延壽與父德鈞俱陷北庭。
manualTranslations.literal: Later when Gaozu reached Luzhou, Yanshou and his father Dejun both fell into Khitan hands.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later when Gaozu reached Luzhou, Yanshou and his father Dejun both fell into Khitan hands.

manualTranslations.zh: 未幾，契丹主以延壽為幽州節度使，封燕王，尋為樞密使兼政事令。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long the Khitan ruler made Yanshou military governor of Youzhou, enfeoffed him as Prince of Yan, and soon made him Commissioner of Military Affairs and concurrently Director of State Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long the Khitan ruler made Yanshou military governor of Youzhou, enfeoffed him as Prince of Yan, and soon made him Commissioner of Military Affairs and concurrently Director of State Affairs.

sourceRange.text: ）清泰元年，晉高祖復鎮河東。三年夏，移鎮汶陽。帝勸晉高祖舉義，贊成密計，經綸之始，中外賴之。晉高祖以帝為北京馬步軍都指揮使。及契丹以全軍赴難，大破張敬達之眾於晉陽城下，有降軍千餘人，晉高祖將置之於親衛，帝盡殺之。晉國初建，加檢校司空，充侍衛馬步都指揮使，權點檢隨駕六軍諸衛事，尋改陜州節度使，充侍衛親軍馬步都虞候。契丹主送晉高祖至上黨，指帝謂高祖曰：「此都軍甚操剌，無大故不可棄之。」晉高祖入洛，委帝巡警，都邑肅然，無敢犯令。

manualTranslations.zh: 清泰元年，晉高祖復鎮河東。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Qingtai, Jin Gaozu again took command at Hedong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qingtai (934), Jin Gaozu was restored as military governor of Hedong.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年夏，移鎮汶陽。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer of the third year he transferred his command to Wenyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the summer of the third year he was reassigned to Wenyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝勸晉高祖舉義，贊成密計，經綸之始，中外賴之。
manualTranslations.literal: The Emperor urged Jin Gaozu to raise righteous arms, approved secret plans, and at the start of grand strategy both court and country relied on him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He urged Jin Gaozu to rebel, helped plan the coup in secret, and from the outset of the enterprise both the court and the realm relied on him.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉高祖以帝為北京馬步軍都指揮使。
manualTranslations.literal: Jin Gaozu made the Emperor commander of the Northern Capital horse-and-foot army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jin Gaozu appointed him commander of the Northern Capital horse-and-foot forces.

manualTranslations.zh: 及契丹以全軍赴難，大破張敬達之眾於晉陽城下，有降軍千餘人，晉高祖將置之於親衛，帝盡殺之。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Khitan came with their full army to aid him, they greatly defeated Zhang Jingda's forces below Jinyang; there were more than a thousand surrendered troops; Jin Gaozu intended to place them in his personal guard; the Emperor killed them all.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Khitan marched in full force to relieve the siege, they routed Zhang Jingda's army below Jinyang. More than a thousand surrendered troops were to be enrolled in Gaozu's personal guard, but the future emperor had them all slaughtered.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉國初建，加檢校司空，充侍衛馬步都指揮使，權點檢隨駕六軍諸衛事，尋改陜州節度使，充侍衛親軍馬步都虞候。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Jin state was first established, he was promoted to Acting Minister of Works, made commander of the palace horse-and-foot guard with acting inspection of the six armies and guards attending the emperor, and soon made military governor of Shaanzhou and chief registrar of the palace guard horse-and-foot forces.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Jin was first founded he was made Acting Minister of Works and commander of the palace horse-and-foot guard, with acting oversight of the six armies and palace guards on campaign; soon afterward he was transferred to military governor of Shaanzhou and made chief aide of the palace guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 契丹主送晉高祖至上黨，指帝謂高祖曰：「此都軍甚操剌，無大故不可棄之。
manualTranslations.literal: The Khitan ruler escorted Jin Gaozu to Shangdang, pointed at the Emperor and said to Gaozu: "This commander is very caola; without a major cause do not abandon him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Khitan ruler escorted Jin Gaozu to Shangdang. Pointing at the future emperor, he told Gaozu, "This commander is very caola—without grave cause do not cast him aside.

manualTranslations.zh: 」晉高祖入洛，委帝巡警，都邑肅然，無敢犯令。
manualTranslations.literal: " Jin Gaozu entered Luoyang, entrusted the Emperor with patrol duties, and the capital grew orderly; none dared violate the law.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " When Jin Gaozu entered Luoyang he entrusted him with patrol duties, and the capital grew so orderly that none dared break the law.

sourceRange.text: 十二月辛巳朔，以護聖左廂都指揮使、岳州防禦使李洪信為遂州節度使，充侍衛步軍都指揮使；以護聖右廂都指揮使、永州防禦使尚洪遷為夔州節度使，充侍衛步軍都指揮使。丙戌，車駕發鄴都歸京。癸巳，至自鄴都。甲午，以皇子開封尹承訓薨。廢朝三日，追封魏王。丁酉，帝舉哀於太平宮。庚子，司徒李鏻薨。辛丑，以前鄜州節度使郭謹為滑州節度使，加檢校太尉。戊申，宿州奏，部民餓死者八百六十有七人。

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月辛巳朔，以護聖左廂都指揮使、岳州防禦使李洪信為遂州節度使，充侍衛步軍都指揮使；
manualTranslations.literal: On the first day (xinsi) of the twelfth month, Li Hongxin, Left Wing overall commander of the Imperial Guard and defense commissioner of Yue, was made military governor of Sui and concurrently overall commander of the palace foot guards;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the twelfth month, left-wing imperial guard commander and Yue defense commissioner Li Hongxin was made Sui governor and concurrent palace foot-guard commander;

manualTranslations.zh: 以護聖右廂都指揮使、永州防禦使尚洪遷為夔州節度使，充侍衛步軍都指揮使。
manualTranslations.literal: Shang Hongqian, Right Wing overall commander of the Imperial Guard and defense commissioner of Yong, was made military governor of Kui and concurrently overall commander of the palace foot guards.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Right-wing imperial guard commander and Yong defense commissioner Shang Hongqian was made Kui governor and concurrent palace foot-guard commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙戌，車駕發鄴都歸京。
manualTranslations.literal: On bingxu the imperial carriage departed Yedu and returned to the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On bingxu the emperor left Yedu and returned to the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸巳，至自鄴都。
manualTranslations.literal: On guisi he returned from Yedu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On guisi he returned from Yedu.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲午，以皇子開封尹承訓薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On jiawu the imperial prince Chengxun, Kaifeng prefect, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiawu imperial prince Chengxun, Kaifeng prefect, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 廢朝三日，追封魏王。
manualTranslations.literal: Court audiences were suspended for three days; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Wei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Court was closed for three days, and he was posthumously created Prince of Wei.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁酉，帝舉哀於太平宮。
manualTranslations.literal: On dingyou the Emperor held mourning rites at Taiping Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingyou the emperor mourned at Taiping Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 庚子，司徒李鏻薨。
manualTranslations.literal: On gengzi Minister of Education Li Lin died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On gengzi minister of education Li Lin died.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛丑，以前鄜州節度使郭謹為滑州節度使，加檢校太尉。
manualTranslations.literal: On xinchou Guo Jin, former military governor of Fu, was made military governor of Hua and given the additional Honorary Grand Guardian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinchou former Fu governor Guo Jin was appointed Hua governor and promoted to honorary grand guardian.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊申，宿州奏，部民餓死者八百六十有七人。
manualTranslations.literal: On wushen Suzhou memorialized that among the local populace eight hundred sixty-seven had died of starvation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On wushen Suzhou reported that 867 local commoners had died of starvation.

sourceRange.text: ◎宗室魏王承訓，字德輝，高祖之長子也。少溫厚，美姿儀，高祖尤鐘愛。在晉累官至檢校司空，國初授左衛上將軍。高祖將赴洛，命承訓北京大內巡檢，未幾，詔赴闕，授開封尹、檢校太尉、同平章事。以天福十二年十二月十一日薨於府署，年二十六。高祖發哀於太平宮，哭之大慟，以至於不豫。是月，追封魏王。歸葬於太原。陳王承勛，高祖之幼子也。國初授右衛大將軍。隱帝嗣位，加檢校太尉、同平章事，遙領興元尹，俄代侯益為開封尹，進位檢校太師、兼侍中。乾祐三年冬十一月，蕭墻之亂，隱帝崩，軍情欲立勛為嗣。時勛已病，大臣及諸將請候勛起居，太后令左右以臥榻舁之以見，諸將就視，知勛之不能興，故議立劉赟。周廣順元年春卒。周太祖下詔封陳王。

context.afterSource: 蔡王信，高祖之從弟也。
context.afterLocal: 蔡王信，高祖之從弟也。

manualTranslations.zh: ◎宗室魏王承訓，字德輝，高祖之長子也。
manualTranslations.literal: ◎ Prince Wei of the Imperial House Cheng Xun, courtesy name Dehui, was Gaozu's eldest son.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: ◎ Prince Wei Cheng Xun of the imperial house, courtesy name Dehui, was eldest son of Later Han Gaozu.

manualTranslations.zh: 少溫厚，美姿儀，高祖尤鐘愛。
manualTranslations.literal: In youth he was gentle and warm-hearted, with handsome features; Gaozu especially cherished him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As a youth he was mild and warm-hearted, handsome in bearing, and Gaozu doted on him above all.

manualTranslations.zh: 在晉累官至檢校司空，國初授左衛上將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: While at Jin he rose through repeated offices to honorary Minister of Works; at the founding of the state he was made Left Guard Grand General.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Jin service he rose step by step to honorary Minister of Works; at the dynasty's founding he was made Left Guard Grand General.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖將赴洛，命承訓北京大內巡檢，未幾，詔赴闕，授開封尹、檢校太尉、同平章事。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu was about to go to Luoyang, he ordered Cheng Xun to inspect the inner palace at the Northern Capital; before long an edict summoned him to court, and he was given the posts of Kaifeng prefect, honorary Grand Marshal, and Associate Director of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As Gaozu prepared to go to Luoyang, he ordered Cheng Xun to inspect the inner palace at the Northern Capital; soon an edict recalled him to court and made him Kaifeng prefect, honorary Grand Marshal, and vice grand councilor.

manualTranslations.zh: 以天福十二年十二月十一日薨於府署，年二十六。
manualTranslations.literal: On the eleventh day of the twelfth month in the twelfth year of Tianfu he died at his yamen, aged twenty-six.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the eleventh day of the twelfth month of Tianfu 12 he died at his yamen, aged twenty-six.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖發哀於太平宮，哭之大慟，以至於不豫。
manualTranslations.literal: Gaozu held mourning rites at Taiping Palace, weeping with such anguish that he fell ill.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gaozu mourned at Taiping Palace and wept so bitterly that he fell ill.

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，追封魏王。
manualTranslations.literal: That month he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Wei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month he was posthumously created Prince of Wei.

manualTranslations.zh: 歸葬於太原。
manualTranslations.literal: His body was returned for burial at Taiyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was returned to Taiyuan for burial.

manualTranslations.zh: 陳王承勛，高祖之幼子也。
manualTranslations.literal: Prince Chen Cheng Xun was Gaozu's youngest son.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prince Chen Cheng Xun was Gaozu's youngest son.

manualTranslations.zh: 國初授右衛大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: At the founding of the state he was made Right Guard Grand General.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the dynasty's founding he was made Right Guard Grand General.

manualTranslations.zh: 隱帝嗣位，加檢校太尉、同平章事，遙領興元尹，俄代侯益為開封尹，進位檢校太師、兼侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Hidden Emperor succeeded, he was given the additional titles of honorary Grand Marshal and Associate Director of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and concurrently held distant command as prefect of Xingyuan; soon he replaced Hou Yi as Kaifeng prefect and was advanced to honorary Grand Preceptor and concurrent Palace Attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yin succeeded, he was made honorary Grand Marshal and vice grand councilor, with distant command as Xingyuan prefect; soon he replaced Hou Yi as Kaifeng prefect and was promoted to honorary Grand Preceptor and Palace Attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾祐三年冬十一月，蕭墻之亂，隱帝崩，軍情欲立勛為嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter in the third year of Qianyou, at the palace upheaval the Hidden Emperor perished, and the army's sentiment was to establish Xun as heir.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Qianyou 3, at the palace upheaval Emperor Yin died, and the armies wanted to make Xun heir.

manualTranslations.zh: 時勛已病，大臣及諸將請候勛起居，太后令左右以臥榻舁之以見，諸將就視，知勛之不能興，故議立劉赟。
manualTranslations.literal: Xun was already ill; the chief ministers and generals requested to call on his health, and the empress dowager had attendants carry him on a couch to be seen; the generals went up and looked, and knowing he could not rise, they therefore deliberated on establishing Liu Yun as heir.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xun was already ill; ministers and generals asked to call on him, and the dowager had attendants carry him on a couch to be seen; when the generals looked and saw he could not rise, they turned to naming Liu Yun heir.

manualTranslations.zh: 周廣順元年春卒。
manualTranslations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Zhou Guangshun he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the spring of Guangshun 1.

manualTranslations.zh: 周太祖下詔封陳王。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhou Taizu issued an edict enfeoffing him as Prince of Chen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhou Taizu issued an edict creating him Prince of Chen.

sourceRange.text: 郭謹，字守節，太原晉陽人。謹少從軍，能騎射，歷河中教練使。晉天福中，遷奉國右廂都指揮使，領禺州刺史。三年，轉奉國左廂都指揮、泗州防禦使。歲餘，授侍衛步軍都指揮使兼寧江軍節度使。六年，從幸鄴。七年，晉祖崩，少帝即位，授彰德軍節度使，領軍如故。開運初，出授鄜州。二年，入為左神武統軍。三年，復鎮鄜州。高祖踐阼，以鄉國舊臣，加檢校太尉，移鎮滑臺。乾祐初，復授彰德軍節度使。二年，就加檢校太師。三年，入朝，加食邑。是歲冬十月，卒於位，年六十。輟視朝二日，贈侍中。皇甫立，代北人也。唐明宗之刺代州，署為牙校，從歷藩鎮。性純謹，明宗深委信之，王建立、安重誨策名委質、皆在立後。明宗踐阼，以立為忻州刺史。長興末，轉洺州團練使。應順初，遷鄜州節度使，檢校太保。清泰三年春，移鎮潞州，未幾，改華州。晉天福中，授左神武統軍。少帝即位，歷左金吾衛上將軍，累官至檢校太尉。高祖定天下，授特進、太子太師致仕。乾祐二年秋卒。

context.beforeSource: 乾祐三年冬，卒於郡。
context.afterSource: 白再榮，本蕃部人也。
context.beforeLocal: 乾祐三年冬，卒於郡。
context.afterLocal: 白再榮，本蕃部人也。

manualTranslations.zh: 郭謹，字守節，太原晉陽人。
manualTranslations.literal: Guo Jin, style name Shoujie, was a man of Jinyang in Taiyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guo Jin, courtesy name Shoujie, was a native of Jinyang in Taiyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 謹少從軍，能騎射，歷河中教練使。
manualTranslations.literal: Jin in youth followed the army, could ride and shoot, and served as training commissioner in Hezhong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He entered the army young, was skilled at horsemanship and archery, and served as training commissioner at Hezhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉天福中，遷奉國右廂都指揮使，領禺州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianfu of Jin he was transferred to commander of the right wing of the Fengguo Guard and held the prefecture of Yuzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Jin Tianfu he became commander of the Fengguo Guard's right wing and prefect of Yuzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，轉奉國左廂都指揮、泗州防禦使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to commander of the left wing of Fengguo and defense commissioner of Sizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 3 he moved to commander of the Fengguo left wing and defense commissioner of Sizhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 歲餘，授侍衛步軍都指揮使兼寧江軍節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: After more than a year he was appointed overall commander of the palace guard infantry and military commissioner of Ningjiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A little over a year later he was made overall commander of the palace infantry and military commissioner of Ningjiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，從幸鄴。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year he accompanied the emperor to Ye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 6 he accompanied the emperor to Ye.

manualTranslations.zh: 七年，晉祖崩，少帝即位，授彰德軍節度使，領軍如故。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh year the Jin ancestor died and the Young Emperor succeeded; he was appointed military commissioner of Zhangde, retaining his military post as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 7, after the Jin emperor's death and the Young Emperor's accession, he was made military commissioner of Zhangde while keeping his command.

manualTranslations.zh: 開運初，出授鄜州。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Kaiyun he was sent out to hold Meizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Kaiyun he was posted to Meizhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，入為左神武統軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year he entered the capital as overall commander of the Left Divine Martial Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 2 he became overall commander of the Left Divine Martial Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，復鎮鄜州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year he again garrisoned Meizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 3 he returned to govern Meizhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖踐阼，以鄉國舊臣，加檢校太尉，移鎮滑臺。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu ascended the throne, because he was an old follower from the homeland he was given honorary Grand Marshal and transferred to garrison Huatai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne he was made honorary Grand Marshal as a veteran from their homeland and transferred to Huatai.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾祐初，復授彰德軍節度使。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Qianyou he was again appointed military commissioner of Zhangde.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Qianyou he was again made military commissioner of Zhangde.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，就加檢校太師。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year he was further given honorary Grand Preceptor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 2 he received the further title of honorary Grand Preceptor.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，入朝，加食邑。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year he came to court and received an increase in his fief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In year 3 he went to court and was granted an enlarged fief.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲冬十月，卒於位，年六十。
manualTranslations.literal: That winter in the tenth month he died in office, aged sixty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in office that winter, in the tenth month, at the age of sixty.

manualTranslations.zh: 輟視朝二日，贈侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: Court audiences were suspended for two days, and he was posthumously given Palace Attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Court audiences were suspended for two days, and he was posthumously made Palace Attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇甫立，代北人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Huangfu Li was a man of northern Dai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Huangfu Li was from northern Dai.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐明宗之刺代州，署為牙校，從歷藩鎮。
manualTranslations.literal: When Mingzong of Tang was military commissioner of Daizhou, he appointed Li as a yamen officer; Li followed him through successive provincial commands.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Mingzong of Tang governed Daizhou he appointed Li a yamen officer, and Li followed him through successive postings.

manualTranslations.zh: 性純謹，明宗深委信之，王建立、安重誨策名委質、皆在立後。
manualTranslations.literal: His nature was pure and dutiful; Mingzong deeply entrusted him. Wang Jianli and An Chonghui both entered service after Li had done so.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was upright and conscientious, and Mingzong trusted him deeply. Wang Jianli and An Chonghui both entered service only after Li had.

manualTranslations.zh: 明宗踐阼，以立為忻州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: When Mingzong ascended the throne he made Li prefect of Xinzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Mingzong took the throne he made Li prefect of Xinzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 長興末，轉洺州團練使。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of Changxing he was transferred to regimental commissioner of Mingzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Late in Changxing he became regimental commissioner of Mingzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 應順初，遷鄜州節度使，檢校太保。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Yingshun he was transferred to military commissioner of Meizhou and honorary Grand Guardian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Yingshun he was made military commissioner of Meizhou and honorary Grand Guardian.

manualTranslations.zh: 清泰三年春，移鎮潞州，未幾，改華州。
manualTranslations.literal: In spring of the third year of Qingtai he was transferred to garrison Luzhou; before long he was changed to Huazhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the spring of Qingtai 3 he was transferred to Luzhou, and soon after to Huazhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉天福中，授左神武統軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In Tianfu of Jin he was appointed overall commander of the Left Divine Martial Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Jin Tianfu he was made overall commander of the Left Divine Martial Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 少帝即位，歷左金吾衛上將軍，累官至檢校太尉。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Young Emperor succeeded he served as Senior General of the Left Golden Crow Guard and rose through offices to honorary Grand Marshal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the Young Emperor's accession he served as Senior General of the Left Golden Crow Guard and eventually reached honorary Grand Marshal.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖定天下，授特進、太子太師致仕。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu settled the realm he was given Special Advancement and Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and retired.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Gaozu secured the realm he was granted Special Advancement and Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and allowed to retire.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾祐二年秋卒。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn of the second year of Qianyou he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the autumn of Qianyou 2.

sourceRange.text: 張鵬，鎮州鼓城人。幼為僧，知書，有口辯，喜大言，後歸俗。唐末帝為潞王時，鵬往依焉。及即位，用為供奉官，累監軍旅。晉開運中，契丹迫澶州，鵬為前鋒監押，奮身擊敵，被創而還。其後累於邊城戍守，士伍服其勇。乾祐初，授鎮州副使，過鄴城，高行周接之甚歡，鵬因言及晉朝傾亡之事，少帝任用失人，藩輔之臣，惟務積財富家，不以國家為意，以至宗社泯滅，非獨帝王之咎也。行周性寬和，不以鵬言為過。鵬既退，行周左右謂行周曰：「張副使之言，蓋譏令公也。」行周因發怒，遂奏鵬怨國訛言，故朝廷降詔就誅於常山，時乾祐元年七月也。

context.beforeSource: 」即奮刃擊之，挈其首而去，後家人以帛贖葬之。

manualTranslations.zh: 張鵬，鎮州鼓城人。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhang Peng was a man of Gucheng in Zhenzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhang Peng was a native of Gucheng in Zhenzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 幼為僧，知書，有口辯，喜大言，後歸俗。
manualTranslations.literal: In youth he became a monk, knew books, had eloquence, delighted in grand speech, and later returned to lay life.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As a boy he became a monk. He was literate, articulate, and fond of bold talk, and later returned to lay life.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐末帝為潞王時，鵬往依焉。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Last Emperor of Tang was Prince of Lu, Peng went to rely on him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Last Emperor of Tang was still Prince of Lu, Peng went to serve him.

manualTranslations.zh: 及即位，用為供奉官，累監軍旅。
manualTranslations.literal: When he succeeded to the throne, Peng was used as a palace attendant and repeatedly supervised armies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After his accession Peng was made a palace attendant and repeatedly supervised military affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉開運中，契丹迫澶州，鵬為前鋒監押，奮身擊敵，被創而還。
manualTranslations.literal: In Kaiyun of Jin the Khitan pressed Chanzou; Peng was vanguard overseer, threw himself forward to strike the enemy, was wounded, and returned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Jin Kaiyun, when the Khitan pressed Chanzou, Peng served as vanguard overseer, charged the enemy at personal risk, was wounded, and withdrew.

manualTranslations.zh: 其後累於邊城戍守，士伍服其勇。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereafter he repeatedly garrisoned border cities, and the soldiers respected his courage.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He later served repeatedly on frontier garrisons, and the troops respected his bravery.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾祐初，授鎮州副使，過鄴城，高行周接之甚歡，鵬因言及晉朝傾亡之事，少帝任用失人，藩輔之臣，惟務積財富家，不以國家為意，以至宗社泯滅，非獨帝王之咎也。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Qianyou he was appointed deputy commissioner of Zhenzhou. Passing through Yecheng, Gao Xingzhou received him very warmly, and Peng then spoke of the collapse of the Jin court: the Young Emperor employed the wrong men; the frontier ministers sought only to amass wealth for their families and did not care for the state, so that the altars of soil and grain were extinguished—not the fault of the emperor alone.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Qianyou he was made deputy commissioner of Zhenzhou. Passing through Yecheng he was warmly received by Gao Xingzhou, and Peng spoke of the fall of Jin: the Young Emperor had chosen the wrong men; frontier ministers cared only to enrich their families and not the state, until the dynasty was destroyed—a failure not of the emperor alone.

manualTranslations.zh: 行周性寬和，不以鵬言為過。
manualTranslations.literal: Xingzhou's nature was broad and mild; he did not regard Peng's words as a fault.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xingzhou was broad-minded and did not take Peng's remarks amiss.

manualTranslations.zh: 鵬既退，行周左右謂行周曰：「張副使之言，蓋譏令公也。」
manualTranslations.literal: After Peng had withdrawn, Xingzhou's attendants said to Xingzhou: "Deputy Commissioner Zhang's words surely mock Your Excellency."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Peng left, Xingzhou's attendants said to him, "Deputy Commissioner Zhang's words were surely aimed at you, sir."

manualTranslations.zh: 行周因發怒，遂奏鵬怨國訛言，故朝廷降詔就誅於常山，時乾祐元年七月也。
manualTranslations.literal: Xingzhou thereupon grew angry and memorialized that Peng harbored resentment toward the state and spread slanderous talk; therefore the court issued an edict to execute him at Changshan. This was in the seventh month of the first year of Qianyou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xingzhou then grew angry and memorialized that Peng had slandered the state out of resentment. The court issued an edict for his execution at Changshan, in the seventh month of Qianyou 1.

sourceRange.text: 李洪建，太后母弟也。事高祖爲牙將，高祖即位，累歷軍校，遙領防禦使。史宏肇等被誅，以洪建爲權侍衞馬步軍都虞候。及鄴兵南渡，命洪建誅王殷之族，洪建不即行之，但遣人監守其家，仍令給饌，竟免屠戮。周太祖入京城，洪建被執，王殷感洪建之恩，累祈周太祖乞免其死，不從，遂殺之。洪建弟業。業，昆仲凡六人，業處其季，故太后尤憐之。高祖置之麾下，及即位，累遷武德使，出入禁中。業恃太后之親，稍至驕縱。隱帝嗣位，尤深倚愛，兼掌內帑，四方進貢二宮費委之出納。業喜趨權利，無所顧避，執政大臣不敢禁詰。會宣徽使闕，業意欲之，太后亦令人微露風旨於執政。時楊邠、史宏肇等難之，業由是積怨，蕭墻之變，自此而作。楊、史既誅，業權領侍衞步軍都指揮使。北郊兵敗，業自取金寶懷之，策馬西奔。行至陜郊，其節度使洪信，即其長兄也，不敢匿於家。業將奔太原，至絳州境，爲盜所殺，盡奪而去。

context.beforeSource: 無子，惟一女，適戶部員外郎張貽肅，羸疾逾年，扶病就戮。
context.afterSource: 閻晉卿者，忻州人也。
context.beforeLocal: 無子，惟一女，適戶部員外郎張貽肅，羸疾逾年，扶病就戮。
context.afterLocal: 閻晉卿者，忻州人也。

manualTranslations.zh: 李洪建，太后母弟也。
manualTranslations.literal: Li Hongjian was the empress dowager's younger brother by the same mother.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li Hongjian was the empress dowager's younger maternal brother.

manualTranslations.zh: 事高祖爲牙將，高祖即位，累歷軍校，遙領防禦使。
manualTranslations.literal: He served Gaozu as a guard officer; when Gaozu took the throne, he rose through military posts and held the defense commissioner title in absentia.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He served Emperor Gaozu as a guard officer; when Gaozu took the throne, he rose through military posts and held the defense commissioner title in absentia.

manualTranslations.zh: 史宏肇等被誅，以洪建爲權侍衞馬步軍都虞候。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shi Hongzhao and the others were executed, Hongjian was made acting chief registrar of the palace guard horse and foot armies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Shi Hongzhao and the others were killed, Hongjian was made acting chief registrar of the palace guard horse and foot armies.

manualTranslations.zh: 及鄴兵南渡，命洪建誅王殷之族，洪建不即行之，但遣人監守其家，仍令給饌，竟免屠戮。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Ye army crossed south, he was ordered to exterminate Wang Yin's clan; Hongjian did not carry it out at once but sent men to guard the household and still had food provided, thus sparing them massacre.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Ye army crossed the river south, he was ordered to exterminate Wang Yin's clan. Hongjian did not act at once but posted guards at the household and still had food sent, sparing them massacre.

manualTranslations.zh: 周太祖入京城，洪建被執，王殷感洪建之恩，累祈周太祖乞免其死，不從，遂殺之。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Zhou founder entered the capital, Hongjian was seized; Wang Yin, grateful for Hongjian's kindness, repeatedly begged the Zhou founder to spare his life, but was refused, and Hongjian was then killed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Guo Wei entered the capital, Hongjian was seized. Wang Yin, grateful for Hongjian's kindness, repeatedly begged Guo Wei to spare his life, but was refused, and Hongjian was killed.

manualTranslations.zh: 洪建弟業。
manualTranslations.literal: Hongjian had a younger brother, Ye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hongjian had a younger brother named Ye.

manualTranslations.zh: 業，昆仲凡六人，業處其季，故太后尤憐之。
manualTranslations.literal: Ye was the youngest of six brothers and was especially favored by the empress dowager.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ye was the youngest of six brothers and was especially favored by the empress dowager.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖置之麾下，及即位，累遷武德使，出入禁中。
manualTranslations.literal: Gaozu placed him under his command, and when he took the throne Ye was repeatedly promoted to Military Virtue Commissioner and came and went within the inner palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gaozu placed him in his service, and when he took the throne Ye was repeatedly promoted to Military Virtue Commissioner and moved freely within the inner palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 業恃太后之親，稍至驕縱。
manualTranslations.literal: Ye relied on his kinship with the empress dowager and gradually grew arrogant and unrestrained.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ye relied on his tie to the empress dowager and gradually grew arrogant and unrestrained.

manualTranslations.zh: 隱帝嗣位，尤深倚愛，兼掌內帑，四方進貢二宮費委之出納。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Hidden Emperor succeeded, he relied on Ye all the more, also put him in charge of the inner treasury, and entrusted him with the receipt and disbursement of tribute goods for the two palaces from all quarters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yindi succeeded, he relied on Ye all the more, gave him charge of the inner treasury, and entrusted him with tribute receipts and disbursements for the two palaces from all quarters.

manualTranslations.zh: 業喜趨權利，無所顧避，執政大臣不敢禁詰。
manualTranslations.literal: Ye delighted in grasping power and profit without scruple; the ruling ministers dared not reprimand him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ye delighted in power and profit without scruple, and the ruling ministers dared not reprimand him.

manualTranslations.zh: 會宣徽使闕，業意欲之，太后亦令人微露風旨於執政。
manualTranslations.literal: When the palace secretariat commissioner post fell vacant, Ye wanted it, and the empress dowager also had someone subtly convey her wish to the ministers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the palace secretariat commissioner post fell vacant, Ye wanted it, and the empress dowager also had someone subtly convey her wish to the ministers.

manualTranslations.zh: 時楊邠、史宏肇等難之，業由是積怨，蕭墻之變，自此而作。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Yang Bin, Shi Hongzhao, and others objected; Ye thus nursed a grudge, and the palace mutiny arose from this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yang Bin, Shi Hongzhao, and others objected; Ye nursed a grudge, and the palace mutiny arose from this.

manualTranslations.zh: 楊、史既誅，業權領侍衞步軍都指揮使。
manualTranslations.literal: After Yang and Shi were executed, Ye was made acting commander of the palace guard foot army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Yang and Shi were killed, Ye was made acting commander of the palace guard foot army.

manualTranslations.zh: 北郊兵敗，業自取金寶懷之，策馬西奔。
manualTranslations.literal: When the northern suburb army was defeated, Ye took gold and jewels into his bosom and spurred his horse west in flight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the northern suburb army was defeated, Ye stuffed gold and jewels into his robes and spurred his horse west in flight.

manualTranslations.zh: 行至陜郊，其節度使洪信，即其長兄也，不敢匿於家。
manualTranslations.literal: When he reached the Shaan outskirts, the military commissioner there was Hongxin, his eldest brother, who dared not hide him at home.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he reached the Shaan outskirts, the military commissioner there was Hongxin, his eldest brother, who dared not shelter him at home.

manualTranslations.zh: 業將奔太原，至絳州境，爲盜所殺，盡奪而去。
manualTranslations.literal: Ye was about to flee to Taiyuan, but when he reached Jing Prefecture territory he was killed by bandits, who stripped him of everything.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ye was heading for Taiyuan, but when he reached Jing Prefecture territory bandits killed him and stripped him of everything.

sourceRange.text: 宏肇弟福，比在滎陽別墅，聞禍，匿於民間。周太祖即位，累遷閑廄使。仕皇朝，歷諸衞將軍。（《宋史·李崇矩傳》：史宏肇爲先鋒都校，聞崇矩名，召署親吏。乾祐初，宏肇總禁兵，兼京城巡檢，多殘殺軍民，左右稍稍引去，惟崇矩事之益謹。及宏肇誅，獨得免。周祖與宏肇素厚善，即位，訪求宏肇親舊，得崇矩，謂之曰：「我與史公受漢厚恩，戮力同心，共獎王室，爲奸邪所構，史公卒罹大禍，我亦僅免。汝史家故吏也，爲我求其近屬，我將恤之。」崇矩上其母弟福。崇矩素主其家，盡籍財產以付福，周祖嘉之。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hongzhao's younger brother Fu was then at a country villa in Xingyang; hearing of the disaster, he hid among the people.

manualTranslations.literal: When the Zhou founder took the throne, Fu was repeatedly promoted, eventually to commissioner of idle stables.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Guo Wei took the throne, Fu was repeatedly promoted, eventually to commissioner of idle stables.

manualTranslations.zh: 仕皇朝，歷諸衞將軍。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Serving the imperial court, he held successive posts as general of the guard offices.

manualTranslations.zh: （《宋史·李崇矩傳》：史宏肇爲先鋒都校，聞崇矩名，召署親吏。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: (From the Biography of Li Chongju in the History of Song: Shi Hongzhao served as vanguard commander; hearing of Chongju's reputation, he summoned him and appointed him personal clerk.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾祐初，宏肇總禁兵，兼京城巡檢，多殘殺軍民，左右稍稍引去，惟崇矩事之益謹。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Qianyou, Hongzhao controlled the forbidden army and also served as capital patrol commissioner, killing many soldiers and civilians; his attendants gradually withdrew, but Chongju served him all the more diligently.

manualTranslations.zh: 及宏肇誅，獨得免。
manualTranslations.literal: When Hongzhao was executed, Chongju alone was spared.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Hongzhao was executed, Chongju alone was spared.

manualTranslations.zh: 周祖與宏肇素厚善，即位，訪求宏肇親舊，得崇矩，謂之曰：「我與史公受漢厚恩，戮力同心，共獎王室，爲奸邪所構，史公卒罹大禍，我亦僅免。
manualTranslations.literal: The Zhou founder and Hongzhao had long been close friends; upon taking the throne he sought out Hongzhao's kin and associates, found Chongju, and said to him: "Lord Shi and I received deep grace from Han, strove together in one mind to uphold the royal house, yet were framed by villainy; Lord Shi ultimately met with great calamity, and I barely escaped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Zhou founder and Hongzhao had long been close; upon taking the throne he sought Hongzhao's kin and associates, found Chongju, and said to him, "Lord Shi and I received deep grace from Han and strove as one to uphold the throne, yet villains framed us; Lord Shi was destroyed and I barely escaped.

manualTranslations.zh: 汝史家故吏也，爲我求其近屬，我將恤之。
manualTranslations.literal: You were an old clerk of the Shi household—find his close kin for me and I will provide for them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You were an old clerk of the Shi house—find his close kin and I will care for them.

manualTranslations.zh: 」崇矩上其母弟福。
manualTranslations.literal: " Chongju presented his younger brother by the same mother, Fu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " Chongju then presented his younger brother by the same mother, Fu.

manualTranslations.zh: 崇矩素主其家，盡籍財產以付福，周祖嘉之。
manualTranslations.literal: Chongju had long managed the household and turned over all registered property to Fu; the Zhou founder commended this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chongju had long managed the household and turned over all registered property to Fu; the Zhou founder commended him.

sourceRange.text: 晉祖受命，敏以本官判戶部，遷尚書左丞。丁父憂，服闋，復本官，俄移太常卿。開運中，奉命使越。先是，朝臣將命，必拜起於浙帥，敏至，抗揖而已，識者多之。使還，改工部尚書。乾祐元年春，疽發於背，聞高祖晏駕，乃扶病於私第，縞素而臨，後旬日卒於家，時年六十三。隱帝嗣位，詔贈右僕射。劉鼎，字公度，徐州蕭縣人。祖泰，蕭縣令。父崇，梁太祖微時，常傭力崇家，及即位，召崇用之，歷殿中監、商州刺史。崇之母撫梁祖有恩，梁氏號為「國婆」，徐、宋之民謂崇家為「豢龍劉家」。鼎起家為大理評事，歷尚書博士、殿中侍郎史、起居郎。清泰中，自吏部員外郎出為渾州廉判，入為刑部郎中，充鹽鐵判官，改吏部郎中兼侍御史知雜事。乾祐初，拜諫議大夫，卒年五十五。鼎善交遊，能談笑。居家仁孝，事繼母趙氏甚謹，異母昆仲凡七人，撫之如一。性若寬易，而典選曹按吏有風棱，人稱為能。

context.beforeSource: 」人亦以為大言，然其慷慨感激，皆此類也。
context.afterSource: 子袞，登進士第，文彩遒雋。
context.beforeLocal: 人亦以為大言，然其慷慨感激，皆此類也。
context.afterLocal: 子袞，登進士第，文彩遒雋。

manualTranslations.zh: 晉祖受命，敏以本官判戶部，遷尚書左丞。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Jin founder received the Mandate, Min in his existing office oversaw the Ministry of Revenue and was promoted to left assistant director of the Department of State Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Jin founder took power, Min retained his post while overseeing revenue and was promoted to left assistant director of the Department of State Affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁父憂，服闋，復本官，俄移太常卿。
manualTranslations.literal: He entered mourning for his father; when mourning ended he resumed his original office, and soon was transferred to Minister of Ceremonies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After his father's death he mourned; when mourning ended he resumed his former post and was soon made Minister of Ceremonies.

manualTranslations.zh: 開運中，奉命使越。
manualTranslations.literal: During Kaiyun he was ordered on embassy to Yue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Kaiyun he was sent on embassy to Yue.

manualTranslations.zh: 先是，朝臣將命，必拜起於浙帥，敏至，抗揖而已，識者多之。
manualTranslations.literal: Previously, when court ministers received imperial commissions they invariably bowed and rose before the Zhe commander; when Min arrived he returned only a formal bow with folded arms, and the discerning praised him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Previously court envoys would bow before the Zhe commander; Min arrived and returned only a formal bow with folded arms, and the discerning praised him.

manualTranslations.zh: 使還，改工部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: On returning from his mission he was made minister of works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On his return he was made minister of works.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾祐元年春，疽發於背，聞高祖晏駕，乃扶病於私第，縞素而臨，後旬日卒於家，時年六十三。
manualTranslations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Qianyou a boil erupted on his back; hearing that Gaozu had died, he supported his illness at his private residence and went in white mourning to attend; ten days later he died at home, aged sixty-three.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the spring of Qianyou year one a carbuncle broke out on his back. Learning that Gaozu had died, he dragged himself from his home in mourning dress to attend, and ten days later died at home at sixty-three.

manualTranslations.zh: 隱帝嗣位，詔贈右僕射。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Hidden Emperor succeeded, an edict posthumously granted him right vice director of the Department of State Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Hidden Emperor succeeded, an edict posthumously made him right vice director of the Department of State Affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 劉鼎，字公度，徐州蕭縣人。
manualTranslations.literal: Liu Ding, styled Gongdu, was a native of Xiao County in Xu Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liu Ding, styled Gongdu, was from Xiao County in Xu Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 祖泰，蕭縣令。
manualTranslations.literal: His grandfather Tai was magistrate of Xiao County.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His grandfather Tai was magistrate of Xiao County.

manualTranslations.zh: 父崇，梁太祖微時，常傭力崇家，及即位，召崇用之，歷殿中監、商州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Chong, when the Liang Taizu was still obscure, often hired out his labor to Chong's house; when Taizu took the throne he summoned Chong and employed him, and Chong served as director of the palace bureau and prefect of Shang Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Chong had employed the future Liang Taizu as a laborer when the latter was obscure; when Taizu took the throne he recalled Chong and promoted him through director of the palace bureau and prefect of Shang.

manualTranslations.zh: 崇之母撫梁祖有恩，梁氏號為「國婆」，徐、宋之民謂崇家為「豢龍劉家」。
manualTranslations.literal: Chong's mother had shown kindness in raising the Liang founder, and the Liang house called her "State Grandmother"; the people of Xu and Song called Chong's family the "Dragon-Raising Liu Family."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chong's mother had nursed the Liang founder and was called "State Grandmother" by the Liang house; people in Xu and Song called the family the "Dragon-Raising Liu."

manualTranslations.zh: 鼎起家為大理評事，歷尚書博士、殿中侍郎史、起居郎。
manualTranslations.literal: Ding began his career as a judging official of the Court of Judicial Review, and served as erudite of the Secretariat, palace censor, and recorder of the ruler's movements.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ding began as a judging official in the Court of Judicial Review, then served as secretariat erudite, palace censor, and recorder of the ruler's movements.

manualTranslations.zh: 清泰中，自吏部員外郎出為渾州廉判，入為刑部郎中，充鹽鐵判官，改吏部郎中兼侍御史知雜事。
manualTranslations.literal: In Qingtai he left the post of vice director in the Ministry of Personnel to become integrity assessor of Hun Prefecture, entered court as director in the Ministry of Punishments, served as salt and iron judging official, and was changed to director in the Ministry of Personnel concurrently with attendant censor in charge of miscellaneous matters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Qingtai he went out from vice director of personnel to serve as integrity assessor of Hun Prefecture, then returned as director in the ministry of punishments, salt-and-iron judging official, and finally director of personnel with concurrent attendant censor in charge of miscellaneous business.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾祐初，拜諫議大夫，卒年五十五。
manualTranslations.literal: Early in Qianyou he was appointed remonstrance official and died at fifty-five.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Qianyou he was made remonstrance official and died at fifty-five.

manualTranslations.zh: 鼎善交遊，能談笑。
manualTranslations.literal: Ding was skilled at friendship and could banter with ease.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ding made friends easily and was gifted at witty conversation.

manualTranslations.zh: 居家仁孝，事繼母趙氏甚謹，異母昆仲凡七人，撫之如一。
manualTranslations.literal: At home he was filial and kind; he served his stepmother Lady Zhao with great care; among seven half-brothers he treated them all alike.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At home he was filial; he served his stepmother Lady Zhao devotedly and treated seven half-brothers as one.

manualTranslations.zh: 性若寬易，而典選曹按吏有風棱，人稱為能。
manualTranslations.literal: His nature seemed easygoing, yet in managing the personnel bureau and investigating officials he had stern authority, and people called him capable.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He seemed easygoing by nature, yet in the personnel bureau his handling of officials was sharp-edged, and he was reckoned capable.

sourceRange.text: 春，契丹以全軍南下，前鋒至相州湯陰縣，詔守貞屯滑州。

localRange.text: 開運二年春，契丹以全軍南下，前鋒至相州湯陰縣，詔守貞屯滑州。

sourceRange.text: 古者用刑，本期止辟，今茲作法，義切禁非。蓋承弊之時，非猛則奸兇難制；及知勸之後，在寬則典憲得宜。相時而行，庶臻中道。今後應犯竊盜賊贓及和奸者，並依晉天福元年已前條制施行。應諸犯罪人等，除反逆罪外，其罪並不得籍沒家產、誅及骨肉，一依格令處分。

manualTranslations.zh: 古者用刑，本期止辟，今茲作法，義切禁非。
manualTranslations.literal: "In antiquity punishment was used with the aim of ending crime; now in establishing law, the principle is firmly to forbid wrongdoing."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: "In antiquity punishment was used to end crime; now in establishing law, the aim is firmly to forbid wrongdoing."

manualTranslations.zh: 蓋承弊之時，非猛則奸兇難制；
manualTranslations.literal: "For in a time of inherited decline, unless severity is applied the crafty and violent are hard to control;"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: "For in a time of inherited decline, unless severity is applied the crafty and violent are hard to control;"

manualTranslations.zh: 及知勸之後，在寬則典憲得宜。
manualTranslations.literal: "once people have been taught and encouraged, leniency allows the code and laws to be properly applied."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: "once people have been taught and encouraged, leniency allows the code and laws to be properly applied."

manualTranslations.zh: 相時而行，庶臻中道。
manualTranslations.literal: "Act according to the times, so that the middle Way may be attained."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: "Act according to the times, so that the middle Way may be attained."

manualTranslations.zh: 今後應犯竊盜賊贓及和奸者，並依晉天福元年已前條制施行。
manualTranslations.literal: "Henceforth those guilty of theft, robbery, plunder, and adultery shall all be handled according to the regulations in force before the first year of Later Jin's Tianfu era."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: "Henceforth those guilty of theft, robbery, plunder, or adultery shall all be handled according to the regulations in force before Later Jin Tianfu 1."

manualTranslations.zh: 應諸犯罪人等，除反逆罪外，其罪並不得籍沒家產、誅及骨肉，一依格令處分。
manualTranslations.literal: "As for all offenders, except for the crime of treason, their offenses shall not entail confiscation of household property or execution of kinsmen — all shall be handled according to the statutes and regulations."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: "For all offenders, except in cases of treason, offenses shall not entail confiscation of household property or execution of kinsmen — all shall be handled according to the statutes and regulations."

sourceRange.text: 五月壬戌朔，帝不視朝，以漢隱帝梓宮在殯故也。戊寅，皇子澶州節度使榮起復，依前澶州節度使，以故貴妃張氏去歲薨，至是發哀故也。己巳，遣左金吾衛將軍姚漢英、前右神武將軍華光裔使於契丹。辛未，太常卿邊蔚上追尊四廟謚議。是夜，有大星如五升器，流於東北，有聲如雷。丙子，太常卿邊蔚上太廟四室奠獻舞名。丁丑，詔京兆、鳳翔府，應諸色犯事人第宅、莊園、店硙已經籍沒者，並給付罪人骨肉。壬午，幸南莊。甲申，考城縣巡檢、供奉官馬彥棄市，坐匿赦書殺獄囚也。丙戌，宰臣馮道為四廟冊禮使。

context.beforeSource: 辛酉，司空致仕盧文紀卒。
context.afterSource: 六月辛卯朔，不視朝，以漢隱帝梓宮在殯故也。
context.beforeLocal: 辛酉，司空致仕盧文紀卒。
context.afterLocal: 六月辛卯朔，不視朝，以漢隱帝梓宮在殯故也。

manualTranslations.zh: 五月壬戌朔，帝不視朝，以漢隱帝梓宮在殯故也。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, on the new moon of the day renxu, the emperor did not hold court, because the coffin of the Hidden Emperor of Han was still in temporary interment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon of renxu day, court was not held because the Hidden Emperor of Han's coffin remained in temporary interment.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊寅，皇子澶州節度使榮起復，依前澶州節度使，以故貴妃張氏去歲薨，至是發哀故也。
manualTranslations.literal: On the day wuyin, Prince Rong, Military Commissioner of Chan, returned to office, continuing as before as Military Commissioner of Chan, because the late Noble Consort Zhang had died the previous year and mourning was now observed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Prince Rong, Military Commissioner of Chan, resumed duty as before, because the late Noble Consort Zhang had died the previous year and mourning was now observed.

manualTranslations.zh: 己巳，遣左金吾衛將軍姚漢英、前右神武將軍華光裔使於契丹。
manualTranslations.literal: On the day jisi, Yao Hanying, General of the Left Golden Guard, and Hua Guangyi, former General of the Right Divine Martial Guard, were dispatched as envoys to the Khitan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Yao Hanying, General of the Left Golden Guard, and Hua Guangyi, former General of the Right Divine Martial Guard, were sent as envoys to the Khitan.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛未，太常卿邊蔚上追尊四廟謚議。
manualTranslations.literal: On the day xinwei, Bian Yu, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, submitted posthumous titles for the four ancestral temples for elevation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Bian Yu, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, submitted proposed posthumous titles for elevating the four ancestral temples.

manualTranslations.zh: 是夜，有大星如五升器，流於東北，有聲如雷。
manualTranslations.literal: That night, there was a great star like a five-sheng vessel, streaming toward the northeast, with a sound like thunder.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That night a great meteor like a five-pint vessel streaked northeast with a thunderous roar.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙子，太常卿邊蔚上太廟四室奠獻舞名。
manualTranslations.literal: On the day bingzi, Bian Yu, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, submitted the names of offerings and dances for the four chambers of the Imperial Temple.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Bian Yu, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, submitted the offering and dance names for the four chambers of the Imperial Temple.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁丑，詔京兆、鳳翔府，應諸色犯事人第宅、莊園、店硙已經籍沒者，並給付罪人骨肉。
manualTranslations.literal: On the day dingchou, an edict was issued to Jingzhao and Fengxiang prefectures that among all offenders of every kind, houses, estates, shops, and water mills already registered and confiscated should all be restored to the offenders' kin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Jingzhao and Fengxiang were ordered that houses, estates, shops, and water mills already confiscated from offenders of every kind be restored to the offenders' kin.

manualTranslations.zh: 壬午，幸南莊。
manualTranslations.literal: On the day renwu, the emperor visited the Southern Villa.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the emperor visited the Southern Villa.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲申，考城縣巡檢、供奉官馬彥棄市，坐匿赦書殺獄囚也。
manualTranslations.literal: On the day jiashen, Ma Yan, patrol inspector of Kaocheng County and Palace Attendant, was executed in the marketplace, the offense being concealing an amnesty edict and killing prisoners.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Ma Yan, patrol inspector of Kaocheng County and Palace Attendant, was executed in the marketplace for concealing an amnesty edict and killing prisoners.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙戌，宰臣馮道為四廟冊禮使。
manualTranslations.literal: On the day bingxu, Chief Minister Feng Dao was made commissioner for the four ancestral temples' enfeoffment rites.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Chief Minister Feng Dao was appointed commissioner for the four ancestral temples' enfeoffment rites.

sourceRange.text: 顯德元年正月庚辰，加開府儀同三司、檢校太尉、兼侍中，依前開封尹兼功德使，判內外兵馬事。時太祖寢疾彌留，士庶憂沮，及聞帝總內外兵柄，咸以為愜。（《隆平集》：曹翰隸世宗幕下，世宗鎮澶淵，以為牙校。及尹開封，翰猶在澶淵，聞周祖寢疾，不俟召來見世宗，密言曰：「王為冢嗣，不侍醫藥，何以副天下望？」世宗悟，入侍禁中，以府事命翰總決。）壬辰，太祖崩，秘不發喪。丙申，內出太祖遺制：「晉王榮可於柩前即位。」群臣奉帝即皇帝位。庚子，宰臣馮道率百僚上表請聽政，凡三上。壬寅，帝見群臣於萬歲殿門之東廡下。

context.beforeSource: 三月，授開封尹兼功德使，封晉王。
context.afterSource: 二月庚戌，潞州奏，河東劉崇與契丹大將軍楊袞，舉兵南指。

context.afterLocal: 二月庚戌，潞州奏，河東劉崇與契丹大將軍楊袞，舉兵南指。
